izzyondroid:it.unige.hidedroid.name: HideDroid
izzyondroid:it.unige.hidedroid.summary: per-app anonymization of collected personal data to a user-chosen privacy level
izzyondroid:it.unige.hidedroid.description:
HideDroid allows the per-app anonymization of collected personal data according to a privacy level chosen by the user.
 In a nutshell, HideDroid collects all the network traffic generated by the invocation of API calls belonging to analytics libraries, and extract the exported data. Then, it anonymizes the personal and device data using a generalization technique, and the data related to the user’s behavior using an approach based on the concept of local differential privacy, in a way that preserves as much data semantics as possible. Finally, the anonymized data are sent to the expected recipients by mimicking the original network calls.

fdroid:com.sponsorcut.name: SponsorCut
fdroid:com.sponsorcut.summary: Remove sponsor segments from local video and audio files using SponsorBlock.
fdroid:com.sponsorcut.description:
SponsorCut removes sponsor segments, intros, outros, and other non-content sections from locally stored video and audio files. It uses SponsorBlock community data to identify segments, then re-encodes or stream-copies the file with those sections cleanly cut out.
How it works:
Enter a YouTube or video ID, or share a file directly from your file manager or browser. SponsorCut fetches the SponsorBlock segment list for the ID, shows you what will be cut and how much time you'll save, then processes the file entirely on-device. The result is saved to your Downloads or Music folder.
Usage methods:
- Share a video or audio file from any file manager
- Share a URL from YouTube — SponsorCut extracts the ID and pre-fetches segments
- Enter a YouTube video ID manually and browse to the local file
- Open a file directly via a compatible player or browser
Features:
- Supports MP4, MKV, WebM, TS, M4A, MP3, AAC, and Opus files
- Audio-only files are saved to Music/SponsorCut with correct MIME type
- Cancel button stops processing at any time
- Wake lock keeps CPU active when the screen turns off during long jobs
- Diagnostic log shows detailed FFmpeg output after each run
- Status text is selectable for easy copying
- Remembers the last used video ID and file across sessions
All processing is local. No data is sent to any server except the SponsorBlock API query (video ID only) and an optional YouTube oEmbed title lookup. No analytics, no tracking, no accounts.
Requires Android 8.0 (Oreo) or later.
SponsorCut is free, open-source, and built in spare time. If it saves you time every day, consider buying the developer a coffee:

fdroid:org.bitanon.studfinder.name: StudFinder - Stud Finder for Android
fdroid:org.bitanon.studfinder.summary: Find wall studs with your Android's built-in magnetometer. Free, no ads.
fdroid:org.bitanon.studfinder.description:
StudFinder uses your Android phone's built-in magnetometer (compass sensor) to detect metal screws and nails inside wall studs. No paid subscription, no ads, no tracking — just a tool that works.
How it works:
Your phone's magnetometer measures the local magnetic field. Wood studs are held in place by metal fasteners (screws or nails) that disrupt the field. StudFinder reads that disruption and shows it on a live LED bar display, letting you sweep along the wall and pinpoint where studs are.
How to use:
1. Calibrate by moving a coin slowly around the back of your phone until the LED sequence completes.
2. Hold the phone flat against the wall.
3. Sweep slowly along the wall horizontally.
4. The LEDs light up red when the magnetometer detects a metal fastener inside a stud.
5. Mark the position and repeat to confirm the stud's width.
Limitations:
The magnetometer detects metal, not wood directly. It works reliably on standard wood-framed walls with metal screws or nails. Concrete walls, steel studs, or plaster-over-metal-lath surfaces give different results — consider a dedicated hardware stud finder for those.
Open source and F-Droid:
StudFinder is fully open-source (Apache 2.0) and distributed through F-Droid. Zero proprietary dependencies: no AdMob, no Firebase, no Google Play Services. The app requires no INTERNET permission and works entirely offline. Source code: github.com/clankwright/StudFinderAndroid

apple-itunes:1451457615.description:
Turn your iPhone and iPad into a dedicated digital canvas. iArtbook combines a fast graphics engine with a clean, intuitive interface — whether you are sketching a quick idea with your finger or painting a detailed illustration with Apple Pencil.
Core features:
* Clean, focused interface. The workspace keeps your tools within easy reach without cluttering the screen. You can pick up the basics in minutes, even if you are new to digital drawing.
* Real-time line stabilization. Three smoothing modes — Line Delay, Rope Stabilization, and Correction — help you draw steady, clean lines, even with your finger on a phone screen.
* Natural paint and brush engine. Blend colors with realistic physics. Choose from hundreds of dry, glossy, textured, and wet brushes, or build your own using a library of over 1,000 textures.
* Layered frame-by-frame animation. Animate characters right inside your main workspace. Combine multiple layers with frame-by-frame playback and customizable Onion Skin settings.
* Flexible layer workflow. Work with complex, multi-layered compositions smoothly. Group layers into folders and edit entire sets at once using Transform, Effects, and Liquify, alongside clipping masks and standard blend modes.
* Deep customization and tutorials. Get started with built-in step-by-step tutorials, high-precision rendering, and detailed brush settings — with even more options available in the Pro version.
Built for a smooth workflow:
* Apple Pencil integration. Responsive pressure and tilt sensitivity paired with reliable palm rejection.
* One-tap smudge. Turn any active brush into a Smudge tool in a single tap to blend colors while keeping the exact same stroke texture.
* Automatic time-lapse. Record your drawing process in the background and export speedpaints ready for social media.
* Essential studio utilities. Quick undo gestures, an eyedropper, symmetry rulers, perspective guides, stencils, and export to PSD, PNG, JPEG, MP4, and GIF.
Download iArtbook and start drawing.

apple-itunes:839537579.name: Prêt à Template
apple-itunes:839537579.description:
Bring your fashion design ideas to life, from the first sketch to the finished collection. Prêt-à-Template is a professional fashion design app created for fashion sketching, fashion illustration, outfit design, and product development. Built for students, creatives, stylists, and professional designers, it transforms inspiration into polished fashion concepts with tools designed specifically for the real fashion workflow.
Whether you are learning fashion drawing, building a fashion portfolio, developing a collection, or exploring new styling ideas, Prêt-à-Template offers a complete workspace for modern fashion design. Unlike generic drawing apps, it is built specifically for the needs of the fashion industry, combining fashion sketch tools, realistic templates, visual research, and presentation workflows in one place. It supports both creative exploration and technical development, helping designers move from early concepts to more resolved and presentation-ready ideas with greater speed and confidence.
The app lets you begin creating in two distinct ways, depending on your design style. You can work with linework templates that include front, side, and back guides, making them ideal for structured fashion sketches, technical development, and clean fashion illustration. Or you can start with realistic product templates, working directly over lifelike silhouettes with depth and volume, which is perfect for outfit design, product visualization, and concept development. Puzzle Look makes the creative process even faster and more intuitive. Simply describe the look you want, and it selects the most relevant templates from the library so you can begin designing right away. AI supports your process with fashion-aware suggestions while keeping the designer fully in control of every creative decision.
Prêt-à-Template also includes a flexible mood board workspace where inspiration, materials, styling ideas, and product references can come together naturally. Its integrated fashion library includes fabrics, textile structures, prints, patterns, textures, trims, findings, sleeves, collars, cuffs, pockets, openings, construction details, care labels, and textile symbols, creating a rich environment for research, experimentation, and product thinking. 
The canvas makes fashion sketching feel more expressive, natural, and realistic. You can sketch, shade, annotate, render, and refine using intuitive tools, realistic brush behavior, and a paper-like surface that gives the digital drawing experience a more tactile quality. Prêt-à-Template also uses AI with real fashion context. Its templates are built around garment proportions, silhouette logic, fabric behavior, drape, trims, and construction details, helping deliver results that feel realistic and aligned with professional fashion design workflows rather than generic image generation.
From fashion design and fashion sketching to fashion illustration, outfit design, mood board creation, collection development, styling exploration, textile research, and fashion portfolio building, Prêt-à-Template supports every stage of the fashion design process in one creative workspace, whether you are just starting out or already working at a professional level.
Subscription Pricing & Terms

apple-macos:6449091332.name: Vetero° Menu Bar Weather
apple-macos:6449091332.description:
Vetero is a weather app built only for the Mac. It sits in your menu bar next to the clock: look up for the temperature, click for the whole forecast.
Official severe weather warnings are free for everyone, not a Plus feature. You see them in the menu bar and on the forecast, and the most serious ones are Time Sensitive, so they arrive even during a Focus.
Free for everyone:
• A menu bar you configure: the temperature or how warm it feels, a condition symbol, a warning badge, and humidity, wind, UV and pressure as items of their own.
• Everything in one popover: feels-like, precipitation, wind and gusts, pressure, UV, humidity and the condition, with dew point, visibility and the moon phase if you want them. No tabs, nothing to scroll for.
• Sunrise and sunset: the sun's real path across the day, first and last light, how long the day is, and today's high and low as a range.
• The next three hours, and tomorrow's forecast.
• The next hour of rain in words: when it starts and when it stops.
• Notifications when rain is about to start and when a freeze follows a mild spell.
• A forecast for your location, precise wherever you happen to be, or for a city you pick.
• A short tour on first launch, which you can open again from the menu.
Vetero Plus adds:
• Fresher weather, refreshed as often as every 10 minutes instead of every 100.
• A countdown in the menu bar to the minute rain or snow starts.
• A ten-day forecast: nine more days after tomorrow.
• Twelve hours ahead, in a strip you scroll sideways, so the popover stays the same height.
• Rain by the minute: the next hour on a chart, showing how hard it will fall.
• Chance of rain by the hour: a bar an hour for the next two days.
• A morning briefing at a time you pick, with the sky, the high and low, and when rain is likely.
• Alerts for damaging gusts, very high UV, and a much colder or warmer tomorrow.
The next hour of rain in words, the notification when rain is about to start, rain by the minute and the countdown all depend on a minute-by-minute forecast that Apple Weather has only in some countries. Where it has none, Vetero doesn't offer them.
Why Vetero:
• Apple Weather data: the same source the rest of your Mac uses.
• Backing an independent developer: subscribing to Vetero Plus supports their work directly and helps the app grow.
Vetero is free. Vetero Plus is an optional yearly auto-renewable subscription with a two-week free trial. Before you start it, Vetero shows the day of the first charge. The subscription renews automatically each year unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Weather data from Apple Weather.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.micropixels.software/vetero/terms
Support: https://www.micropixels.software/vetero

apple-macos:6827988367.description:
The weather, with a little character.
Bring the charm of a traditional weather house to your iPhone/iPad and macOS device. The Weather House pairs an intricately illustrated wooden chalet with local weather, animated figures, ambient sound, and changing skies—turning a quick weather check into something worth lingering over.
TRADITION COMES TO LIFE
Inspired by the familiar weather-house mechanism, the figures respond to outdoor relative humidity: she moves forward in drier conditions, he in more humid conditions. A thermometer completes the scene, while the animated flag adds another touch of movement.
It is a nostalgic interpretation of today's outdoor conditions, brought to life with weather data rather than a physical humidity sensor.
A CHARMING VIEW. USEFUL DETAIL.
Show local temperature, humidity and wind speed beneath the house. Tap the conditions bar to explore a more detailed view, including hourly and five-day forecasts.
Discover feels-like temperature, wind direction, pressure, precipitation, sunrise and sunset, and more when available from the weather provider.
MAKE IT FEEL LIKE HOME
Enjoy an animated sky that reflects local weather, or choose photos from your library for a more personal setting. Add soft focus, gentle Ken Burns motion, or an animated selection of photos.
Choose nostalgic figures where available, show or hide the city and date/time labels, and adjust the presentation to suit your mood.
YOUR WEATHER. YOUR PREFERENCES.
• Temperature in Celsius or Fahrenheit.
• Wind speed in Beaufort or metres per second.
• Independent controls for flag and weather animation.
• Optional city, date/time and conditions displays.
• Photo backgrounds with soft focus and motion effects.
• Layouts for iPhone and iPad.
A little craftsmanship. A little nostalgia. A different way to enjoy the weather.
An internet connection and location access are needed to retrieve local weather. Available readings and forecast details vary by provider and location. The figures illustrate humidity; they do not independently predict rain.

READ YOUR WAY
Browse stories from individual sites or bring a folder together in one reading list. Choose a comfortable theme, adjust the text, and use gestures to move through your stories. Download stories for offline reading and pick up where you left off.
STORIES AT A GLANCE

GO DEEPER

IN YOUR LANGUAGE

flathub:com.github.xournalpp.xournalpp.name: Xournal++
flathub:com.github.xournalpp.xournalpp.description:
Xournal++ is a hand note-taking software written in C++ with the target of flexibility, functionality
 and speed. Stroke recognizer and other parts are based on Xournal Code, which you can find at sourceforge.
 It supports GNU/Linux (e.g. Ubuntu, Debian, Arch, SUSE), macOS and Windows. Supports pen input
 from devices such as Wacom Tablets.
 Xournal++ features:
 Supports pressure-sensitive styluses and digital pen tables (e.g. Wacom, Huion, XP Pen, etc.
 tablets)
 Paper backgrounds for note-taking, scratch paper, or whiteboarding
 Annotate on top of PDFs
 Select text from the background PDF, copy, highlight or underline it or strike it through
 Follow links from the background PDF
 Export to a variety of formats including SVG, PNG and PDF, both from the GUI and command
 line
 Different drawing tools (e.g. pen, highlighter) and stroke styles (e.g. solid, dotted)
 Shape drawing (line, arrow, circle, rectangle, spline)
 Use the set-square and compass tools for measurements or as a guide for drawing straight
 lines, circular arcs and radii
 Fill shape functionality
 Shape resizing and rotation
 Rotation and grid snapping for precise alignment of objects
 Input stabilization for smoother writing/drawing
 Text tool for adding text in different fonts, colors, and sizes
 Enhanced support for image insertion
 Eraser with multiple configurations
 LaTeX support (requires a working LaTeX installation) with customizable template and a resizable
 editor with syntax highlighting
 Sidebar containing page previews with advanced page sorting, PDF bookmarks and layers (can
 be individually hidden/edited)
 Allows mapping different tools/colors etc. to stylus/mouse buttons
 Customizable toolbar with multiple configurations, e.g. to optimize toolbar for portrait/landscape
 Custom color palette support using the .gpl format
 Page template definitions
 Bug reporting, autosave, and auto backup tools
 Audio recording and playback alongside with handwritten notes
 Multi language support (over 20 languages supported)
 Plugins using Lua scripting

flathub:com.jiosphere.JioSphere.name: JioSphere
flathub:com.jiosphere.JioSphere.description:
Step into the future of browsing with JioSphere, the ultimate browser designed for speed, security, and simplicity. Built to complement your everyday needs, JioSphere empowers you to explore, work, and connect effortlessly on your desktop.
 MORE THAN JUST A BROWSER
 JioSphere is a feature-packed browser that adapts to your lifestyle. With its clean interface, powerful tools, and unmatched performance, it’s the perfect choice for anyone looking for a superior web experience.
 Why Choose JioSphere?
 Clean Design, Intuitive experience

flathub:io.botfather.Botfather.name: Botfather
flathub:io.botfather.Botfather.description:
With Botfather, you can create and run automation bots with ease.
 Automate your favorite Android, Browser, and Desktop applications using bot scripts.
 Find scripts online or create your own using Botfathers convenient APIs.
 Botfather already has image recognition, custom types, and much more built-in.

flathub:io.github._0_don.clippy.name: Clippy
flathub:io.github._0_don.clippy.summary: Privacy focused clipboard manager with sync and encryption
flathub:io.github._0_don.clippy.description:
Clippy is a clipboard manager built with Rust and TypeScript. It supports text, images, files,
 HTML, and RTF content with smart search, favorites, and customizable hotkeys.
 Features include:
 Multi-content support (text, HTML, RTF, images, files)
 Cloud sync via Google Drive with end-to-end encryption
 Type out clipboard content where pasting is not allowed
 Smart search for links, colors, images, and hex codes
 Customizable global hotkeys and keyboard shortcuts
 Dark and light mode with multiple language support

flathub:io.github.cgueret.Scriptorium.name: Scriptorium
flathub:io.github.cgueret.Scriptorium.description:
Scriptorium is a text editor coupled with a planning tool and a publishing tool. The objective
 is to provide writers with a simple and complete environment to plan, write and publish e-books.
 Scriptorium features are organised around three facets:
 Plan the list of scenes and story elements of the manuscript.
 Write the content of the scenes with a text focused editor.
 Publish your manuscript as an epub after previewing it.
 In addition, some general features are:
 Dark mode
 Versioning of scenes managed via Git
 Back-end using plain text YAML and HTML files

flathub:io.github.hoisasa.SharksEmpire-E.name: Sharks Empire: English
flathub:io.github.hoisasa.SharksEmpire-E.description:
Note: Only supports russian translations 
 There are three modes: Overview, Practice, and Exam. While the overview straight up shows the translation, other modes provide it after pressing a corresponding button. In the end, all mistakes are shown to provide you with a feature to reflect on your answers. To gauge the progress of learning each word, they have points assigned to them. When you are ready, complete the exam—a more strict area which punishes mistakes more. The exam's goal is to make as few mistakes as possible, but in order to not be utterly strict, it allows one mistake to pass.
 The features of an app are as follows:
 One part of speech per group
 Groups have subgroups
 10 words per subgroup
 Self-evaluation approach
 No multiple choice guessing
 Context-sensitive translations
 Supported languages: Russian

flathub:io.github.laserlicht.TowerOops.name: Tower Oops!
flathub:io.github.laserlicht.TowerOops.summary: A modern GTK4 port of the classic "Crazy Towers" puzzle game.
flathub:io.github.laserlicht.TowerOops.description:
Tower Oops! is a small tower/match puzzle game: a modern GTK4 port
 of the classic "Crazy Towers", rewritten in Rust. It features multiple
 AI difficulty levels (including Minimax with alpha-beta pruning) and a
 modular codebase for clarity and extension.
 The game supports clicking cells to select or place towers, has menu
 controls to start a new game and change who begins, and provides
 settings accessible from the UI.

flathub:io.github.vinser.burnfix.name: burnfix
flathub:io.github.vinser.burnfix.summary: Try to fix screen image retentions and burn in, look for screen defects
flathub:io.github.vinser.burnfix.description:
After turning off or moving the taskbar, you suddenly find that the logo in the corner of the screen and the search magnifier are still visible on your monitor or TV screen, although not as brightly.
 This is called "image retention" or "burn-in".
 Burnfix can attempt to get rid of this effect on your LCD, LED or plasma screen by showing a special moving pattern for a perioid of time.
 Moreover, burnfix can show full-screen images of various colors to help you identify defects in the display matrix.

flathub:io.tether.QVAC.Workbench.name: QV.AC
flathub:io.tether.QVAC.Workbench.summary: Desktop app for local AI models, workflows, and experimentation
flathub:io.tether.QVAC.Workbench.description:
QV.AC is an Electron desktop app for running local AI models, managing projects and threads,
 and experimenting with retrieval, transcription, and MCP integrations on-device.
 The app includes local document conversion support, persistent local storage, and peer-to-peer
 sync features for moving work across devices.

flathub:it.mijorus.collector.name: Collector

flathub:it.mijorus.collector.description: Collector is a simple utility that allows you to drag multiple files into a single window and drop them anywhere! It can also download images automatically when pasting urls.

flathub:net.sourceforge.mcomix.name: MComix
flathub:net.sourceforge.mcomix.summary: Comic and general purpose image viewer
flathub:net.sourceforge.mcomix.description:
MComix is a user-friendly, customizable image viewer. It is specifically designed to handle
 comic books (both Western comics and manga) and supports a variety of container formats (including
 CBR, CBZ, CB7, CBT, LHA and PDF).
 MComix is a fork of the Comix project, and aims to add bug fixes and stability improvements
 after Comix development came to a halt in late 2009.

flathub:org.cataclysmbn.CataclysmBN.name: Cataclysm BN
flathub:org.cataclysmbn.CataclysmBN.description:
Cataclysm: Bright Nights is a roguelike with sci-fi elements set in a post-apocalyptic world.
 While some have described it as a "zombie game", there is far more to Cataclysm than that. Struggle to survive in a harsh, persistent, procedurally generated world. Scavenge the remnants of a dead civilization for food, equipment, or, if you are lucky, a vehicle with a full tank of gas to get you the hell out of there.
 Fight to defeat or escape from a wide variety of powerful monstrosities, from zombies to giant insects to killer robots and things far stranger and deadlier, and against the others like yourself, who want what you have.
 Find a way to stop the Cataclysm ... or become one of its strongest monsters.
 Cataclysm: Bright Nights is a fork of Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead. The two forks diverged a few years ago over disagreements regarding the right direction for development to take, with BN choosing less emphasis on realism. Overall, BN has taken a more Sci-Fi approach, with robots and bionics still prominent in society.

flathub:org.cutwire.Prism.name: Prism
flathub:org.cutwire.Prism.description:
Prism is a beginner-friendly live visuals app for triggering clips and compositing
 overlays in real time. Made for school events, small concerts, and sports, it combines
 instant clip triggering with hands-on control of the program output.
 Instead of a fixed grid, clips live on a node-based canvas with groups, transform
 contexts, and audio routing — click to trigger, with no scenes or playlists to manage.
 Features:
 Node-based clip canvas with groups, transform contexts, audio routing, and a VJ hotkey grid
 Many source types: video, images, slideshows, webcams, screen and window capture, GLSL shaders, HTML/QML overlays, text, Lua scripts, NDI inputs, and phone cameras over WebRTC
 Live A/B deck mixing with a crossfader and per-deck speed control
 Per-clip trim, crop, transform, and composited text/image overlay editing
 Audio spectrum analysis driving shader inputs, plus master audio routing
 Reusable asset library with drag-and-drop onto the clip canvas
 Program output hub: mirror windows, optional NDI output, virtual-camera output, and program video/audio recording
 Panic controls: instant blackout, freeze-frame hold, and stay-tuned overlay
 OBS WebSocket integration and network remote control
 Session save and load with autosave and smart asset relinking

flathub:org.gottcode.Tetzle.name: Tetzle
flathub:org.gottcode.Tetzle.description: Tetzle is a jigsaw puzzle game that uses tetrominoes for the pieces. Any image can be imported and used to create puzzles with a wide range of sizes. Games are saved automatically, and you can select between currently in progress games.

fedora-packages:american-fuzzy-lop/ameri.description: American fuzzy lop uses a novel type of compile-time instrumentation and genetic algorithms to automatically discover clean, interesting test cases that trigger new internal states in the targeted binary. This substantially improves the functional coverage for the fuzzed code. The compact synthesized corpuses produced by the tool are also useful for seeding other, more labor- or resource-intensive testing regimes down the road. Compared to other instrumented fuzzers, afl-fuzz is designed to be practical: it has a modest performance overhead, uses a variety of highly effective fuzzing strategies, requires essentially no configuration, and seamlessly handles complex, real-world use cases - say, common image parsing or file compression libraries.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-autpgrp/gap-pkg-.name: gap-pkg-autpgrp
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-autpgrp/gap-pkg-.summary: Compute the automorphism group of a p-Group in GAP
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-autpgrp/gap-pkg-.description: The AutPGrp package introduces a new function to compute the automorphism group of a finite p-group. The underlying algorithm is a refinement of the methods described in O'Brien (1995). In particular, this implementation is more efficient in both time and space requirements and hence has a wider range of applications than the ANUPQ method. Our package is written in GAP code and it makes use of a number of methods from the GAP library such as the MeatAxe for matrix groups and permutation group functions. We have compared our method to the others available in GAP. Our package usually out-performs all but the method designed for finite abelian groups. We note that our method uses the small groups library in certain cases and hence our algorithm is more effective if the small groups library is installed.

fedora-packages:geany-plugins/geany-plug.name: geany-plugins-geanyprj

fedora-packages:geany-plugins/geany-plug.description: Geanyprj provides an alternate project management approach to Geany's built-in project facility. The idea is to be less a "session manager" as the built-in project management does: It allows/requires you to manually open and close project and allows you to store project files in different locations from project sources. Geanyprj takes a different approach: It never saves session information, so that project files can be stored in version control without constant noise from changes of opened files or cursor position. You also will never have to open/close projects manually. If a *.geanyprj file is found somewhere up in path it will be opened automatically.

fedora-packages:geany-plugins/geany-plug.description: WebHelper is a plugin for Geany that provides some web development facilities, such as a web page preview and some debugging tools (web inspector). Prominent features: * A basic web view, allowing to display any web page (using WebKit) * Possible automatic reloading of the web view upon document saving * A web inspector/debugging tool for the web view's content (including a JavaScript console, a viewer and editor of processed HTML and CSS, a network usage analysis tool and many more, thanks to WebKit).

fedora-packages:ghc-relude/ghc-relude.name: ghc-relude
fedora-packages:ghc-relude/ghc-relude.summary: Safe, performant, user-friendly and lightweight Haskell Standard Library
fedora-packages:ghc-relude/ghc-relude.description: 'relude' is an alternative prelude library. If you find the default 'Prelude' unsatisfying, despite its advantages, consider using 'relude' instead. == Relude goals and design principles * Productivity: You can be more productive with a "non-standard" standard library, and 'relude' helps you with writing safer and more efficient code faster. * Total programming: Usage of partial functions can lead to unexpected bugs and runtime exceptions in pure code. The types of partial functions lie about their behavior. And even if it is not always possible to rely only on total functions, 'relude' strives to encourage best-practices and reduce the chances of introducing a bug. * Type-safety: We use the "make invalid states unrepresentable" motto as one of our guiding principles. If it is possible, we express this concept through the types. Example: ' whenNotNull :: Applicative f => [a] -> (NonEmpty a -> f ()) -> f () ' * Performance: We prefer 'Text' over 'String', use space-leaks-free functions (e.g. our custom performant 'sum' and 'product'), introduce 'INLINE' and 'SPECIALIZE' pragmas where appropriate, and make efficient container types (e.g. 'Map', 'HashMap', 'Set') more accessible. * Minimalism (low number of dependencies): We do not force users of 'relude' to stick to any specific lens or text formatting or logging library. Where possible, 'relude' depends only on boot libraries. * Convenience: Despite minimalism, we want to bring commonly used types and functions into scope, and make available functions easier to use. * Excellent documentation: 1. Tutorial 2. Migration guide from 'Prelude' 3. Haddock for every function with examples tested by doctest 4. Documentation regarding internal module structure 5. 'relude'-specific HLint rules * User-friendliness: Anyone should be able to quickly migrate to 'relude'. Only some basic familiarity with the common libraries like 'text' and 'containers' should be enough (but not necessary). * Exploration: We have space to experiment with new ideas and proposals without introducing breaking changes. 'relude' uses the approach with 'Extra.*' modules which are not exported by default. The chosen approach makes it quite easy for us to provide new functionality without breaking anything and let the users decide to use it or not.

fedora-packages:golang-github-theupdatef.name: golang-github-theupdateframework-notary
fedora-packages:golang-github-theupdatef.summary: Project that allows anyone to have trust over arbitrary collections of data
fedora-packages:golang-github-theupdatef.description: The Notary project comprises a server and a client for running and interacting with trusted collections. See the service architecture documentation for more information. Notary aims to make the internet more secure by making it easy for people to publish and verify content. We often rely on TLS to secure our communications with a web server, which is inherently flawed, as any compromise of the server enables malicious content to be substituted for the legitimate content. With Notary, publishers can sign their content offline using keys kept highly secure. Once the publisher is ready to make the content available, they can push their signed trusted collection to a Notary Server. Consumers, having acquired the publisher's public key through a secure channel, can then communicate with any Notary server or (insecure) mirror, relying only on the publisher's key to determine the validity and integrity of the received content.

fedora-packages:golang-github-vishvanand.name: golang-github-vishvananda-netlink-devel
fedora-packages:golang-github-vishvanand.description: The netlink package provides a simple netlink library for Go. Netlink is the interface a user-space program in linux uses to communicate with the kernel. It can be used to add and remove interfaces, set ip addresses and routes, and configure ipsec. Netlink communication requires elevated privileges, so in most cases this code needs to be run as root. Since low-level netlink messages are inscrutable at best, the library attempts to provide an api that is loosely modeled on the CLI provided by iproute2. Actions like ip link add will be accomplished via a similarly named function like AddLink(). This library began its life as a fork of the netlink functionality in docker/libcontainer but was heavily rewritten to improve testability, performance, and to add new functionality like ipsec xfrm handling. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/vishvananda/netlink

firefox-addons:2948416.name: Private Tab History
firefox-addons:2948416.summary: Stores browsing history for private/incognito tabs.
firefox-addons:2948416.description:
Private Tab History is a browser extension designed to enhance your private browsing experience by providing a convenient way to view and manage your browsing history within private or incognito tabs. This tool is particularly useful for users who need to keep track of the websites they visit during private sessions without compromising the core privacy features of incognito mode.
Key Features
 Browsing History Storage: The extension stores a record of all the pages you visit while in private or incognito mode. This allows you to easily revisit previously accessed sites without having to rely on bookmarks or manual note-taking.
 Easy Access: With a simple click, you can access your browsing history from a dedicated interface within the extension. This makes it quick and convenient to find and revisit important pages.
 One-Click History Clearance: The extension offers a convenient one-click feature to clear your stored browsing history instantly. This ensures that you can maintain a clean slate and manage your privacy with ease.
 Non-Intrusive: The extension does not interfere with any other incognito features such as cookie management, password storage, or tracking prevention. Your private browsing session remains secure and private, ensuring that your browsing data is not stored on your device or shared with third parties.
 User-Friendly Interface: The interface is designed to be intuitive and easy to navigate, allowing users to quickly find and manage their browsing history with minimal effort.
 Customizable Settings: Users can customize the extension's settings to suit their preferences, such as setting the duration for which the browsing history is stored or choosing which types of data to include in the history.
 Cross-Device Compatibility: The extension is compatible with desktop and mobile, ensuring a seamless experience across different devices.
Use Cases
 Research and Work: Professionals who need to keep track of multiple sources and references during research projects can benefit from this extension without compromising their privacy.
 Online Shopping: Users who frequently shop online in incognito mode to avoid targeted ads can easily revisit product pages and compare prices without leaving a trace on their main browsing history.
 Personal Use: Individuals who value their privacy but still need to keep track of their browsing activities can use this extension to maintain a record of their private sessions.
 Privacy Assurance 
 Private Tab History is designed with privacy in mind. It ensures that your browsing history is stored securely and is only accessible through the extension's interface. The extension does not collect or share any personal data with third parties, maintaining a safe and private browsing experience.

firefox-addons:3061610.summary:
Suíte completa de utilitários rápidos para Desenvolvedores, Designers, Web Designers, Especialistas em SEO e Marketing.
Complete suite of fast utilities for Developers, Designers, Web Designers, SEO and Marketing Experts.
firefox-addons:3061610.description:
World4.dev is a comprehensive, free online platform that offers a suite of over 100 utility tools designed to streamline the daily workflows of tech and digital professionals. Built with high-performance technologies like React and Vite, the platform's standout feature is that its tools execute locally in your browser. This ensures lightning-fast results and total data privacy, as your code, tokens, and files never have to be uploaded to an external server.
Here is a breakdown of the most interesting and useful tools available on the site, categorized by your target professions:
Developers require reliable tools for formatting data, testing APIs, and debugging code. World4.dev provides a powerful "Swiss Army knife" for these tasks:
 JSON Formatter & Validator: Instantly format, beautify, and validate JSON strings to ensure your data structures are error-free and highly readable.
 HTTP Request Tester: A built-in HTTP client that allows you to test REST APIs directly from your browser. You can send GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests while analyzing response headers and bodies.
 JWT Decoder: Easily decode JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to inspect their payload/header data and quickly verify claims and expiration dates.
 Regex Tester: A real-time environment to test and debug complex Regular Expressions.
 Cron Generator: Generate and translate server Cron expressions into plain, human-readable schedules so you never make mistakes with server job timings.
 Hash Generator & File Checksum: Securely generate cryptographic hashes (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512) or verify file integrity entirely client-side.
Visual and web professionals can leverage tools that speed up asset preparation and design-to-development handoffs:
 Image Color Picker: Easily extract precise HEX, RGB, and HSL color codes from any uploaded image. This is highly useful for building UI color palettes directly from reference materials.
 SVG & Image Converters: Quickly convert between various graphic and file formats, including specialized tools for scalable vector graphics (SVG).
 QR Code Generator: Create customizable QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi networks, and contact cards, which can be downloaded in high-quality SVG or PNG formats for web or print design.
 Markdown Preview: An excellent tool for web designers writing documentation, featuring live rendering with GitHub Flavored Markdown and syntax highlighting.
The platform includes a dedicated "SEO Suite" that is incredibly valuable for digital marketers looking to optimize search engine visibility and social media presence:
 SEO Metadata Generator: Automatically generate highly optimized HTML meta tags. This includes creating OpenGraph and Twitter cards to ensure your web pages look perfect when shared across social media networks.
 SERP Inspector & Cache Metadata: Inspect live search metadata, verify Google cache discrepancies, and understand exactly why a website's search snippet might be appearing outdated in search results.
 SEO Rank Tracker (Keyword Tracker): A client-side solution to monitor keyword performance and optimize your ongoing content strategy.
 Sitemap Generator & Content Quality Dashboard: Quickly generate XML sitemaps to help search engines crawl your site, and analyze your content structure to ensure it meets modern SEO standards.
Because World4.dev is 100% free, requires no complex setup, and processes everything securely on your own computer, it is a highly recommended site to bookmark. It eliminates the need to jump between dozens of different websites, offering developers, designers, and marketers a unified, privacy-first workspace.

bluejetty:00017335:ios.description:
Note: Saving animations requires a one time in-app purchase. Before purchase, all photos taken are saved as static JPEG photos.
Twinkly brings the magic of Christmas to life. It is a totally new way to celebrate Christmas through photos. Twinkly transforms your photos into a work of art. 
While taking a photo with Twinkly, you can watch one of its animated effects live in the camera preview. It is a seamless Augmented Reality experience. Choose from 18 wonderfully designed effects to add a magical touch to your Christmas season. The animated effects range from Sparkling Twinkles, Shiny Stars, Swinging Bells and Swinging Santa Claus Ornaments to the more themed effects such as Rainbow Shine, Space Glow, Pink Sparkles, Fairy Blue and many others. Try Twinkly on your Christmas lights or decorations and watch what happens!
Features:
- Create amazingly looking twinkling photos with one tap. 
- Watch the magic as it happens live in the camera preview. Your Christmas tree has never looked so alive! 
- Automatically saves animations (requires a one time in-app purchase. Before purchase, all photos taken are saved as static JPEG photos)
- 18 animated effects to choose from: Bright Twinkles, Pink Glow, Star Santa, Rainbow Tree, Glittering Reindeers, Funky Sparkles, Beating Hearts, and a lot more...
- Emojis! Use emojis to make new effects. From emoji stars to emoji hearts and kisses
- Pick the animation for the emoji effect by tapping on one of the animation types that appear when you use it
- This means that you have hundreds and hundreds of emoji effects to try out! Yay! :-)
- Combine multiple emojis in one effect. This holiday season, make yourself an emoji Christmas tree!
- Add text and music to your photo to make the most charming personalized Christmas Card you've ever sent!
Bring the magic of Christmas to life and share it with Twinkly.

bluejetty:00073559:ios.description:
Introducing our Printer app - the perfect solution for anyone who needs to print documents on the go. Our app offers a range of features that allow you to easily print your documents from various sources, making it the ultimate printing tool for iOS users.
Our app lets you print documents directly from your photo gallery, iCloud files, and even full-size web pages. You can also print contact information on A4 paper, making it easier to keep your contacts organized. What's more, our app supports a wide range of document formats, including PDF, XSL, DOCX, and more, so you can print virtually any document you need.
All files that are printed are stored locally in our secure storage, ensuring your documents are safe and accessible at all times. You can filter your documents and see them in either grid or list mode, making it easy to find the document you need.
In addition to these features, our app also lets you create text documents with our smart text editor tools, and print them using AirPrint. We also offer a big photo editor module with rich photo editor tools, allowing you to import photos, edit them, and print them with ease.
With our Printer app, you'll have everything you need to print your documents quickly and easily, no matter where you are. So why wait? Download our app today and start printing your documents hassle-free!

Watch the terminator move across the globe as hours and days pass. Explore sunrise, sunset, a
bluejetty:00024696:ios.description:
Day & Night Map shows you exactly which parts of Earth are in daylight and which are in darkness — right now, or at any date and time you choose.
Watch the terminator move across the globe as hours and days pass. Explore sunrise, sunset, and twilight around the world. Perfect for travellers, astronomers, photographers, teachers, and anyone curious about time on our planet.
KEY FEATURES
• Live world map of day and night
• Move through time with intuitive date and time controls
• Jump back to the current moment with one tap
• Pinch to zoom and pan across the map
• Full-screen map view
• Home Screen widgets in multiple sizes (including Extra Large on iPad)
• Configurable widgets: sun, moon, moon phase, twilight, icon size, and more
• Show sun and moon positions on the map
• Display the current moon phase
• Twilight zones: smooth shading or separate civil, nautical, and astronomical twilight
• Equator and tropics lines
• Show your current location on the map (optional)
• Display time in local time or UTC
• Light, dark, or system appearance
• Share a map image by email, message, and more
• Create animations over a chosen time range
• Export animations as animated GIFs
ANIMATIONS
Pick a start and end date, set the step interval and speed, and watch the day/night line move over hours or days. Play the animation in the app or create an animated GIF to share.
HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Add the widget to your Home Screen and keep the current day/night map at a glance. Customize what is shown and how it looks directly when adding or editing the widget.

FEATURES OF WHEELIE KING 3D : 
========================================================
Realistic and immersive game graphic & sound. 
Unlock various challenges and tracks. 
Get coins to unlock more tracks & off road challenges. 
Try your hand at riding low cc scooters and turbo bikes

bluejetty:00027634:ios.description:
Afin d’accompagner la stratégie d’inclusion financière, de combattre l’utilisation massive du cash au niveau national et d’accompagner la population dans la transition d’une solution cash vers une nouvelle solution innovante, CLICK offre à ses utilisateurs une solution Mobile paiement (Wallet) qui en plus de garantir la sécurité, vise à faciliter l’accès aux services financiers de base aux populations non bancarisées, digitaliser le quotidien, stimuler la croissance et l’entreprenariat, créer de l’emploi, développer le e-commerce, généraliser le paiement électronique et accélérer l’inclusion financière.
La solution Click met à la disposition de sa clientèle une gamme de services financiers et transactionnels sans avoir de compte bancaire.
Elle met également à la disposition de sa clientèle une application mobile, une carte de paiement internationale Mastercard, un service USSD, des TPE et un portail web afin de
digitaliser l’activité de ses utilisateurs.

bluejetty:00031787:ios.description:

All content and functionality is available at no cost.
You will need to be online to download the DCS materials.
AGES DCS is the evolution of eMatins, previously produced and offered by Fr. Seraphim Dedes. You can print PDF booklets of services as well as individual scores directly from your iPad.
This public version of AGES DCS is offered for free and as is. The translations, rubrics, Greek and English texts are for the purposes of worship only and are subject to change without notice and should not be construed as a commitment by the authors, translators, developers, and personnel associated with their publication. Every effort has been made to make the materials as complete and as accurate as possible, but no warranty of fitness is implied.
For information about other versions of AGES DCS and the inclusion of different texts and music, contact AGES Initiatives.
AGES Initiatives envisions all Orthodox Christian churches having the texts, music and trained singers needed to maintain the fullest possible liturgical life.

bluejetty:00053614:android.summary: Cwallet is a powerful, secure wallet and multi-chain crypto wallet designed for the next generation of Web3 users. Combining both centralized and decentralized features, Cwallet empowers over 50 million users with a streamlined, feature-ric
bluejetty:00053614:android.description:
Cwallet is a powerful, secure wallet and multi-chain crypto wallet designed for the next generation of Web3 users. Combining both centralized and decentralized features, Cwallet empowers over 50 million users with a streamlined, feature-rich experience for managing, paying, swapping and earning from their cryptocurrencies — all in one place.
---
Why Cwallet?
- Support for 1000+ tokens and 60+ chains (Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), TRON (TRX), Dogecoin (DOGE), SATS, Solana (SOL), Cardano (ADA), Sui (SUI), Stellar (XLM), XRP and more
- Swap and cryptocurrency financial services powered by smart contracts
- Native Telegram experience (Wallet Bot & Wallet Mini App) for seamless community engagement and crypto utilities
- All-in-one crypto finance tools: Cozy Card (Virtual Card), Bulk Payments, Gift Cards (Amazon Card), Tip Box, Mobile Airtime Recharge
- Passkey login, 2FA protection, HSM-grade security, and cold wallet storage for maximum protection. Cwallet, your trusted Web3 wallet since 2019
---
Core Features
Multi-Chain Crypto Wallet
 Easily manage Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), TRON (TRX), Dogecoin (DOGE), SATS, Solana (SOL), Cardano (ADA), Sui (SUI), Stellar (XLM), XRP and 1000+ digital assets across 60+ chains. Track your portfolio in real time with customizable views in this decentralized wallet and NFT wallet.
Crypto Swap & Zero-Fee Exchange
Execute cross-chain token swaps with optimized routes for the best prices and minimal slippage. Enjoy zero-fee exchanges on select trading pairs. empowered by Cwallet's crypto swap engine and token bridge integration
Grow Your Crypto Assets on principal-protected products
Grow your assets effortlessly with flexible and fixed growing options. Benefit from hourly interest calculations and no lock-in periods--a simple way to grow crypto with low risk
Crypto Borrowing Solutions
Borrow USDT, BTC, or ETH by collateralizing your crypto assets. Transactions are executed via smart contracts to ensure transparency and security for asset-backed lending
Telegram Wallet & Community Tools
Use Cwallet seamlessly within Telegram to send and receive crypto instantly — no wallet addresses needed. Automate community engagement with powerful tools:
- Launch automated airdrop campaigns
- Enable tipping, giveaways, and loyalty rewards in chats and groups
- Set up paid subscriptions and exclusive crypto-access memberships
- Verify users' asset holdings to unlock premium roles
- Manage whitelists, automate prize distributions, and deploy token drops Whether you're building a Web3 project, NFT community, or DAO, Cwallet powers smarter, faster crypto management — all integrated within Telegram as a leading social wallet
Crypto Payments & Virtual Cards
Shop globally with crypto using the Cozy Card (Virtual Card), compatible with Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal. Send mobile airtime recharges, make bulk payroll payments, and issue branded gift cards with ease using your secure crypto wallet.
Top-Tier Security
- Passkey login and two-factor authentication (2FA)
- Cold wallet storage for the majority of user funds
- HSM-grade private key protection
- Regular third-party audits to ensure system integrity
- Designed with enhanced privacy considerations, Cwallet offers secure crypto transactions and integration-ready architecture for future zk-SNARK and ZK-Rollup technologies.
Built for Everyone
From crypto beginners to DeFi veterans, Cwallet serves individuals, creators, community managers, startups, and enterprises.
---
Join the Web3 Future
From crypto beginners to DeFi veterans, Cwallet serves individuals, creators, community managers, startups, and enterprises.
It also offers a built-in WalletConnect support to explore decentralized applications seamlessly.
Explore more: https://cwallet.com

bluejetty:00094984:ios.description:
Jump into a thrilling rhythm-packed arcade adventure and help save your fellow cats in Cat Dash! From the creators of Duet Cats, this game takes platformer action to new levels with catchy cat-themed pop music. If you’re a fan of rhythm games, arcade fun, or platformers, Cat Dash offers a dynamic, exciting experience like never before.
What’s Inside:
Epic Cat Story & Music Sync: Dash, jump, and bounce through colorful levels as you embark on a mission to rescue your cat friends! Every move is synced to playful, cat-voiced covers of popular songs, creating an immersive blend of rhythm and action that keeps the excitement going.
Exciting Gameplay:
Cat Actions Galore: Jump, bounce, and fly through diverse levels. Enjoy intuitive controls that make each movement feel smooth and precise, perfectly timed with the music.
Challenging Obstacles & Checkpoints: Tackle increasing difficulties with a variety of obstacles and strategically placed checkpoints. Adapt to different cat forms, each with unique abilities, keeping you on your toes as new actions unfold. But don’t worry—we’ve got a Practice Mode to sharpen your skills!
Explore the Cat Multiverse: Travel through a vast cat world map with multiple themes and adventures! From bustling cat cities to mystical forests, each level presents a unique environment filled with surprises and challenges.
Art & Customization:
Immerse yourself in adorable 2D cartoon visuals featuring the iconic Duet Cats. A feast for the eyes, Cat Dash brings colorful, lively art to every level.
Customize Your Cats: Personalize your cats with skins, outfits, and accessories. Make your cat uniquely yours as you dash through the adventure!
Catchy Cat-Voiced Hits: Experience cat-sung remixes of popular songs with playful twists. Surprising new elements keep the rhythm fresh, ensuring every beat is more exciting than the last!
Are you ready to leap into action, groove to the beat, and save the cats? Download Cat Dash now and conquer the leaderboard in this cute, colorful, and rhythmic adventure! Let’s dash to the Purrfect Rhythm!

bluejetty:00015592:ios.summary: Real piano lessons. Real results. Simply learn to play piano with fun, step-by-step lessons, world-class teachers, and the songs you love — even if you’ve never played a note before. Works with any piano or keyboard – start with a free tria
bluejetty:00015592:ios.description:
Real piano lessons. Real results. Simply learn to play piano with fun, step-by-step lessons, world-class teachers, and the songs you love — even if you’ve never played a note before. Works with any piano or keyboard – start with a free trial.
Playground Sessions was co-created by music legend Quincy Jones (28× GRAMMY winner). Quincy helped shape our curriculum and how our piano app arranges songs to ensure every lesson is musically authentic, fun to play, and designed to build real, lasting piano skills. “We designed Playground so even if you’ve never played a single note before, you’d be hooked and having fun from day one — while learning real musical skills that stay with you for life.” – Quincy Jones
Perfect for beginners, adults returning to piano, homeschooling families, and musicians learning piano as a new instrument — Playground combines real-time feedback, step-by-step video lessons, and hit songs to make learning piano easy, effective, and fun.
Trusted by real users — even Jimmy Fallon.
Late-night host Jimmy Fallon picked up Playground in his free time to learn piano:
“I love it, I really love it! It makes me feel like I’m learning!”
Years later, Playground is still Jimmy’s favorite piano app.
LEARN BY PLAYING SONGS YOU LOVE
It’s easier — and more fun — to learn piano when you’re playing music you already enjoy. Choose from over 2,000 songs across every genre, from Disney to Bach, Queen, Adele, Sinatra, Coldplay, Elton John, Taylor Swift, and more — with new songs added regularly. Each song includes multiple arrangements (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced), so you can play no matter where you are on your journey.
STEP-BY-STEP VIDEO LESSONS FROM WORLD-CLASS TEACHERS
Learn piano from expert musicians who guide you with easy to easy-to-follow video lessons. Our teachers are fun, supportive, and make it easy to get started. Start with Bootcamp, then progress through guided Courses designed to build real skills — from reading notes and playing with both hands to understanding chords and beyond.
TECHNOLOGY THAT ACCELERATES YOUR LEARNING
-Real-time feedback: See which notes you play correctly — and where to improve.
-Accuracy scores & tips: Stay motivated and improve every session.
-Loop and isolate tricky sections to master them with ease.
-Play with the band & orchestra: Studio-quality backing tracks make practice feel like performance.
-Smart sessions adapt to you: Our proprietary system evolves with your progress using data from other learners.
MOTIVATION MEETS GAMIFICATION
-Track progress session by session
-Earn points and unlock rewards
-Level up and earn achievements as you play
BUILT FOR ALL LEVELS AND LIFESTYLES
-From total beginners to advanced players
-Learn at your own pace, anytime
-Great for kids, adults, families, and aspiring musicians
WHAT’S INCLUDED
-Interactive piano lessons and video tutorials with real-time feedback
-Bootcamp for Rookie, Intermediate & Advanced levels
-Specialized Courses and piano lessons to grow your skills in style, technique, and more
-Hundreds of guided video lessons
-Unlimited access to 2,000+ songs
-Learn anytime — on your schedule
HOW IT WORKS
-Create an account
-Choose mic-based feedback or connect with a cable
-Place your iPad/iPhone on your acoustic or digital piano or keyboard
-Start learning through Bootcamp, Songs, and Courses
-Get instant feedback as you play, so you can improve faster and build real piano skills
-Explore a full library of popular songs and guided courses designed to help you sound like a pro
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY OF PIANO LEARNERS
facebook.com/groups/playgroundsessions
instagram.com/playgroundsessions
PLAY SONGS. LEARN REAL PIANO.
With structured lessons, real-time feedback, and the songs you love, Playground helps you make lasting progress — simply.
Questions? support@playgroundsessions.com
Terms: playgroundsessions.com/about/terms-and-conditions
Privacy: playgroundsessions.com/about/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00033929:ios.description:
The best and most addictive Traffic Jam Cars Puzzle 2024! Unique and exciting traffic puzzle match 3 game! Use your intelligence to beat the craziest challenge ever. Enjoy tons of beautiful characters and wonderful graphics!
Beat the traffic jam and help the city by playing match 3 puzzles during rush hour. The unique car puzzle games feature vivid cartoon designs with super smooth gameplay and extraordinary sound effects! Come explore the traffic jam game and unlock new stories, areas, tournaments, and tons of amazing features.
On the addictive traffic journey, you will be challenged with parking jam puzzles from newbie to super expert mode. Police cars are chasing the thieves and fire trucks are rushing to emergency rescue missions. Watch out for obstacles on the road! Be ready for more than 4000 levels! Compete with your friends, and enter the top of the leaderboards!
Explore the new areas and seasonal events with Treasure Keys, Easter Eggs, Christmas Santa, and much more. New and exciting adventures are waiting for you to discover in traffic jams! Rainbow buses appear on the road! Police cars are the best during rush hour. Collect special cars and boosters to blow all the car jam stages and watch the magic happen!
How to play the Traffic Jam Game: Match 3 cars in a row to beat the challenge and start your car puzzle journey. If you want a game that is very challenging and fun, this traffic puzzle match 3 game is for you!
Traffic Jam Cars Puzzle features:
UNIQUE TRAFFIC GAMEPLAY
You are a hero who supports police, fire trucks, helicopters, ambulances, and traffic puzzle trains to get to their destinations during rush hour. Traffic jam 3d and car packing puzzles are tough to handle! Only you can help the citizens to solve the rush hour traffic jams!
CUTE AND CARTOONISH INTERFACE
The world of imagination is right in front of you! Feel the sounds, shapes, outstanding graphics, and beautiful colors while enjoying the fun of solving the puzzle game car.
FANTASTIC CHARACTERS
The traffic puzzle games have the best companions! Play traffic puzzles and meet interesting characters: Nurse, policeman, pilot, and so much more!
WONDERFUL STORYLINES
Assist the ambulance, play car packing and rescue the little dog. Unlock more and more situations to progress the story of the car puzzle traffic games.
CREATE A GREEN CITY
Plant more grass and enjoy the beauty of the green city. Complete the car packing mini-game to get all the cars out of the parking lot.
AMAZING SEASONAL EVENTS
Exclusive events and a lot of awesome features for all traffic run seasons will make you feel excited: Lucky Cards, Mini game, Racing Challenge, Adventure, Brain Out, Car Jam, Rush hour 3d, and much more!
PLAY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS
There is so much joy when you play traffic puzzle match 3 and car puzzle game with your friends! Join your family and double the fun!
This Traffic Jam game is so addictive, mind-blowing, and fun! If you like casual traffic puzzle games, puzzle game car traffic games, traffic jam 3d, traffic puzzle 2024, you will love Traffic Jam Cars Puzzle!
Traffic Jam Cars Puzzle 2024 is free and requires no Wi-Fi or internet connection! You can play the car traffic jam game offline, wherever you go, and whenever you have free time! All the levels of the car puzzle game can be completed for free though some in-game items can be purchased for real money. You can enjoy solving the traffic puzzle match 3 game by clearing the traffic jam or completing the rescue quest in rush hour with your family. You will have so much fun winning these car jam traffic games!
Will you be the traffic puzzle genius to rescue the traffic jams? Beat the traffic, clear the traffic jam, whatever you call it, let's be the Traffic King!

bluejetty:00132404:ios.summary:

But... h
bluejetty:00132404:ios.description:
Sure, it's "just" a dictionary app...
As a reader, you can use it like you would normally use a dictionary, to look up specialized or unusual words, and you'll get what you expect: a concise definition to get you back to reading.
But... here's the great part. As a writer, you can also use it to look up words you already know. Or think you do! And you should, because this is Mr. Webster's actual and original dictionary. The real deal.
The magic is in the definitions for commonplace words. Just take a look at the screenshots! This is good stuff. It will delight and amuse. It may even kindle your imagination.
The author's personality shines through in colorful prose that's packed with classic examples of usage.
And! 
Remember paging through a big hardcover dictionary looking for a word only to get sidetracked exploring other words you'd stumble across? 
Oh-hoh! If I may bend your ear a moment longer...
The usual way to do search is to show only results that match what has been typed so far. And normally that's perfect: don't show you anything you don't need to see, right? 
But if I did it that way, how can you get sidetracked?
So I went a different direction. All of the words are in a giant list. You can scroll it or jump to a letter. And as you search, it scrolls to the first match. It's fast and you can find what you want quickly, but it still leaves room for serendipity.
Get it and get writing!

bluejetty:00134266:ios.description:
Unlimited learning adventures, all together in one app! Explore 10 award-winning apps and educational learning games where children 3-12 yrs+ independently can play and develop skills in math, literacy, and more with premium content from top brands!
**UNLOCK 10 AWARD-WINNING LEARNING APPS**
**DEVELOPED BY PEDAGOGY EXPERTS**
**TEACHER-APPROVED**
**100%-SAFE AND AD-FREE**
**TRUSTED BY MILLIONS OF PARENTS & TEACHERS WORLDWIDE**
**PREMIUM CONTENT FROM TOP BRANDS**
LEARN TO READ 
Practice literacy and phonics training with an interactive learn-to-read game that will assist your child in alphabet learning and developing reading skills. Enter the world of interactive play with letters and their sounds with Kahoot! Poio's Learn to Read. Suitable for ages 3-8 yrs
BUILD A SOLID MATH FOUNDATION
Intuitive learning games to introduce your kids to math and build a solid understanding on numbers, additions, subtractions, and algebra with Kahoot! Numbers, Big Numbers, and Algebra by DragonBox. Suitable for ages 4-8 yrs
MAKE ADVANCED MATH EASY
Multiplication games to master times table with ease, immersive math games for algebra practice, and master the world of shapes while gaining confidence in geometry. Build a greater understanding of advanced topics and concepts in math with Kahoot! Multiplication, Geometry, and Algebra 2 by DragonBox. Suitable for ages 8 yrs+
PRACTICE SOCIAL-EMOTIONAL LEARNING SKILLS 
Explore quiz games for kids on a wide range of topics such as science games for kids or practice social-emotional learning with Kahoot! Quiz games. Children will also strengthen their knowledge in key areas such as literacy, math, sports, culture, communication, and even how to protect the earth! Suitable for ages 3 yrs+
BUILD ESSENTIAL LIFE SKILLS THROUGH THE GAME OF CHESS
Learn important life skills, such as winning and losing, memorization, focus improvement, reasoning, and strategic thinking with Kahoot! Chess by DragonBox. Suitable for ages 5 yrs+
GAMES THAT ADAPT TO YOUR CHILD
Spark your kid’s curiosity, imagination, and exploration. With different complexity levels, your children can teach themselves by freely exploring and playing their way.
AWARD-WINNING LEARNING APPS
The collection of learning apps has won several international awards and is today used and trusted by parents and teachers all over the world.
DEVELOPED BY EXPERTS
Crafted by a team of educational experts, dedicated teachers, game developers, and designers with a passion for creating innovative and engaging game-based learning tools. Each game is designed after essential learning principles to effectively teach kids in a playful way. 
TRACK DAILY PROGRESS & ACHIEVEMENTS
Track daily progress and follow your child's learning journey with reports, or easily step in to follow your child's progress by asking questions about the game. You’ll be surprised how fast they grow in knowledge! 
CREATE YOUR OWN FAMILY GAME SHOW
Create your own family quiz game to have fun together and learn more about your children’s interests, or choose from millions of ready-to-play kahoots to play right away with family and friends, with Kahoot! Play & Create.
—
REVIEWS
“Kahoot! Numbers by DragonBox is the first thing you should download on a tablet if you have kids 4-8 years old” 
- Forbes, Kahoot! DragonBox Numbers
“A solid choice in the crowded space of math apps”
- Common Sense Media, Kahoot! Big Numbers by DragonBox
“Uses the full potential of digital games and storytelling to help children to learn to read” 
- Learning Technology Awards, Kahoot! Learn to Read by Poio
“The most impressive math education app I’ve seen”
- The New York Times, Kahoot! Algebra 2 by DragonBox
**REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION**
Full access to the contents and functionality of these apps requires a Kahoot!+ or Kahoot! Kids subscription. 
—
Privacy Policy: https://kahoot.com/privacy
Terms and conditions: https://kahoot.com/terms

bluejetty:00092487:ios.description:
Your Barbies, Star Wars toys, Marvel action figures, Funko Pops, LEGO sets, and vintage collectibles are not just toys—they're valuable items that you can exchange for cash! Brian's Toys is the easiest place to get money for collectibles without any work. Simply scan, get an offer instantly, ship with no upfront shipping cost and get paid securely. Make room, make money, and pass your collection on to someone who’ll love them!
Don't let your toys sit there! Sell them, convert them to instant money, and do so safely and effortlessly. Download Sell My Toys® by Brian’s Toys now onto your smart device and see your collection convert to money in your pocket.
How it Works:
1. Scan or Search- You can easily locate your toys by either using barcodes or inputting keywords.
2. Receive an Offer- You will obtain an initial cash offer for your toy collectible.
3. You will ship with no up-front shipping cost- You will use our prepaid shipping label to ship your toy collectibles safely and securely.
4. Fast Payment- We will send payment via PayPal, direct deposit or you can receive a check in the mail-- usually by the next day.
Why Collectors Find Brian's Toys a Safe App to Use: 
● Instant Cash Offers: Scan or search your toys and receive a quote in real-time, instantly.
● Fast & Secure Payments: Get paid by PayPal or a check—which is typically the next day!
● Free Prepaid Shipping: We provide shipping labels, so all you have to do is ship the collection.
● Wide Range of Toys Accepted: Barbies, Star Wars, Marvel, LEGO, Funko Pops, action figures, vintage items and more—we buy everything!
● Hassle-Free Selling: Scan, submit, ship, and get paid. That's it! No listings, no auctions, no problems. 
What Can You Sell?
1. Sell My Barbies: Classic dolls, hard-to-find toys, collector's edition.
2. Sell Star Wars Toys: Action figures, playsets, and limited pieces.
3. Sell Marvel Action Figures: Action figures from the movies, comics and cartoons! We will make an offer on heroes, villains and everything in between.
4. Selling Funko Pops & LEGO Sets: Classic collectibles and cash buy offers today.
5. Sell Vintage Toys: Treasures from decades ago.
Key Reasons Behind the Popularity of Brian’s Toys:
● Perfect for toy collectors, parents, or hobbyists wanting to declutter.
● Makes selling rare or treasured items simple and secure.
● Turn old unused toys into cash or trade credit that you can use to upgrade your collection.
● Used and trusted by thousands of sellers nationally.
Sell Now!
Don't allow your Star Wars toys, Barbie dolls, vintage finds, LEGOs, action figures, Marvel toys, or Funko Pops to go to waste. With us, you can get instant offers, pre-paid shipping, and fast, secure payments, in just a few taps. Declutter, earn, and give these toys a new life with the easiest, fastest, and most trustworthy selling interface for collectors everywhere.

bluejetty:00092992:ios.name: Timeprint: Timestamp Camera
bluejetty:00092992:ios.summary:
The work on site is done, but you still have to explain when and where each photo was taken?
Team photos scattered across phones and group chats while the supervisor chases and sorts them?
Timeprint records capture time and GPS location,
bluejetty:00092992:ios.description:
The work on site is done, but you still have to explain when and where each photo was taken?
Team photos scattered across phones and group chats while the supervisor chases and sorts them?
Timeprint records capture time and GPS location, organizes team photos by project, and shares them by web link—no app required.
【1. One photo explains the job】
Add capture time, address, GPS, project, work notes, and a company logo directly to photos and videos. A supervisor, client, or inspector can understand the job without calling the person who took the photo.
Capture time cannot be edited manually in Timeprint. When server time is available, Timeprint uses it to calibrate the timestamp. GPS coordinates come from the device location and cannot be entered manually. The address is shown from the location result, making the site record more reliable.
Whether you are recording progress, an inspection, a repair, or a handoff, the photo carries the job context.
【2. Your crew takes photos. Timeprint organizes them.】
Choose a team and project and turn on auto-sync. New Timeprint photos can sync automatically to Team Space, organized by project, with each member's photos easy to find.
The office can see what each project captured and who took each photo. No chasing photos in group chats. No downloading, renaming, and filing everything by hand.
【3. Send one link. No app required.】
Create a web link for the whole team, one project, or one member. Supervisors, clients, inspectors, and partners can view shared team photos in a browser without installing Timeprint.
Managers can use the Timeprint team web portal on a computer to manage photos, projects, and members. For reports and delivery, export personal work photos as PDF, ZIP, or KMZ and team photos as PDF or ZIP.
【4. Built for these jobs】
• Construction: daily progress, work before it is covered, site issues, and inspections
• Fiber optic and telecom: excavation, cable routes, splicing, equipment locations, and installation
• HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and repairs: fault locations, before-and-after work, and completion
• Property management: move-in and move-out checks, inspections, repairs, and maintenance
• Cleaning: arrival, before-and-after work, completion, and quality checks
• Security: patrol time, location, site conditions, and incidents
• Warehousing, logistics, and delivery: loading, cargo condition, damage, handoffs, and drop-offs
• Landscaping and roofing: maintenance, progress, weather, and site issues
• Retail and field teams: store visits, displays, client sites, and attendance
• Contractors and small businesses: branded job records organized by project
Some advanced features require a Timeprint Pro subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in Apple ID Subscriptions. Available subscription options, trial eligibility, and benefits are shown in the app.
Questions or suggestions? Email: support@timeprint.net
Official website: https://www.timeprint.net
Terms of Use: https://www.timeprint.net/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.timeprint.net/privacy

bluejetty:00088234:ios.description:
Let's Un-screw This Puzzle
You have to untwist colorful screws and put them in matching boxes. It's like a puzzle with screws! 
crew Jam Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts is a super fun game where you need to be a smart engineer. Your job? Take apart tricky structures by unscrewing the right parts in the right order. It's like a puzzle challenge!

How to play?
Remove screws one by one to open the way. 
Put same-colored screws in the same box. Fill all boxes to win! 
No hurry! Take your time and enjoy. 
Tons of levels to challenge you! 
Special helpers to give you a hand when it's tricky. 
Why you'll love it:
It's super fun and relaxing! 
The sounds are really satisfying! 
It makes your brain work hard! 
Can you solve all the puzzles? Let's find out! 
Think you're smart? Prove it! Download Screw Jam Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts now and start solving! You'll love it!

bluejetty:00122201:ios.name: TiVo
bluejetty:00122201:ios.summary: The free TiVo App for iOS is the ultimate entertainment app serving up control, discovery and a mobile place for viewing. Watch live or recorded TV via your TiVo, find shows and schedule recordings and browse content via the guide, by genre
bluejetty:00122201:ios.description:
The free TiVo App for iOS is the ultimate entertainment app serving up control, discovery and a mobile place for viewing. Watch live or recorded TV via your TiVo, find shows and schedule recordings and browse content via the guide, by genre or category, explore the cast and crew, and even see where the content is available whether it be through cable TV, Netflix, Hulu PlusTM, YouTube, Amazon Instant Video, through VOD in certain markets and more.   
“What to Watch” combines real-time viewing data, recommendations and personal preferences to create a custom dashboard presenting the exact content you want most every time you sit down to watch TV. This feature allows you to categorize by content that is on TV now, starting within the next 30 minutes, or on later tonight. Categories include: Popular on TV, Sports on Now, Powered by Thuuz, Movies on TV, Kids, Favorite Channels, Viewer’s recorded TV, Shared by Friends.
TiVo Roamio Plus, TiVo Roamio Pro, TiVo BOLT and TiVo Edge users can seamlessly stream live or recorded programming to their iOS devices. Download recordings while at home or away via WiFi or cellular to watch when you have no connection. TiVo Stream users can stream live or recorded content to iOS devices within their home network and download shows to go.    
Features of the TiVo app (some features are only available to TiVo Premiere or TiVo Roamio DVR customers):   
> Out-of-home & in-home streaming: watch your live or recorded shows remotely anywhere you have Wi-Fi   
> Out-of-home and in-home downloading: download your content to enjoy anywhere so that low bandwidth or lack of a Wi-Fi connection never slows you down   
> What to Watch Now: no matter where you are, TiVo’s second screen dashboard provides instantaneous personalized recommendations the second you pull up your TiVo app, providing you with available content options to watch now, in the next 30 minutes, or tonight.   
> Remote scheduling: browse and view the programming guide, manage recordings, check your To-Do List or set a Season Pass® any time – no matter where you are   
> Mobile Search & discovery: figure out what’s on whether you’re in the office or a hotel and enjoy the same browsing tools you have with your TiVo at home (including the TiVo editorial Collections and show, cast and actor information)   
> Use a TiVo remote control replica or our intuitive, gesture-based remote control   
> Search across TV, Netflix, Amazon Instant Video & Hulu Plus – and get integrated results on what you’re looking for   
> Explore cast and crew while watching a show   
> And much more   
Having troubles finding or connecting to your TiVo DVR? Try one or more of these steps:  
* Restart your network router by unplugging it, waiting 30 seconds, and plugging it back in   
* Restart your TiVo DVR by following the instructions in the TiVo menus under Settings & Messages > Help > Restart or Reset System > Restart the TiVo Box
