bluejetty:00148985:ios.summary: Welcome to Slimaid Princess: Family, a fun, cozy, and creative play house simulation game! This game is all about fun and imagination, where you can create characters and avatars, dress up, explore, and interact in a warm and lively home. E
bluejetty:00148985:ios.description:
Welcome to Slimaid Princess: Family, a fun, cozy, and creative play house simulation game! This game is all about fun and imagination, where you can create characters and avatars, dress up, explore, and interact in a warm and lively home. Experience the fun of an open-ended girls' game, where every little detail brings joy!
In a two-story dream house, explore different rooms, including a cozy living room, modern kitchen, warm bedrooms, a fun nursery room, a luxury bathroom, a mysterious garage, and a spacious backyard—each packed with surprises. Open the fridge to grab food, dig through the wardrobe for stylish outfits, and make every moment fun!
Love cooking? Enjoy a realistic kitchen simulation where you can use various ingredients and kitchen tools to cook! Unlock exciting recipes, use frying pans, soup pots, and more to whip up delicious meals or hearty stews. Let your creativity shine by mixing different ingredients and creating your own signature dishes!
Step into the vibrant backyard and enjoy fun outdoor activities! Swing, play with water guns, collect honey, or go bug-catching with a net to discover the wonders of nature. You can even adopt and care for adorable pets—choose a cute cat or a playful dog, feed them, play with them, and experience real pet interactions!
Visit the drone delivery station to receive surprise items, including home decorations, clothes, and toys, and design your own unique living space!
In Slimaid Princess Home, there are no rules or limitations— drag and move characters as you want, set up their daily lives, and bring each room to life! Whether you're hosting a family gathering, inviting friends over, dressing up characters, create avatars, playing with pets, or simply creating your own home stories, there are endless possibilities for fun!
[Game Features]
Interactive Home – Explore 7 different rooms, including the kitchen, bedroom, backyard, and more!
DIY Cooking Fun – Use tons of ingredients to create your own meals!
Dress Up & Style – Try on different outfits to show off your unique personality!
Adopt Cute Pets – Take care of adorable cats and dogs, interact with them, and enjoy pet fun!
Drone Delivery Surprises – Unlock exciting furniture, clothes, and more to customize your home!
Ultimate Creativity – No rules, no stress—just play however you like!
Perfect for All Ages – Cute graphics, soothing sounds, and an immersive play house experience!
Multi-Touch Supported – Play with friends for even more fun!
Download Slimaid Princess: Home to play now! Additional content can be unlocked through a one-time in-app purchase, which will be permanently linked to your account. If you have any issues during purchase or gameplay, please contact us at slimaid124@gmail.com.
Slimaid Princess: Family offers weekly and monthly subscription options. Choose what works best for you. After confirming, payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
Plans:
• Slimaid Princess: Family Weekly Pass – 1 week, $4.99
• Slimaid Princess: Family Monthly Pass – 1 month, $12.99
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours before renewal.
You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime via your iPhone Settings > iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > View Apple ID > Subscriptions.
Subscriptions are tied to your Apple ID and can be used across your devices. Slime Princess: Family does not support Apple Family Sharing.
If you start with a free trial, your account will be charged at the end of the trial based on your selected plan.
You can cancel anytime, but no refunds will be issued for the remaining period.
For any issues, contact us at: contact@slimaid124@gmail.com
By subscribing, you agree to:
Privacy Policy:
https://privacy.kalegames.com/privacy/slime-privacy.html#app=Slimaid%20Princess%20Family
User Agreement:

bluejetty:00045109:ios.summary: KC Needlepoint stands as the leading provider in the needlepoint community, renowned for its vast selection of quality canvases, comprehensive selection of fibers, and personalized customer service. Situated in the heart of Kansas City, thi
bluejetty:00045109:ios.description:
KC Needlepoint stands as the leading provider in the needlepoint community, renowned for its vast selection of quality canvases, comprehensive selection of fibers, and personalized customer service. Situated in the heart of Kansas City, this shop caters to both seasoned needlepoint enthusiasts and beginners looking to embark on a new craft journey. With a commitment to excellence and creativity, KC Needlepoint has become a trusted name for all things needlepoint.
At KC Needlepoint, customers can explore a curated inventory that features everything a needlepointer could need. The shop offers an extensive range of canvases, threads, and accessories from top brands in the industry. Whether you are seeking hand-painted canvases with intricate designs or blank canvases for a custom project, KC Needlepoint has a huge selection to meet your needs. The shop also stocks a diverse array of threads, including wool, silk, cotton, and metallics, available in a rich palette of colors to bring your needlepoint projects to life.
For those looking to start a new project with all the necessary materials bundled together, KC Needlepoint provides customized needlepoint kits. These kits are carefully assembled to include a canvas, appropriate threads, needles, and detailed instructions, ensuring that stitchers have everything they need to complete their project. Whether you are interested in creating a beautiful home décor item, a unique gift, or a piece of wearable art, these kits are tailored to inspire creativity and simplify the needlepoint process.
Customer satisfaction is at the forefront of KC Needlepoint's mission. The shop prides itself on offering a welcoming and supportive atmosphere where customers feel valued and appreciated. Knowledgeable staff members are always available to offer expert advice, assist with product selection, and provide tips for improving needlepoint techniques. Additionally, KC Needlepoint offers an online store that you can shop through this mobile app, making it convenient for customers to browse and purchase their favorite products from the comfort of their homes or on the go.
KC Needlepoint is more than just a store; it is a vibrant community hub for needlepoint enthusiasts. 
Education is a core pillar of KC Needlepoint's offerings. We are with you from start to finish on every project. Use this app to stay up to date on the latest happenings in the industry by reading our blog, learn new needlepoint stitches in The Stitch Vault, and get the basics you need to get started stitching.

bluejetty:00176041:ios.developer: Zhuzhou Yiqi Network Technology Co., Ltd.
bluejetty:00176041:ios.summary:
Discover the power of binaural beats for sleep, focus, relaxation, meditation, and lucid dreaming.
Binaural Beats has been created for anyone feeling stressed, tired, overwhelmed, or simply looking for a moment of calm. Our goal is to prov
bluejetty:00176041:ios.description:
Discover the power of binaural beats for sleep, focus, relaxation, meditation, and lucid dreaming.
Binaural Beats has been created for anyone feeling stressed, tired, overwhelmed, or simply looking for a moment of calm. Our goal is to provide immersive audio experiences that help you relax your mind, stay focused, and enjoy deeper rest through sound.
We believe sound can positively influence the way you feel. Through carefully designed binaural beats, brainwave frequencies, isochronic tones, and ambient music, we create sessions for sleep, meditation, concentration, relaxation, and mindful listening.
Binaural beats offer a unique way to experience sound and frequency. Brainwaves describe patterns of electrical activity in the brain, with different frequency ranges commonly associated with states such as relaxation, focus, sleep, and meditation.
Our app includes carefully designed sessions inspired by:
• 40 Hz Gamma Waves – focus, awareness, and attentive listening
• Delta Waves – sleep, rest, and nighttime relaxation
• Theta Waves – meditation, creativity, and deep relaxation
• Alpha Waves – calm, mindfulness, and relaxed focus
• Beta Waves – concentration, alertness, and focused listening
Each frequency offers a unique listening experience for different moments of your day.
We compose instrumental soundscapes and frequency-based audio for:
• Sleep and deep rest
• Focus and concentration
• Study and deep work
• Meditation and mindfulness
• Relaxation and moments of calm
• Deep listening and inner awareness
Our sessions combine binaural beats, brainwave frequencies, isochronic tones, ambient sounds, and immersive audio to create relaxing and focused listening experiences.
Since 2014, we have been creating Binaural Beat tracks, instrumental music, and frequency-based sound experiences for meditation, sleep, focus, and deep relaxation. Every track in our app is carefully crafted and takes hours to compose, design, and produce.
Listening to Binaural Beats or Isochronic Tones can be an immersive way to create a personal routine for relaxation, concentration, meditation, or sleep. For the intended binaural listening experience, we recommend using headphones or earbuds.
What Are Binaural Beats?
Binaural beats are an auditory illusion created when two tones with slightly different frequencies are played separately into each ear. Because of the frequency difference, the listener perceives an additional rhythmic sensation known as a binaural beat.
For example:
If a 50 Hz tone is played in one ear and a 40 Hz tone in the other, the frequency difference is 10 Hz.
Explore Frequency Sessions
Explore a wide range of sounds for meditation, deep listening, focus, and relaxation, including 432 Hz and Solfeggio frequencies such as 174 Hz, 285 Hz, 396 Hz, 417 Hz, 528 Hz, 639 Hz, 741 Hz, 852 Hz, and 963 Hz.
Whether you're preparing for sleep, studying, meditating, focusing on work, or simply taking a quiet moment, explore different frequencies and find the sounds that fit your routine.
Disclaimer:
Binaural Beats is intended for relaxation, meditation, sleep, focus, and general wellness purposes only. It is not medical advice and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Individual experiences may vary.
Subscription Prices & Terms
Binaural Beats offers optional Monthly and Yearly auto-renewing subscriptions, as well as a Lifetime purchase.
Premium access includes all sessions and app features. Selected sessions are available for free.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/topd-studio
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/topd-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00073871:ios.description:
Live Weather provides accurate weather forecasts around the world. Wherever you are, and whatever your plan is, you’re always prepared with the latest weather forecast from Live Weather.
New Features of iOS16
-Support Live Activities,you can view the weather forecast by locking the screen
-Support the weather information display of Dynamic Island
-The cute weather icon will float on your Dynamic Island
Main features：
-Provide accurate 15 days weather forecast for daily temperature, wind direction, wind force, air quality and other specific information.
-Custom weather background, shoot and upload live scenery for background.
-Detailed hourly temperature and weather changes within 24 hours.
-Weather radar covers every country on the map.
-Receive weather alerts for the latest official National Severe Weather Warnings for your saved locations as soon as warnings are issued，such as snow, storms, ice, fog and rainforecasts.
-You can set the rainfall forecast when commuting, and it will tell you the first time if the street is about to rain.
Featured accessibility：
-Support Siri shortcut function, view the latest weather forecast directly via Siri with a password anytime, anywhere
-Pull down the phone notification bar to view the weather forecast via widget
Accurate forecasts include：
-15 days weather forecast
-24-hour hourly weather forecast
-Rainfall forecast within 2 hours(rain, sleet, snow, hail, and drizzle)
-Update every 30 seconds
-Global weather data
-Extreme weather warning alerts
-Air pollution forecasts
-Wind speed, direction and gusts
-Sunrise and sunset times
-Local weather forecasts unlimited locations
-UV Index, visibility and humidity

Warrio
bluejetty:00122369:ios.description:
Take command of one of the last shelters in the new world! Bring the survivors together and lead them, train people, and assign duties ­­- there’s always a job for everyone! Build and strengthen your base, and make it impregnable!
Warriors must be alert, and their weapons at the ready. Items and supplies found in abandoned warehouses will be useful in battles against hordes of zombies and their master.
Take command, sir, and save humans! 
Here are some features you get in the game:
• Refuge construction management.
Build and upgrade rooms to create an impregnable shelter. Workers are already there. Give the order to start building now! Prepare your shelter for defense by building a variety of defensive structures. Decide which defense combination will be most effective!
• Dwellers developing.
In these dark times, every survivor counts, and everyone will have something to do! Teach your people new skills, upgrade, and let them show you what they have learned in practice!
• Choice of equipment.
Create effective weapons and equipment, arm and dress your squad!
• Multiplayer, PVP.
We are not the only survivors, but only the strongest survive the apocalypse, right? Create a mighty, invincible squad to dominate your enemies in arena's tournament or attacks on other shelters. Show the others who's running the show in the open confrontation!
• Story-driven campaign.
Lead your squad through all the trials of the new world and survive using the whole arsenal available! There are hundreds of battles with hordes of zombies and mutant fanatics ahead of your brave fighters.
Set in a post-apocalyptic environment, spiced with an atmosphere of danger and featuring high-quality HD graphics, this rpg game will leave no one unimpressed.
In-App purchases may include random items.
Brought to you by MY.GAMES

bluejetty:00148498:ios.name: Work Log - Shift Tracker
bluejetty:00148498:ios.summary: Work Log is a shift and hours tracker for hourly workers, salaried staff and contractors. Log every shift, and see your hours, overtime, time off and estimated pay for each pay period, or turn them into a PDF timesheet for your employer or
bluejetty:00148498:ios.description:
Work Log is a shift and hours tracker for hourly workers, salaried staff and contractors. Log every shift, and see your hours, overtime, time off and estimated pay for each pay period, or turn them into a PDF timesheet for your employer or an invoice for your client.
Punch in and out, or add shifts by hand. Work Log adds up your hours and works out your pay for every shift, week, month and pay period.
KNOW YOUR PAY
• Pay periods that match your paycheck: weekly, every two weeks, twice a month, monthly or your own schedule
• Overtime by shift, week or pay period, up to three tiers, as a fixed rate or a multiplier like 1.5×
• Premium and shift-differential rates for nights, weekends and holidays
• A clear paycheck breakdown: regular hours, overtime, premium pay and the estimated total
• Estimate your net pay with named taxes, deductions and bonuses. Set your own percentages or flat amounts. Flat amounts can apply per pay period, shift or hour, with before-tax deductions where needed.
• Tips, sales, expenses, mileage, per diem, bonuses, deductions, raises and holiday pay
TRACK YOUR TIME
• Punch in and out with one tap, or enter shifts manually
• Home Screen widget: punch in without opening the app
• Reminders to punch out, end a break or take one
• Quick Shifts, automatic breaks and rounding
• Notes on any shift
• Time zones per job, so your records stay right when you travel
ADD YOUR SCHEDULE
• Take a photo of the roster, or share a PDF or spreadsheet from WhatsApp, email or Files
• Your shifts are found; if several people are listed, you pick your name
• Review and change anything before it's added
• Upcoming shifts are added as scheduled, with optional reminders. Punch in or Confirm with one tap; they're never counted until worked.
• Your first import is free
TIME OFF AND INVOICES
• Time off: log vacation, sick and personal days, and see your balances with accrual, carry-over and yearly resets
• PDF invoices: bill clients straight from your shifts, with invoice numbers, payment terms and tax (Pro)
• Timesheets and spreadsheets: export any period as PDF or XLSX (Pro)
• Your shifts online: view, edit and export them from any computer at worklogdashboard.com (Pro)
SEE IT YOUR WAY
• Monthly calendar: see worked shifts, scheduled shifts and time off together, then choose a day to view its entries or add a shift.
• View your shifts by day, week, month, pay period or year, as a list or a calendar
• A Home Screen panel you can customize: today, this week, your pay period, year to date and time off
• Light and dark themes, and your own date, time and currency formats
• Available in 23 languages
KEEP IT SAFE
• Free cloud backup and sync across your devices (sign-in required)
• Local backups you can restore at any time
WORK LOG PRO
Upgrade to remove ads and get:
• Import your schedule from a photo, PDF or spreadsheet
• Multiple jobs, each with its own rates and settings
• Spreadsheet and PDF exports, including timesheets and invoices
• Your shifts online at worklogdashboard.com
Does your employer use Work Log? Link to your employer in the app and Pro is included.
FOR EMPLOYERS
Work Log - Dashboard shows your team's hours in one place: a team overview, a page for each employee, scheduled email reports for your bookkeeper, and shared access for an office manager.

MONTE SUA P
bluejetty:00123352:ios.description:
Telefone é coisa do passado! Este é perfeito para você que gosta de praticidade, agilidade e conforto na hora de fazer seu pedido! Além de possuir vantagens exclusivas, você realiza seu pedido totalmente através do aplicativo. 
MONTE SUA PIZZA
Com um layout único, você pode montar sua pizza de forma simples! Arraste os sabores, saiba todos os ingredientes de cada um, e tenha uma pré-visualização de como sua pizza vai ficar. Para facilitar ainda mais, adicionamos um sistema de busca, onde você encontra os seus sabores preferidos de forma muito mais rápida. Nunca foi tão fácil fazer um pedido de pizza!
DESCONTOS EXCLUSIVOS
Todo mundo ama aquele descontinho, não é mesmo? Com o nosso aplicativo, você fica por dentro de todas as nossas promoções, além de ter acesso exclusivo ao sistema de conquistas, onde pode conseguir diversos prêmios!
QUER PAGAR COMO?
Já que estamos falando em praticidade, já pensou em poder pagar seu pedido diretamente pelo do aplicativo? Isso mesmo, agora você pode usar seu cartão de crédito para pagar por seu pedido antes mesmo do entregador chegar. É rápido, prático e seguro. Diga adeus às maquininhas sem sinal! Mas, se você preferir pagar na entrega, pode escolher entre as outras opções de pagamento disponíveis no app.
AGENDAMENTO DE PEDIDOS
Está planejando aquele rolê com os amigos no seu apartamento? Você pode agendar o seu pedido (até mesmo com o restaurante fechado) para receber a hora que preferir!
PREFERE BUSCAR O PEDIDO?
Sem problemas, aqui você pode escolher entre receber diretamente na sua casa ou buscar em nosso estabelecimento.
FEEDBACKS E AVALIAÇÕES
Para nos ajudar a melhorar cada vez mais a sua experiência, você pode avaliar cada pedido e dar sugestões diretamente no aplicativo. 
NÃO GOSTOU DE ALGUM INGREDIENTE?
Utilize o campo de observação para que tudo chegue do jeitinho que você gosta, podendo customizar os ingredientes do seu pedido.
A felicidade em forma de App chegou!
Baixe agora e aproveite todas as vantagens que o aplicativo oferece.

ROLI Learn is the piano learning app that gets you playing real songs - fast. With expert-designed lessons, 1,000+ songs, and technology that lights your keyboard to guide every note, it's the most engaging way t
bluejetty:00024164:ios.description:
Learn piano the smart way.
ROLI Learn is the piano learning app that gets you playing real songs - fast. With expert-designed lessons, 1,000+ songs, and technology that lights your keyboard to guide every note, it's the most engaging way to learn piano available today.
300+ Expert Piano Lessons:
Build real piano skills with step-by-step lessons created by professional music teachers. Whether you're a complete beginner or picking up where you left off, ROLI Learn's structured piano course takes you from single-finger melodies to confident two-handed playing - at your own pace.
1,200+ Songs to Play:
Explore a growing library of songs spanning today's biggest hits to timeless classics - Billie Eilish, Beethoven, and everything in between. New songs are added every month so there's always something new to learn.
4 Ways to See the Music:
Learn the way that works for you: cascading video game-style notes, color-coded horizontal scrolling, or traditional sheet music. Slow songs down, practice one hand at a time, and build up to full speed when you're ready.
450+ Chords & Scale Exercises:
Lay a solid musical foundation with hundreds of chord and scale exercises, designed to build the technique you need for the songs you love.
Skill-Building Games:
Piano practice doesn't have to feel like homework. Arcade-style games like Springboard and Superluminal sharpen your keyboard skills while keeping things fun.
AI-Powered Technique Feedback (with ROLI Airwave):
ROLI Vision uses your camera to track your hands in real time, giving you instant feedback on finger placement and technique - like having a personal piano teacher watching every note.
---
*ROLI Learn requires a ROLI Piano or Piano M keyboard and an active ROLI Learn Membership. Internet connection required.*
ROLI Learn Terms of Use: https://roli.com/legal/learn-subscription-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00161388:ios.description:
Negative Image is a simple yet powerful app for performing negative effects on images and videos and improving photos quality. Enhance the quality of your photos by modifying parameters like hue, saturation, brightness, contrast and more. You can then use our smart sharpening filter to get stunning results for your image.
ENHANCE QUALITY:
* Get beautiful negative results
* Adjust photo parameters like hue, saturation, brightness, contrast, exposure and more to get better results
* Convert old negative films to real photos with high quality
* Sharpen the image using a smart sharpening filter
* Preserve the aspect ratio of the original photo/video
SMART NEGATIVE ENGINE:
* Keeps the original high quality of the photo or video
* Fast performance
* Saves history of all converted photos/videos
* You can save results to Photos or Files
* Share results with friends using any other social app you like
* All common image/video formats are supported (jpg, png, heic, mp4, mov, flv, and more)
HOW TO USE:
1. Load a photo or a video
2. Apply the negative effect and adjust colors parameters as you wish
3. Watch the result, save it to Photos/Files and share with friends
Please read our terms of service and privacy policy before using the application:
* Terms of service - https://ofirapps.blogspot.com/2021/04/negative-image-terms-and-conditions.html

- Smooth Skin: Swipe over wrinkles, blemishes and sm
bluejetty:00016126:ios.description:
Camera360 is a professional but easy-to use App for photo editing and selfie retouching. You can use Camera360 to edit photo with filters, stickers and make-ups.
ORIGINAL FACE RETOUCHING
- Smooth Skin: Swipe over wrinkles, blemishes and smooth skin.
- Reshape: 21 micro-adjustment, no trace of PS.
- Face and Body reshape: Manual and auto adjustment. You can protect the parts you don't want to edit.
- Beautify: One tap and instantly beautify your photo. 
FILTERS OF VARIOUS STYLES
- Magic Sky: Change the sky as you like. Anime Sky, Dreamy Sky.
- Painting filter: Make the photo look like a painting. Use “Great Artist” filter. Everybody can be an artist. 
- Anime effect: Try cartoon filter and make a photo nobody else can do!
- Movie Filter: From cinematic, B&W to color, anything you ask is here. Try our movie filters and be who you wanted to be.
HIGH QUALITY SELFIE
- High Quality Filter: Over 300 filters, from retro, black and white, HDR, LOMO, to Hong Kong style!
- Natural and Stylish makeup: Including main and sub, there are over 30 makeup filters! Customize your favorite style and color just the way you like and make your own!
- Cute AR Sticker: With smart face recognition, not only face but also your expression will be captured! You can also play interactively!
- Video Selfie: Support videos of 10s to 60s with music. You can freely change your music and enjoy filter and makeup at the same time.
EDIT LIKE A PRO
- Detailed Color Expressions: It works really well if you just want to change one color! Make the unique colored photo with DSL.
- Image Correction: Support vertical and horizontal correction. Suitable for photos of buildings. Lines will be straight and balanced.
- Basic Color Change: 13 basic parameters including saturation level, exposure, highlight, shade, layers, color temperature, hue, etc.
- Mix Filter: Over 300 filters can be used.
【Camera360 VIP Service Statement】
1. Service name: 
- Yearly Camera360 VIP；
Hereinafter referred to as VIP.
2. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.After successful deduction, Camera360 will be automatically extended for one subscription period. To cancel renewal, manually turn off automatic renewals in iTunes/AppleID setup 24 hours before the current subscription period expires.
3. You can suspend or terminate this service by:
Automatic renewal for Apple In App Payments (IAP payments, in-app purchases): Goto iPhone "Settings" --> Enter "iTunes Store and App Store" --> tap "Apple ID", select "View Apple ID", enter "Account Settings" page, tap "Subscribe", and select Camera360 VIP to cancel the subscription.
4. VIP Subscription Notice：
https://www.camera360.com/iap_subscription_en.html

https://www.camera360.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00184778:ios.description:
EMBARK ON THE ULTIMATE SOLITAIRE ADVENTURE
Solitaire Tripeaks Lost Worlds puts you in the shoes of a fearless girl explorer as she uncovers the secrets of mysterious lost worlds. Journey through enchanted islands filled with music, exotic flavors, and ancient wonders — all while mastering the classic TriPeaks Solitaire card game.
Pick up the rules in seconds and play for hours. Tap a card that is one higher or lower than your active card to clear the board and move on to the next island. Simple to learn, endlessly satisfying to master.
EXPLORE LEGENDARY LOST WORLDS
Each world is a unique themed realm waiting to be discovered. Explore the Music World, the Food World, remote and exotic lands, and much more. Every island brings stunning new visuals, fresh challenges, and hidden treasures on your solitaire journey.
BIG, EASY-TO-READ CARDS
Designed for comfort and clarity, the large cards in Solitaire Tripeaks Lost Worlds are easy to read at a glance — perfect for all ages, and for playing anywhere, anytime.
HUNDREDS OF HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
Progress through hundreds of carefully designed levels across multiple lost worlds, with new islands added regularly. From breezy warm-up rounds to genuine brain challenges, every level feels unique.
DAILY QUESTS, EVENTS AND CHALLENGES
Return every day for fresh rewards. Complete daily quests, take part in special events, and tackle limited-time challenges to earn coins, boosters, and exclusive prizes on your card adventure.
BOOSTERS AND WILD CARDS
Stuck on a tough level? Use wild cards and powerful boosters to clear the board and keep your island adventure moving. Collect them as you progress and deploy them wisely.
TRAP CARDS AND STRATEGIC TWISTS
Special trap cards add exciting layers of strategy to the classic TriPeaks gameplay. Plan your moves carefully — every card played counts.
EVERYTHING YOU GET:
- Hundreds of levels across multiple themed worlds
- Classic TriPeaks Solitaire card game — easy to learn, hard to put down
- Big, easy-to-read cards designed for all ages
- Daily quests, events, and challenges with fresh rewards
- Boosters and wild cards to help you clear tough boards
- New islands and lost worlds to unlock and explore
- Fun for the whole family (ages 4+)
THE ADVENTURE BEGINS WITH A SINGLE CARD
Join the girl explorer on her quest to uncover the lost worlds — one island, one card, one adventure at a time. Every level brings you closer to the secrets hidden beyond the horizon.
Download Solitaire Tripeaks Lost Worlds now and start your card game adventure today!

• Runs in AWS GovCloud U.S-West Region, operated by U.S. personnel 
• Enables adherence to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) 
• One-on-one or group messaging: Securely chat with up to 500 Wickr users in a room
• Audio and video calling: Hold conference calls with up to 100 attendees
• Screen sharing and broadcasting: Present with up to 500 participants
• File sharing and saving: Transfer files up to 5GB with unlimited storage
• Configurable ephemeral messaging: Control expiration and burn-on-read timers
AWS WickrGov provides a secure platform for public sector organizations and teams to help manage their sensitive communications.

bluejetty:00148894:ios.description:
Make zombies great again! 
Imagine the world where zombies are not a deadly threat, they just want to play. That’s Coin Scout - Idle Exploring Game! 
Zombies were smart enough to organize their weird, but functioning, form of society, spreading across the world, having fun and scouting for the coins.
People, as usual, are opposite to them and identifying zombies as a classical threat from horror movies. This time they are gravely mistaken. In Coin Scout their pathetic attempts to resist the zombies – is the direct way to join the rotting ranks.
Who would have thought that a trivial idle clicker would allow you to do something incredible! It was an unremarkable evening for ordinary people, until suddenly, out of nowhere, an insatiable green zombie scout with big eyes appeared! And as soon as he appeared here, the growth and building of a brave new world began! And he longed to mine coins infinitely! Humanity was amazed at how quickly the new population began to grow! It was absorbing new territories and spreading stronger and stronger... Never has the apocalypse looked so cute and so desirable, even people have a little started to participate... Unfortunately they are not very good at building this new world… 
But everything needs time and coins will definitely fill our pockets, we believe.
This curious world lives and grows by itself, all the time while you work or sleep, in the best traditions of idle games! Simple, trivial, but still with a strategic part, be on the alert! Send your zombies to investigate while you're away. When you get back to your phone, they'll be richer and ready to build. Gather dozens of experts, each with their own style
Unlock new buildings as your business grows and discover more new territories, and just tap and enjoy to produce more gold! 
Features:
- Simple, trivia and clingy tap gameplay
- Zombies have never been so cute and friendly
- IDLE System
- Beautiful graphics and lovely animations
- Close to infinite game progression
- Iconic locations from zombie-movie: gas station, highway, supermarket, military camp, hospital, etc.
- Build your own zombie paradise - raise, explore, spread, pursue your own strategy
Idle clickers are cool! Join the big family of fans of this genre!

listings.description:
Make zombies great again! 
Imagine the world where zombies are not a deadly threat, they just want to play. That’s Coin Scout - Idle Exploring Game! 

Zombies were smart enough to organize their weird, but functioning, form of society, spreading across the world, having fun and scouting for the coins.
People, as usual, are opposite to them and identifying zombies as a classical threat from horror movies. This time they are gravely mistaken. In Coin Scout their pathetic attempts to resist the zombies – is the direct way to join the rotting ranks.

Who would have thought that a trivial idle clicker would allow you to do something incredible! It was an unremarkable evening for ordinary people, until suddenly, out of nowhere, an insatiable green zombie scout with big eyes appeared! And as soon as he appeared here, the growth and building of a brave new world began! And he longed to mine coins infinitely! Humanity was amazed at how quickly the new population began to grow! It was absorbing new territories and spreading stronger and stronger... Never has the apocalypse looked so cute and so desirable, even people have a little started to participate... Unfortunately they are not very good at building this new world… 

But everything needs time and coins will definitely fill our pockets, we believe.

This curious world lives and grows by itself, all the time while you work or sleep, in the best traditions of idle games! Simple, trivial, but still with a strategic part, be on the alert! Send your zombies to investigate while you're away. When you get back to your phone, they'll be richer and ready to build. Gather dozens of experts, each with their own style

Unlock new buildings as your business grows and discover more new territories, and just tap and enjoy to produce more gold!

- Simple, trivia and clingy tap gameplay

- Beautiful graphics and lovely animations

- Iconic locations from zombie-movie: gas station, highway, supermarket, military camp, hospital, etc.
- Build your own zombie paradise - raise, explore, spread, pursue your own strategy

Idle clickers are cool! Join the big family of fans of this genre!

bluejetty:00187148:ios.description:
TeamLive is a highly intuitive and useful team scheduling and communication platform, built specifically for the hospitality industry by seasoned hospitality professionals.. Featuring a simple design and real-time collaboration features, the app allows you to easily view your work schedule and seamlessly communicate with your co-workers, all from your mobile device. 
The app gives you more freedom to plan your personal life. With Team Scheduling, you can dynamically view your work schedule across devices by day, week, or month; be alerted to new or updated work schedules; and take comfort in the built-in functionality to prevent scheduling conflicts (because there’s nothing worse than being understaffed for dinner rush). 
The TeamLive app is modeled after the social media you use every day, so communication has never been easier. With Team Communication, you and your team can stay in sync with company goals, status updates, and more—all from one dashboard. Easily submit time-off requests, update your availability for upcoming schedules, and trade shifts with other employees—all from the app (so you can say goodbye to those group chats forever.) 
The TeamLive app has all of the scheduling & communication tools you need, in one place!

bluejetty:00061640:ios.description:
**Scan It All** turns your iOS device into a multipage document scanner for documents, receipts, notes, and other text.
***NEW*** Sign document pages from within the app. Create and store unlimited number of signatures. place signature on any page. resize move, and if needed delete signatures previously added.
Quickly scan, store, sign and email your documents as multipage PDF files. Upload to Dropbox, Google Drive and OneDrive and others.
**Scan It All** auto-detects document edges, straightens the documents, eliminates shadows and sets a perfect contrast.
Very easy and intuitive interface.
All image processing happens on your iOS device, keeping your documents secure and confidential.
**Scan It All** has DropBox, Google Drive and OneDrive support, upload your PDF to cloud service from within the app.
FEATURES: 
• On touch Email, Print and Upload options on scanned documents.
• Automatic perspective correction and edge detection, manual options to override it for Black & white and color. 
• Sign document pages*.
• Quick processing. 
• Multipage editing: reorder (drag drop), delete (drag out) and add multiple pages* 
• Email document as PDF.
• Email PDF to pre-configured email addresses.
• Email JPEGs as attachment.*
 • Printing via AirPrint.
• Compact attachments.
• Open PDF in other applications like (Dropbox, Evernote, iBooks etc)*
• Export scanned Images to Photo Library*
• Upload PDF to Dropbox, Google Drive and oneDrive directly*
• Copy Image.
• Paste Image*
• Export PDFs from other apps to Scan It All and add/edit pages.
• Set PDF Password.
• Import encrypted PDFs.
• Use Touch ID to secure documents.
• Backup/Restore*/Sync documents to/form iCloud
• Scan from Photo Gallery
• Merge Documents
* (requires one time upgrade to un-limited version)
TIPS ON SCANNING 
 • Make sure your document is flat and well lit. 
 • Use flash in low light conditions, but avoid glare with glossy documents (magazines, etc.)
We're constantly improving Scan It All, If you want to send us your feedback or have a problem with our software, please use the Email Support button in the app.
If you find an issue with our software please email support@bitsabound.com or use "Email Support" option under settings menu, and we'll promptly reply.

bluejetty:00119817:ios.description:
Introducing iTranslate Lingo: The easiest way to learn a language.
With iTranslate Lingo, we’ve made sure to put FUN at the heart of language learning, by designing an app that helps you easily and playfully learn a new language.
It's pretty simple:
** 4 Words per Lesson
** 5 Minutes per Day
** 1K Words in 8 Months!
FEATURES:
• Learn up to 14 languages including English, Chinese, Korean, Russian, German, French or Spanish.
• Choose from 3 skill levels for each language.
• Personalize your language learning with 30+ categories.
• Effective & simple exercises: Choose the correct translation from a list of four words. It’s as simple as it sounds.
• Type and improve your spelling skills! Everything you write will be automatically corrected.
• Get excellent audio training and take your listening skills to the next level. Achieve impressive results immediately.
• With tailored pronunciation lessons, you will learn how to speak clearly in no time!
• Correct mistakes to achieve the best results.
• Review my Words: Improve your language skills in a playful way.
• Improve & celebrate your progress and earn awards.
• And the best part: Subscribe to PRO and get access to ALL apps within the iTranslate App Suite
Learn more about iTranslate Lingo: https://www.itranslate.com/lingo

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/iTranslateApp
Like & share on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/itranslateapp
Learn more about iTranslate: https://www.itranslate.com

bluejetty:00138569:ios.description:
En esta aplicación encontrarás La Biblia La Torah Completa en Español totalmente Offline.
La Torah viene del hebreo Torah, que puede traducirse “dirección”, “enseñanza” o “ley” (Proverbios 1:8; 3:1; 28:4).
Los ejemplos anteriores muestran cómo se usa esta palabra "Torah" en las Escrituras.
La Torah se usa para referirse a los primeros cinco libros de la Biblia: Génesis, Éxodo, Levítico, Números y Deuteronomio.
Al conjunto de estos libros también se le conoce como el Pentateuco, que significa “volumen quíntuplo” en griego.
Como fue Moisés quien escribió La Torah, también se le llama “el libro de la ley de Moisés” (Josué 8:31; Nehemías 8:1).
Para el judaísmo, la Torá es la Ley. Según la tradición judía, involucra la totalidad de la revelación y enseñanza divina otorgada al pueblo de Israel.
Según la tradición hebrea, los cinco libros del Pentateuco fueron escritos por Moisés, quien recibió la revelación directamente de Dios en el monte Sinaí, por lo cual se define como la "instrucción dada por Dios para su pueblo, a través de Moisés".
La Torah también puede referirse a las leyes que recibieron los israelitas sobre asuntos concretos, como “la ley [Torah] de la ofrenda por el pecado”, “la ley acerca de la lepra” y “la ley acerca del nazareo” (Levítico 6:25; 14:57; Números 6:13).
A veces, La Torah hace referencia a la dirección y enseñanza que dan los padres, personas sabias o el propio Dios (Proverbios 1:8; 3:1; 13:14; Isaías 2:3).
El Hebreo tiene su origen influenciado por varias lenguas-raíz semíticas Arameo (antecesores y derivados; las mismas que originaron el árabe, por ejemplo), además de que fue altamente enriquecido por el babilónico y el Fenicio.
El hebreo es una lengua con casi 30 siglos de historia escrita. Obviamente en un período tan largo la lengua ha sufrido procesos de cambio lingüístico que hacen del hebreo antiguo y el hebreo actual, más que la misma lengua puedan considerarse lenguas emparentadas pero que difieren en pronunciación, gramática y léxico.
Lo que contiene La Torah:
-La historia de la relación de Dios con la humanidad desde la creación hasta la muerte de Moisés (Génesis 1:27, 28; Deuteronomio 34:5).
-Las normas de la Ley de Moisés (Éxodo 24:3).
El alefato o alfabeto hebreo, algunas veces denominado mediante su forma hebrea álef-bet2 (אָלֶף-בֵּית), es la serie formada por las consonantes hebreas. Está compuesto por 22 caracteres, de los cuales cinco tienen una grafía distinta al final de las palabras. Se utiliza para escribir el idioma hebreo, el yidish y, en menor medida, el judeoespañol.
Además, la aplicación Biblia La Torah en Español Offline incluye para un mejor estudio y comprensión de la Biblia:
- El diccionario hebreo bíblico más completo y práctico que puedas encontrar para tu teléfono o tablero. Ideal para utilizar como consulta en el estudio del hebreo bíblico y en la exégesis del texto de la Biblia Hebrea. 
- Recursos sobre el hebreo, indispensables para conocer a fondo nuestra historia.
- La Torá y el Tanaj.
- Concordancias Bíblicas.
- Traductor hebreo.
- Biblia Hebraica escrita y en audio.
- Tanaj en audio y muchos más.
- Glosario de términos.
Beneficios de Biblia La Torah:
- Posibilidad de copiar los textos y compartirlos a través de las redes sociales.
- Fácil de usar, puedes usarlo sin necesidad de internet.
- Disponible para todos los dispositivos y tablets.
- Permite moverse entre capítulos.
- Posibilidad de aumentar o disminuir el tamaño de la letra del texto.
¡¡¡ En esta aplicación encontrarás todo lo que necesitas para tu alma !!!
Descargue ahora la Biblia La Torah En Español Offline y comparta con nosotros su experiencia.

bluejetty:00036642:ios.description:
Body Temperature App lets you track, analyze and share your thermometer data right from your iOS device. Discover the smartest way to manage your body temperature data with our mobile application. Get comprehensive insights on your health and fitness with highly accurate data analytics and artificial intelligence. Select accompanying symptoms from a built-in list of symptoms or add notes for later references. Your health data can be exported in a report format and shared with your health professional right from the app.
KEY FEATURES 
• Record your body temperature in both Celsius (°C) and fahrenheit (°F).
• Add notes (e.g. before breakfast) and measurement data (feeling, measured site, symptoms, etc.) for each record.
• Store data on the cloud and access from any device using your Apple ID.
• Share and export your body temperature data with doctors, healthcare providers or family members via text messages or email.
• Print PDF reports or graphs directly from your device.
• Get daily reminders to measure your temperature.
• Track body temperature of your family members by creating multiple profiles.
DISCLAIMER
Body Temp Monitor app has been designed for informational and educational purposes only. The app is not intended to diagnose, prevent or treat any condition. Hence, it should not be considered as a substitute for a professional medical device.

bluejetty:00187849:ios.description:
Deltek Client Relationship Management (CRM) users have access to critical client and pursuit information from their mobile device. With the Deltek CRM for Vantagepoint mobile app, teams have instant access to pursuits, firm details, contact information and activities from anywhere, at any time. Help keep all of your team members informed and turn more pursuits into projects with access to key business development intel on the go. 
Features:
• Add, update and view client and contact details
• Create and manage project pursuits (opportunities)
• Manage activities and associate them with clients, contacts and projects
• Track information unique to your business in custom fields
• One-touch tap to make a call, send an email or view an address on a map
• Maintain all CRM security access and controls through the mobile app
• Easy and secure access to the app using a 4-digit pin 
To use the app:
• A Deltek Vantagepoint CRM user license is required.
• Contact your firm’s IT resource to obtain your firm-specific Deltek CRM mobile URL needed during set up. Note that this URL is different than the URL used in a browser.

bluejetty:00061348:ios.description:
Keynote is now part of Apple Creator Studio, an amazing collection of Apple’s most powerful creative apps designed to help you bring your ideas to life. The suite includes Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, Motion, Compressor, and MainStage — plus premium content and intelligence features in Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform, all in one simple plan. Creating, viewing, and editing presentations in Keynote, as well as collaborating in real time, does not require a subscription.
Create memorable presentations on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. Start with an Apple-designed theme and add text, images, charts, and shapes. Bring it all to life with cinematic animations and transitions. Confidently present from anywhere, in person or virtually, and take turns controlling a presentation in multi-presenter slideshows.
Get Started Quickly
• Work from iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, or even a PC with iCloud.com
• Select from a wide variety of Apple-designed themes
• Import and edit Microsoft PowerPoint presentations
Create Stunning Presentations
• Easily change slide layouts and backgrounds
• Add recorded audio, live video, and image galleries
• Use powerful graphics tools including background removal and masking
• Draw or write with Apple Pencil on iPad
Cinema-Quality Animations
• Beautiful cinematic slide transitions and impressive animations
• Emphasis builds and Magic Move let you effortlessly add impact
• See live on-canvas previews as you animate your slides
• Draw a motion path with Apple Pencil on iPad
Present to Your Audience
• Rehearse with a customizable presenter display
• Practice in an immersive Conference Room or Theater environment on Apple Vision Pro
• Highlight with Apple Pencil or with your finger while presenting on iPad
• Control your slideshow from an iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch
Share with Anyone
• Share your presentation publicly or collaborate with specific people using iCloud or Box
• Make changes from any device and see a list of changes from others in real-time
• Export presentations to Microsoft PowerPoint, PDF, HTML, movies, and image files
Apple Intelligence
• Use Writing Tools to proofread, rewrite, summarize, and compose text
• Create your own fun images with Image Playground based on a description
Some features of Apple Creator Studio require an Apple Intelligence–capable device. For full system requirements and usage limits for Apple Creator Studio intelligence features, see Apple Support article 125029.

bluejetty:00015057:ios.summary: Brilliant is a superintelligent tutor for math and coding. Our team of experts from MIT and Harvard has built a world-class personalized learning system. For students from grade 5 to college and beyond – you work through problems with a tut
bluejetty:00015057:ios.description:
Brilliant is a superintelligent tutor for math and coding. Our team of experts from MIT and Harvard has built a world-class personalized learning system. For students from grade 5 to college and beyond – you work through problems with a tutor that sees where you’re stuck, can sketch right on your screen, asks the right questions, and guides you to real a-ha moments. 
Forget memorizing formulas. Brilliant is designed to build real understanding and help you excel. It’s there when you need it, adapts to how you think, and makes learning feel like a fun challenge instead of a chore. 
Master everything from foundational math and algebra to college-level calculus, Python, computer science, AI, neural networks, algorithms, data analysis, physics, and more.
Join over 10 million people using Brilliant to reach their learning goals.
WHY BRILLIANT WORKS
- One-on-one learning for all 
Private tutoring is the most effective way to learn, but it’s expensive, hard to schedule, and out of reach for most families. Brilliant’s tutor works with you one-on-one, every single day, for a fraction of the cost. No scheduling. No waiting. Just learning. 
- Like someone sitting next to you
Brilliant’s tutor can see what’s on your screen and react in real time, from highlighting parts of a problem to creating visualizations that bring hard concepts to life. 
- Expert-crafted curriculum
Every course is crafted by our team of human experts from top institutions around the world. And with new and updated courses added every month, there’s always something new to explore.
- Learning that adapts to you
Brilliant’s tutor personalizes your experience in real time, adjusting to your skill level, filling gaps before they become problems, and helping you build confidence as you go.
- Build true problem-solving skills
Brilliant doesn’t give you answers. It guides you through problems and to your own a-ha moments. So while you’re learning, you’re also building critical thinking and analytical skills – and having fun.
WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
“Koji doesn’t judge. It feels like talking to the most patient teacher.” — Alan
“Going through a lesson with Koji is more active, interactive, and guided than traditional learning.” — Lory
“She read the problem out loud and figured it out on her own — ‘Oh! I know! Never mind, Mom, I got it!’ I'm seeing those breakthroughs more often.” — Arianne
Send feedback to ios@brilliant.org.

bluejetty:00137610:ios.summary:
Golf Dreams is a free golf simulation game using real physics and groundbreaking controls making it one of the most true golf games out there!
* Tournaments - start your career from scratch and work your way to glory. Solo golf gameplay as
bluejetty:00137610:ios.description:
Golf Dreams is a free golf simulation game using real physics and groundbreaking controls making it one of the most true golf games out there!
* Tournaments - start your career from scratch and work your way to glory. Solo golf gameplay as it should be.
* Golf clubs - win prizes in tournaments and get new clubs and upgrade them to get yourself in perfect shape and sink even more birdies.
* Weekly League
* Awesome golf courses inspired by real world examples from the best courses around the globe. Tee off for a relaxing round with birds chirping in the background.
* Shape your shots with draw and fade golfshot. Swing, chip, flop, punch, putt and drive your way to success around the fairway and greens. Stay away from the rough, bunkers and water hazards and make your way to the top of the tour.
* Mini golf tournaments and multiplayer matches with 6 holes to play. Quick game play.
* PvP multiplayer. Play golf head-to-head against friends or a random rival. No waiting time. Play your golf round directly and your opponent can play their round when it suits them.
* Realistic golf ball tracer and tracker with in-depth stats how you strike the golf ball.
Enjoy a nice round of single player golf or challenge someone for a golf battle in one of the best golf games for free.
+++ Recent Reviews +++
"Beautiful game! Very well thought out and quick to play. I have been looking for a good golf game that has a fun solo mode and this is it!"
/ Bradley W.
"What a great bunch of engineering. The stroke is cool. The clubs play true. As does the wind. Only sad part is nobody seems to know it exists. If you play golf in real life you'll enjoy this expressly for the controls and purity of play..."
/ Drew D.
"Best golf game out there! It's the only not to be pay to win trash. No micro transaction, just courses to buy. No chests to unblock. Also more realistic, you can choose the clubs and you don't magically know where it will land, and you also don't play a stupid timing game to play. Just feels like golf. Kudos on making this game."
/ Tiago S.
"Lots of fun and as challenging to play as actual golf. I'm enjoying the simplicity and colors of the polygon graphics..."
/ Richard D.
"Brilliant game, probably the closest game to a simulation. No pay to win aspects and really bright future for mobile golf games"
/ Daniel D.
+++ Get in touch +++
Discord: https://discord.gg/3NHxcTdT5B
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/golfdreamsofficial

bluejetty:00144480:ios.name: Rust+
bluejetty:00144480:ios.summary:
The official Rust companion app from Facepunch Studios – stay connected to the game so you never miss an important moment again. Coordinate with your team, receive alerts when you’re being raided, remotely set off traps, and more!
Requires
bluejetty:00144480:ios.description:
The official Rust companion app from Facepunch Studios – stay connected to the game so you never miss an important moment again. Coordinate with your team, receive alerts when you’re being raided, remotely set off traps, and more!
Requires the Rust game - available on macOS and PC. Rust Console Edition is not supported at this time.
PAIR WITH YOUR SERVERS
Pair with your favorite Rust servers to receive real-time updates for the things that matter the most: player counts, current game time, online teammates, and more. You’ll also get (optional) push notifications whenever one of your teammates joins the game.
KEEP UP WITH YOUR TEAM
Communicate with your team from anywhere to just catch up or plan for your next raid. Messages are visible in both the app and the in-game team chat so you can seamlessly switch between the two.
CONTROL YOUR IN-GAME DEVICES
Connect Smart Switches and Smart Alarms to your in-game electrical contraptions and pair them with Rust+ to control them remotely at any time. Smart Switches let you turn things on or off, and Smart Alarms send customizable push notification alerts when an electrical signal is detected.
EXPLORE THE MAP
View the full server map to see all monuments, your teammates, and points of interest.
GET THE LATEST RUST NEWS
Get notified about new Rust blogs and news so you can stay on top of the latest updates, or catch up on older blogs you may have missed.

bluejetty:00119773:ios.name: Your PDF Catalogs of products
bluejetty:00119773:ios.summary:
Are you looking for an effective way to present and sell your products? 
Reach a larger audience, attract more potential customers? 
Enhance your brand image, elevate to a new level, explore new markets?
Product catalogs are essential for
bluejetty:00119773:ios.description:
Are you looking for an effective way to present and sell your products? 
Reach a larger audience, attract more potential customers? 
Enhance your brand image, elevate to a new level, explore new markets?
Product catalogs are essential for reaching customers and enabling them to choose the products to order.
With this application, from your iPad or iPhone, you can create and maintain your product catalogs based on photos, descriptions, and prices. Your product features can be entered directly into the app or imported in text format with ease. You can effortlessly add a cover page, table of contents, and end page to give your catalogs a distinctly professional image. 
Finally, you can share or email your catalogs in PDF format to your clients and prospects.
Are you aware of the power of social media? 
Automatically convert your catalogs into videos and share them with an audience that craves entertaining, inspiring, and interactive content.
Upon installation, the application offers you:
• to integrate a demo database to quickly discover all the possibilities.
• to download examples of catalogs to see real completed documents.
• to consult the startup help pages for a serene launch.
Key features of the application:
• Unlimited creation of catalogs with a choice of the initial layout of product information.
• Visual display of 1 to 16 products per page, with photo, title, long label, price, reference.
• Product photos: choice from the album or via the camera.
• Multi-suppliers and multi-product families.
• In addition to product pages, each catalog can contain: cover page, customizable start page, table of contents, customizable end page, last page.
• Management of pre-established messages to use when sending a catalog by mail (examples provided).
• Import of products in CSV or JSON format, examples provided.
• Standalone application: no synchronization between devices.
• Sending catalogs in PDF format by email or sharing in compatible apps.
• Automatic conversion to MP4 video format with the option to add a soundtrack of your choice.
• Contextual and general help, direct access to support via email.
All features are operational in the basic version; only the number of products is limited. You have the option to expand the capacity according to your needs via a subscription in the application.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
The download and use of the "Catalog" App is free of charge. Access to expanded content is available to you as an 1-month, 3-months or 6-months subscription (In-App purchase). 
For a subscription, you will pay the fixed price set for your country which is displayed in the app. The subscription will be renewed automatically if it is not cancelled within at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your iTunes account will be charged for each new term within 24 hours prior to the expiration of the current subscription. Current term of In-App subscriptions cannot be cancelled. You can disable the automatic renewal of your subscription in your iTunes account settings at any time.
MORE INFORMATIONS
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/your-catalogs-of-products
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/your-catalogs-of-products-pp

The most well-connected Workout Data manager on the App Store with support for 50 of the most popular apps and services.

Get your complete training history and take control of your workout data.

Keep all your workout details from popular services including Apple Watch, Polar, Garmin, Coros, Peloton, Strava, Runtastic, Suunto, adidas, SportsTracker, Apple Health, Zwift, Rouvy and many others on your iPhone or iPad for instant access anytime.

bluejetty:00122345:ios.description:
WTOP brings you the latest local news, weather and traffic impacting D.C., Maryland and Northern Virginia. 
* Read and watch original and exclusive stories from WTOP’s award-winning news team. 
* Listen to live radio 24/7. Our anchors and reporters break down the biggest stories of the day.
* Get customized breaking news and weather alerts and the D.C’ region’s most custom traffic updates available. 
* Save and easily share local, national and international stories impacting the D.C. region. 
* Win rewards for listening, check-ins, contests and sweepstakes.
* Send news tips, photos, videos and voice messages directly to the WTOP team.
WEATHER FEATURES:
* Set your preferred locations for easy access to conditions in those areas.
* Customize weather alerts and notifications sent to your phone or email.
* Live conditions & weather radar map.
* Hourly and 10-day forecasts at your fingertips.
* Up-to-date closings & delays announcements from schools and other organizations across the D.C. area.
TRAFFIC FEATURES:
* Customize alerts to receive notifications direct from the WTOP Traffic Center when a major incident will impact YOUR commute. 
* At-a-glance map of major incidents, powered by the WTOP Traffic Center and Google Maps.
* Quick list of the latest and most severe incidents on the roads. 
* Quick list of the latest Metro alerts and major delays.
* Missed a traffic report on the radio? Listen to the latest traffic report on-demand.
* Report a traffic incident: Easily send a message, voice memo, photos and videos or call the WTOP Traffic Center directly from the app.
LIVE RADIO AND PODCAST FEATURES:
* Listen to WTOP Radio programming live, 24/7, while browsing the rest of the app.
* Track your listening for special rewards.
* Subscribe to and download your favorite podcasts from the WTOP Podcast Center. 
PERSONALIZATION FEATURES:
*Sign up for customized app alerts: Choose from breaking news, weather, traffic, mass transit, closings & delays and sports and entertainment. 
*Curate your own reading list: Save articles of interest and check them off as you go.
*Connect with WTOP: Use the Feedback button to share messages, voice memos, photos, videos and news tips with the WTOP team.
*Share articles easily via email and social media.
The WTOP News app is supported by Apple CarPlay! 
* Apple is in no way affiliated with or responsible for any contests/rewards presented with this app.
* This app is not intended for users located within the European Economic Area.

bluejetty:00150962:ios.description:
The Kerndt Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your Kerndt Brothers Savings Bank accounts into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES:
• Account Activity: View account balances and transactions
• Account Opening: Existing customers can open additional account within the App
• Funds Transfer: Make transfers and view existing scheduled transfers.
• Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming payments.
• Bill Pay: Pay bills and view scheduled payments
• Mobile Check Deposit: snap picture(s) of checks to deposit and view deposit history
• Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Kerndt Brothers Savings Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE:
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re using Online Banking. The app also features the ability to utilize biometric scanning to help prevent unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED:
Download and install Kerndt Bank Mobile App and sign in or register.

bluejetty:00077695:ios.description:
Gao Tie Guan Jia (高铁管家) is an App that provides train dynamic information service in China at an early stage.
As a one-stop travel service platform, Gao Tie Guan Jia's core service is a "high-speed rail + flight" itinerary service, offering users a variety of travel products, including train tickets, air tickets, private car rentals, hotel bookings, bus tickets, and attraction tickets. The goal is to provide a one-stop solution for all travel needs, making travel a better way of life.
Features of Gao Tie Guan Jia include railway travel services such as train ticket booking, intelligent transfer solutions, real-time train information, and train meal ordering. Gao Tie Guan Jia continuously innovates and leads in the field of travel experiences.
The main products and services offered by Gao Tie Guan Jia include:
Train Tickets:
• 24-hour booking, anytime and anywhere to buy train tickets, high-speed rail tickets, student tickets, and child tickets
• Train ticket prices are synchronized with the official 12306 website, with worry-free refund and exchange policies
• Easy management of "My Itinerary," real-time query of train status, stoppages, delays and early notifications
• Double-engine ticket-grabbing system, including waiting list booking and monitoring for available seats, ensures immediate purchase of released tickets
• Support for advance booking up to 63 days before departure, and automatic booking when tickets are released
• Intelligent transfer system, providing the best travel options through AI algorithms
• Station VR navigation, providing panoramic views of the station
• Train meal ordering, with onboard delivery to seats
Air Tickets:
• Provides air tickets from major airlines and reputable agents
• Special discount tickets and full network price comparison
• Real-time flight information and delay notifications
• Support for online check-in on mobile phones and seat selection on official website
Private Car Rentals:
• Flat-rate prices, transparent pricing without additional tolls, parking fees or other expenses
• Free delay for flights/trains, and driver breach compensation
• High-quality drivers, who are ready in advance, help with luggage and provide a welcome sign for pickup
Taxi Services:
• Covers many cities across China, with one-click booking across multiple platforms and car types, including Caocao, Shouqi, Yangguang, Ctrip, and Shenzhou
• Supports real-time and pre-booked taxi services
Hotels:
• Provides hotel accommodation options around the world
• Discounts for train ticket bookings, special discounts for new and existing customers
• Free hotel cancellations due to flight delays or cancellations
Bus Tickets:
• Provides bus ticket query and booking services for most cities in China, including bus schedules, routes, and prices
Attraction Tickets:
• Covers attractions in various provinces and cities in China, providing tickets, routes, and guided tours
• Supports QR code entry to attractions, avoiding long lines
Gao Tie Guan Jia's official website is https://www.133.cn/, and its official WeChat account is "Gao Tie Guan Jia" (WeChat ID: gaotieguanjia).

bluejetty:00121185:ios.description:
Mr. Grumpy is back, but he’s on vacation! Will you respect his alone time and let him relax?
Yeah, right!
Discover even more fun, silly and creative ways to disturb your favorite grumpy marmot and don’t go away until you run out of pranks! Which will never ever happen!
Laugh out loud with Mr. Grumpy’s “thrilled” reactions, and get creative to find out just how many grumpy faces an annoyed marmot can make!
And don’t worry about the big flashy DO NOT DISTURB sign on his door: it actually means “welcome” in marmot talk!
HIGHLIGHTS
-PLAY many, many, different kinds of pranks on Mr. Grumpy and give him the relaxing vacation he so desperately needed!
-TAP everywhere to find new ways of annoying Mr. Grumpy and have fun discovering endless pranks! There are many surprises hiding in plain sight, so tap, tap tap and then tap some more!
-LAUGH with Mr. Grumpy’s funny reactions and see if you can watch every single grumpy animation of our beloved marmot!
-BECOME the best prankster ever and prove your skills by never getting caught!
Mr. Grumpy secretly loves your attention, he just has a very marmot-like way to show it!
Don’t let him spend his vacation all alone and show up in his doorstep unannounced: he’ll love the surprise!
If Mr. Grumpy yells DO NOT DISTURB and doesn’t answer the door, don’t worry: you’ll find tons of ways to lure him out!
Third time is always the charm, and mr. Grumpy has lots of charm if you look really hard! Just knock on his door and don’t go away until he answers! Don’t let him see you, though: he’ll love the mystery!
Download now and catch up with the cutest grumpy marmot ever!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00040664:ios.description:
Clean up your photo library and iCloud Photos—without turning it into a chore.
Tidy is a photo cleaner that helps you clear out duplicate photos, similar shots, blurry images, unwanted screenshots, and space-hogging videos. Reclaim storage space, organize photos by month, and get back to the memories you actually want to see.
SWIPE THROUGH YOUR CAMERA ROLL
• Swipe left to delete photos you do not want
• Swipe right to keep the ones that matter
• Swipe up to move special photos to your Secret Space
• Swipe down to save your favorites
You are always in control. Before anything is removed, you get a final review. Tidy never deletes photos without your permission.
CLEAR CLUTTER, KEEP THE GOOD STUFF
• Find duplicate photos and clear them in one tap
• Review similar photos and choose the best one to keep
• Start with old videos, blurry photos, or low-quality images
• Clean up screenshots and other clutter in your camera roll
• Free up storage space and keep your photo library easier to browse
A PHOTO ORGANIZER THAT RESPECTS YOUR PRIVACY
Tidy works locally on your phone, so you can organize your photos offline without uploading your library to a server. No connection is needed to clean up your camera roll.
Less scrolling. Less clutter. More room for the photos and memories you love. Download Tidy and make your photo library feel good again.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Tidy offers optional PRO subscriptions. In the United States, PRO is available for $3.99 per week or $25.49 per year. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. SWIPE THROUGH YOUR CAMERA ROLL
• Swipe left to delete photos you do not want
• Swipe right to keep the ones that matter
• Swipe up to move special photos to your Secret Space
• Swipe down to save your favorites

CLEAR CLUTTER, KEEP THE GOOD STUFF

• Review similar photos and choose the best one to keep
• Start with old videos, blurry photos, or low-quality images
• Clean up screenshots and other clutter in your camera roll
• Free up storage space and keep your photo library easier to browse

A PHOTO ORGANIZER THAT RESPECTS YOUR PRIVACY
Tidy works locally on your phone, so you can organize your photos offline without uploading your library to a server. No connection is needed to clean up your camera roll.

Less scrolling. Less clutter. More room for the photos and memories you love. Download Tidy and make your photo library feel good again.

DS1 Companion™ is a feature rich app, designed to give you the most out of your DS1 radar detector, while enhancing your driving experience along the way. Featuring intelligent alerts and advanced muting! DS1 Companion™ is the COMPLETE solution to enjoying your DS1. 
**** NOTE ***
Make sure to upgrade your DS1's firmware to version 1.21. Previous versions prior to 1.15 will not keep the detector muted after you mute it.
The DS1 Companion™ app leverages years of optimizations and features from V1 Companion™ (Available separately on the app store for owners of the Valentine One radar locator). Building on this legacy, the DS1 companion app adds new systems to support Radenso's detector's unique abilities and features.
Enhanced GPS location based 'false muting' via SpotLocks™ - All future updates to this app are free to purchasers of DS1 Companion™
DS1 Companion™'s alerting and muting systems are fully optimized for the DS1 platform. Intelligent voice announcements and on-screen visuals will always keep you informed and aware of the situation around you. 
NOTE: DS1 Companion™ requires a Radenso DS1 radar detector with firmware 121 to function correctly.
DS1 Companion™ full feature list:
• SpotLocks™ - Location based false silencing has never been this good or easy. Turn on the intelligent location-based learning and let DS1 Companion™ do the rest. Or you can manually 'lock' or 'unlock' locations with ease from the main alert screen.
• Works seamlessly with the DS1's auto mute memory, manual mute memory, k-block, and K X Low Speed built in muting. 
• Ability to set the DS1’s internal detector settings (more coming in free future upgrades). *Req US Version 1.21 firmware.

• SpotLocks™ works seamlessly with your DS1’s built in 'auto mute memory' locations.
• 'Proximity' meter - leverages the high resolution signal strength information provided by the detector to show you a better representation of the signal's source.
• 'K & X falses in area' meter shows you how many possible false alerts exist in the area you are traveling based on the accumulated SpotLock data™.
• 'Custom Phrases' for a given threat's audio announcements.
• High resolution meters for the priority alert (Not limited to the # of bars on the DS1 display).
• Customizable heads-up display.
• HUD displays the priority alert's band, signal strength, frequency. The HUD is color coded between real threats & false signals.
• HUD of the secondary alerts' bands, signal strengths, frequencies, & bogey counts.
• Advanced BSM/CAS/Ka False Muting (Optimized for the DS1 platform).
• 'Ghost' muting quiets false alerts when you are stuck traveling near a false emitting vehicle.
• "Passive Mute™"- Quiets the DS1 below user set speeds & during weak K & X signals.
• Bogey count display showing total number of threats.
• Vehicle speed (MPH or KMH) display. Speed is color coded for each alert type.
• Mute status with the ability to manually mute/unmute alerts as you need.
• Detailed & intelligent voice announcements of band, frequency, strength, number of alerts, occurrences of mixed signals and more.
• Automatic muting of Ka, K, and X bands ('Time before mute' set for each band).
• 'Reduce Speed' notification for user set speed.
• ‘Urgency Alerts™’ - Unmutes growing threats & announces these alerts via voice & notifications.
• ‘Alert History’ - View your past alerts with detailed encounter information.
• Compass heading.
• Imperial/metric units (mph/kmh).
• Detailed trip summary at the end of your ride including duration, distance, alerts, muting stats.
• Automatic & seamless connection via Bluetooth.
• iPhone & Apple Watch notifications of band, & frequency of each alert.

【Story】
Your
bluejetty:00150382:ios.description:
"The story of how you, a coward and liar with a gentle heart—a mere human—set off on a journey to save the world."
A slightly dark storybook vibe in a world filled with dolls, blended with a traditional "Match 3" puzzle game.
【Story】
Your name is Oz, and you are a con man.
Though you are a mere human, you claim to all that you are a mighty wizard, and sent a lost young girl who wished to return home off to face the evil witch who rules this land.
All under the promise of sending her home with your magic.
That young girl's name is Dorothy.
When our story begins, Dorothy has failed to defeat the witch, and all the creatures in the land have been transformed into tin dolls.
With color gone from the world, and everyone having lost their hearts, you set off on a journey to regain the title of savior you bestowed upon that girl from a strange land.
You, and your trusted plush doll companions.
【Game】
▼Puzzle
Match 3 puzzles with simple controls.
Connect at least 3 pieces of the same color, while evading various tricks and twists!
Traverse thousands of stages with your characters.
▼Trips
Send your characters off on trips and they'll come back with items.
They might even come back with a photo from their trip...
▼Character Education
Probe into the characters' memories to learn their backstories, see amazing transformations, and puzzle together with them to unlock their hidden powers!
【Characters】
▼Lily Leone
A very cowardly lion.
Her actual name is “Leone”, but her timid stuttering of her name led her to be known as “Lily Leone”.
Though she is a coward, she is very good at dealing with spiders.
▼Keshika
A smart but dopey scarecrow.
Her harsh treatment of crows apparently comes from the ruin they bring to her beloved barley field.
On such days she can be seen skipping about energetically, to a mysterious tune called “Suttoko Dokkoi”.
▼Kiko
A woodcutter who is habitually sad.
She sliced her own body one day and was in a bind until she made a new one out of tin, which she rather likes.
Fearing rust, water is her greatest enemy.
▼Toeto
The bravest little pupper ever.
She set off on a journey to find her master, who she was separated from.
She’s always full of energy, but gets lost a lot.
It’s a shame.
But as long as she’s happy…
▼Jacqueline
A pumpkin-loving, mischievous weirdo.
She loves pranks and is always smirking.
No one has seen her without a smile on her face, so one wonders just what she is really feeling.
She seems to be deeply afraid of pumpkin pie.
Supported OS: iOS 11 or later
