Кроссворд - классическая словесная головоломка, с ранних лет знакомая многим любителям ребусов.
Разгадывайте в любом месте, в дороге или в очереди, кроссворды хранятся в вашем телефоне и не требуют подключения к сети интернет.
Если вы любит
bluejetty:00023847:ios.description:
Кроссворд - классическая словесная головоломка, с ранних лет знакомая многим любителям ребусов.
Разгадывайте в любом месте, в дороге или в очереди, кроссворды хранятся в вашем телефоне и не требуют подключения к сети интернет.
Если вы любите сканворды, загадки, викторины - вам обязательно понравится.
Способен ли Ты разгадать все уровни?
Несколько категорий на выбор:
- Классические
- Фигурные
- Тематические
- Кроссворды на одну букву
- Сложные
Основные функции:
- Все кроссворды работают оффлайн (без интернета).
- Автонастройка сетки под ваш экран
- Возможность изменить масштаб сетки (приблизить, если не видно)
- Поддерживает тёмную тему ios
- Подсказка для открытия буквы
- Подсказка для открытия слова
- Заморозка разгаданных слов
- Режим просмотра вопросов в списке
- Отличный способ скоротать время и размять извилины!
- Тренируй интеллект и расширяй словарный запас!
- Бонусные подсказки за ежедневную игру!
- Все кроссворды бесплатно
- Удобно и просто
- Ежедневные Уровни
Это увлекательная головоломка (как и сканворд), которая тренирует память и заставляет работать мозг.
Заполняя клетки правильными словами по горизонтали и вертикали, игрок развивает мышление, расширяет словарный запас и получает удовольствие от решения интеллектуальных задач.
Стоите в очереди, скучаете в ожидании, летите в самолете и нет интернета - кросворд всё равно работают - это офлайн игра!
Если вы ищете не сканворд, а настоящий классический кроссворд — это приложение для вас: логика, мышление и увлекательные головоломки каждый день.
Играйте в игры без интернета — где и когда угодно.
Также небольшой совет - оффлайн игры могут быть без рекламы, если отключить сеть, попробуйте :)
Если для Вас это плюс - у нас отсутствует регистрация!
Но вы всегда можете сохранить и восстановить свой прогресс через Apple Game Center.
Регулярное разгадывание кроссвордов помогает:
Улучшить память и концентрацию
Поддерживать ум в тонусе и замедлять когнитивное старение
Снижать уровень стресса и тревожности
Развивать словарный запас и речевое мышление
Играйте с пользой — каждый кроссворд делает ваш мозг чуть сильнее!
Подходит как взрослым, так и школьникам — каждый найдёт что-то для себя.
Слова, логика и новые знания — всё в одном и бесплатно!
Проверьте, насколько вы сильны в словах! Заставь работать свой мозг!

bluejetty:00074476:ios.summary:
Upgrade Your Netatmo Weather Station with myatmo® – The Ultimate Companion App
myatmo® is the unofficial yet indispensable app for your Netatmo weather station, offering detailed charts and a user-friendly design. With support for Apple Wa
bluejetty:00074476:ios.description:
Upgrade Your Netatmo Weather Station with myatmo® – The Ultimate Companion App
myatmo® is the unofficial yet indispensable app for your Netatmo weather station, offering detailed charts and a user-friendly design. With support for Apple Watch and Home Screen Widgets, myatmo® stands out as the most comprehensive 'all-in-one' solution for Netatmo weather station users.
Enhance your Netatmo experience with myatmo® and explore a wealth of metrics through beautiful, feature-rich, and interactive charts. It's no wonder many users refer to myatmo® as the 'unofficial' app for Netatmo weather stations!
myatmo® includes:
• Detailed charts for all data types
• Heat maps for several data types
• Comparison charts for months and whole years
• Min / Max diagrams
• Wind direction diagrams
• Wind frequency diagrams
• Cumulative precipitation diagram
• Grassland temperature sum diagram*
• Cold sum diagram*
• Overview diagram of the most important data types together
• Charts for the last 1-48 hours
• Diagrams for any period of time
• Compare different data types in a chart
• Weather forecast bar and 'Global Weather Maps'
• CSV data export via iCloud or email
• Configurable and customizable in almost all aspects
• Free color choice for better recognition of various data types
• Share chart screenshots via iMessage, Whatsapp and more
• Apple Watch App, Apple Watch Complications
• 'Home Screen' Widgets
• 'Lock Screen' Widgets
Please note our EULA:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
and our terms and conditions:
https://www.myatmo.de/knowledgebase.php?article=124
Please note: some features require a myatmo® 'Premium' purchase. To use myatmo® you need a netatmo weather station, for some features of myatmo® you also need a netatmo wind gauge and a netatmo rain gauge. 
* Some diagrams are only available for weather stations in Europe!
myatmo is a registered trademark of Totalidea Software GmbH, Germany.

bluejetty:00015509:ios.description:
My Pretend Big Family Mansion invites you to check out the biggest Pretend Series game yet with a variety of rooms to explore!
Enter the Golden Gates of this rich neighborhood, and step into the Biggest Mansion you have ever seen!
My Pretend Big Family Mansion is like one big Giant Dollhouse and Playground for Kids and even big kids!
Explore the living room with a gorgeous, winding staircase, grand piano, and kitchenette! Play with video games, relax near the aquarium tank full of exotic fish and relax on the couch!
Head over to the kids room, and play with toys, accessories, and fun items in the play room, fit for kids of all ages!
Head into the parent's master bedroom, and explore all the rich amenities they have to offer! A large bed with city views and a spa tub with the best in accessories are just the beginning!
Explore the huge garage with exotic cars, race cars, and even airplanes! Oh My! This family has it all!
Head over to the Big Family Mansion's very own sports center equipped with all kinds of sporting equipment - they even have a basketball court!
Find the secret lever near the aquarium, and head down to the basement where you will discover tons of artifacts, antiques, and other collections from their travels!
Cool off at the exotic rooftop pool with a drink, and a fun floaty and watch the television!
Tinker with cars, motorcycles, swim at the pool, take the golf cart for a spin, play video games, explore the arcade, the rooftop pool, and never, ever leave this mansion because it has everything you could ever want!
My Pretend Big Family Mansion is our biggest pretend series game yet, and there are plenty of rooms to explore in this enchanted mansion!

bluejetty:00135470:ios.description:
Feeltracker: 4.8 stars with 23K+ ratings • 800K+ downloads • 250K+ users/year • 5M+ saves/year • 96% satisfaction
Scan your scale AND your food with your camera—no manual entry needed. Weight Journal uses AI-powered scanning, hands-free voice conversations, and on-device intelligence to turn weight tracking from a chore into an effortless journey toward your health goals. Whether you're losing weight, gaining muscle, or maintaining your ideal body composition, get intelligent insights to help you succeed.
COMPLETE WEIGHT MANAGEMENT:
• Track weight, body fat percentage, and BMI calculations
• Scan your scale with your camera for instant, accurate entry
• Scan food to get nutritional analysis with calories, protein, carbs, and fat
• Log multiple daily measurements for accuracy
• Set and monitor progress toward your goal weight
• Attach photos to entries to document your journey
• Record notes about diet, exercise, and lifestyle factors
• Automatic unit conversion (lbs/kg, in/cm)
YOUR PRIVACY, RESPECTED:
• No account required—start tracking immediately
• Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+): run AI fully on-device, 100% offline and private
• Automatic iCloud sync keeps your progress safe
• Export data anytime in PDF, CSV, Excel, or JSON formats
DESIGNED FOR SUCCESS:
• Beautiful Liquid Glass design with eye-friendly Dark Mode
• Quick-entry widgets for easy weight logging
• Smart reminders, 24-hour clock option, localized in-app FAQ
• Integration with Apple Health for complete wellness view
UNDERSTAND YOUR JOURNEY:
• Powerful trends show weight changes over time
• Interactive charts—tap any point to view detailed measurements instantly
• Weekly, monthly, and six-month averages smooth out fluctuations
• Track body fat percentage alongside weight changes
• Identify patterns linked to diet and exercise
• Generate detailed reports for healthcare providers
AI-POWERED FEATURES:
• Voice Chat: hands-free two-way conversations with the AI
• Ask a Question: instant answers about your weight data
• Chat: interactive fitness journey conversations
• Voice Summary: audio summaries of your weight trends
• Meal Planner: personalized weekly meal plan based on your goals
• Exercise Planner: personalized workout routine for your needs
• Pattern Detective: discover correlations affecting your weight
• Goal Assistant: personalized weight management goals
• Doctor Summary, Pro Health Report, Deep Research Report
• Song Recommendations: music matched to your workouts
• Personalized Quiz, Make Me Laugh, Calm Me Down for Sleep
• Personalized greeting shares the meaning of your name
• Optional profile context (age, gender, sleep schedule, weather) for sharper insights
FREE WITH PRO OPTIONS:
• All core tracking features completely free
• Pro unlocks Meal & Exercise Planners, deep AI analysis, and Apple Intelligence mode
• Affordable pricing for your long-term health journey
IMPORTANT HEALTH DISCLAIMER:
This app is for personal tracking and informational purposes only. AI insights and recommendations do not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making health or dietary decisions.
Privacy Policy: https://feeltracker.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://feeltracker.com/terms/

bluejetty:00115659:ios.description:
Master your Jiu Jitsu journey with FlowRoll, the essential training companion designed by practitioners, for practitioners. Whether you're a white belt taking your first steps or a seasoned black belt refining your game, FlowRoll helps you track, analyze, and improve your Jiu Jitsu.
Track Your Technique Library
Build your personal database of BJJ techniques with our intuitive categorization system. Organize moves by type (Submission, Sweep, Pass, Escape etc) and smart custom tags. Add detailed notes and links to create a comprehensive library that grows with your journey. (20 Max, paid Pro version required for unlimited techniques)
Log Training Sessions
Record every roll with detailed session tracking. Note whether you trained gi or no-gi, count your submissions, rate your satisfaction and link the techniques you worked on. Track your progress over time and identify patterns in your training.
Join a global community of grapplers on your journey. Share your training sessions to inspire others and see what fellow practitioners are working on. Follow training partners, comment on their progress, and celebrate each other's achievements. Climb the leaderboards and see how your dedication stacks up. Whether you train at a small local gym or a world-renowned academy, FlowRoll connects you with the wider BJJ community.
Powerful Analytics
Visualize your BJJ development with insightful charts and statistics. Overview your submissions, see which techniques you're drilling most, track your training frequency, monitor satisfaction trends, and identify gaps in your game. Our analytics help you make data-driven decisions about your training focus. (Full analytics requires paid Pro version)
Smart Filtering & Search
Quickly find any technique in your library with advanced filtering options. Search by name, category, position, or notes. Filter your training sessions by date, type, or satisfaction level. Never lose track of that sweep your coach showed three months ago.
Key Features:
Smart import of techniques from your existing BJJ notes
Comprehensive technique tracking with categories and positions
Detailed session logging with satisfaction ratings
Visual analytics and progress charts (Full analytics requires paid Pro version)
Advanced search and filtering
Offline-first design
Clean, intuitive interface designed for quick logging
Support for both gi and no-gi training
Export your data anytime (Full analytics requires paid Pro version)
Download FlowRoll today and take control of your Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu journey!

bluejetty:00168921:ios.description:
Real fits, real people.
FitDrop is the social app for outfits. Post what you're wearing, tag every piece and get inspired by what real people put on every day. No influencers, no models.
POST YOUR FIT
Take or pick a photo, tag each piece with its name, brand and category, tag the friends in the picture, add your styles and put a song on it.
FRIENDS AND GLOBAL
The Friends feed shows fits from the people you follow. Global shows outfits from people all over the world.
FIT OF THE WEEK
Swipe through the week's looks and vote for your favourites. The winners drop every Monday. Maybe it's you.
FIND YOUR STYLE
Search for people and outfits, follow the styles you love, browse trending posts and discover the Fitdroppers on Fire.
CONNECT
Like, comment on and save fits, follow your friends and share your favourite posts in a tap. Notifications keep you in the loop.
YOUR PROFILE, YOUR RULES
All your fits in one place, so you never forget an outfit. Make your account private, block people and report anything that doesn't belong here. You decide whether we may use analytics or send you marketing emails.
SUPPORTER MEMBERSHIP (OPTIONAL)
FitDrop is free to use. Supporters get a badge next to their name, show up first in search and lead the Fitdroppers on Fire row. Your membership keeps FitDrop independent: no ads, and we never sell your data.

bluejetty:00069340:ios.summary:
Play Spades FREE with millions of players from all over the world in our multiplayer, social gaming platform!
Break spades, master the art of bidding nil or blind nil, trump properly, and improve your skills as a spades player.
Game featu
bluejetty:00069340:ios.description:
Play Spades FREE with millions of players from all over the world in our multiplayer, social gaming platform!
Break spades, master the art of bidding nil or blind nil, trump properly, and improve your skills as a spades player.
Game features:
• SOCIAL ASPECT - Friend players and like their profiles, send them gifts, express yourself with animated emojis, and rate their gameplay after each game!
• TOURNAMENTS – Take part in regularly organized tournaments where you can play against the best players and receive big prizes when you win!
• LEADERBOARDS - Get to the top of the leaderboards! Prove you are the best in different, exciting and elite aspects!
• DAILY CHALLENGES - Cover three daily challenges every day! You have 24 hours to complete all three!
• CLUBS - Enter a social or fighting club! Create a club, invite friends, play and earn club experience! Level the club up!
• ONE ACCOUNT – Play VIP Spades through a browser or any mobile device with the same account. 
• GET REWARDS – Log-in every day to claim your daily bonus, as well as many other bonus opportunities.
• LIVE conversation - Real-time conversation with others in the “Play with friends” room. 
• KNOCKOUT ELIMINATIONS - Win three consecutive games against players of any level!
• MAKE NEW FRIENDS - Find same-interest players from all around the world!
• PROFILE CUSTOMIZATION – Upload your own profile picture, write a personalized bio, choose between a variety of custom-drawn borders, play with a different deck of cards, and change the background of the table you play on!
• VIP STATUS - Become VIP in Spades and gain access to even more social features and benefits on the platform!
• GLOBAL CHAT – Talk about what excites you or discuss different Spades strategies! Create new topics and get to know our players! “Like” chat threads of others.
• EXPERIENCE BOOSTER - Increase the experience you gain while playing games! This means that now you can level up much faster!
• FREE TRAINING - Our challenging AI will allow you to learn how to play spades in a stress-free way!
• NO REGISTRATION – Choose “Continue as Guest” to use our free card game app without registration.
• BALANCED MATCHMAKING - Fair gameplay with players near your skill level that provides a fair experience for everyone.
Most popular Spades modes in one place:
• Solo - There are no teams and the score is tracked separately for each player. The prize pool goes to one player. If there is a draw between two or more players, another round is played. If a Nil bid is successful, the player gets 50 points, if not - 50 points. No blind bid can be placed.
• Pairs - Work together with your partner and help each other! Be a team and assist your partner by trying to give them the tricks they need.
• Joker-Joker-Ace - You can include the Jokers card in your game! Available for both Solo and Pairs Spades.
• Suicide - Players play with a partner but with a twist. One of them must bid Nil and the other has to bid at least 4. Blind Nil bids are not available. Players should do their best to achieve synergy with their teammates to win.
• Whiz - A mode designed only for the best Spades players who are ready to test their skills to the limit. Professionals play in teams and must bid the exact number of trumps they have or bid nil. No Blind Nils are allowed.
• Mirror - Also played with a partner, the Mirror mode requires players to announce the exact number of Spades they have. If somehow a player has no spades, he must bid Nil. No Blind Nils are allowed.
Fans of the multiplayer Spades game? Follow us:
https://www.facebook.com/vipspades
https://www.instagram.com/vipspades/
Email: support@vipspades.com
Terms of Use: https://vipspades.com/terms-and-conditions/
IMPORTANT:
This product is intended for those 18 or older and is for amusement purposes only. This game includes in-app purchases. Practice or success at social casino gaming does not imply future success at real money gambling and gaming.

bluejetty:00062099:ios.description:
This is an app full of fun phone calls from Cookie Monster, which will help teach your child about life skills and milestones.
Ring Ring, Cookie Monster here! Sesame Street's blue, cookie-loving monster wants to video chat with you! Receive video calls and voice messages, and when you call Cookie he is always there to answer. 
FEATURES 
• Receive video calls from Cookie Monster, or dial Cookie yourself! 
• Receive voicemail from Cookie regularly and listen to the messages any time. 
• See live video of yourself in the corner of the screen while you're chatting with Cookie. 
• Grown-ups can activate calls or schedule calls for a variety of situations, such as nap time (more calls for getting ready to go, time to wake up, bedtime, brushing teeth and getting dressed available with additional call packs). 
LEARN ABOUT 
Cookie Calls encourages children to engage in a variety of healthy habits, from washing your hands to eating fruits and vegetables. This app also helps parents establish daily routines for their children. 
CALL PACKS 
The Cookie Calls sampler pack comes with your purchase of this app. This initial pack gives a taste of all the fun things Cookie wants to tell you about, like healthy eating, math and more. For even more calls, download the "Fortune Cookie" call pack for FREE, plus you can buy additional call packs easily right within the app. 
• Fortune Cookie: Cookie Monster shares ancient wisdom that’s found inside of fortune cookies. (FREE) 
• Eat Your Colors: Cookie Monster calls to talk about, and eat, some of his favorite healthy foods like apples, avocados, and cauliflower! 
• Healthy Habits: Cookie Monster can’t wait to tell you about the joy of exploring nature, the importance of getting exercise, and lots of other healthy habits! 
• Parent's Helper: Daily routines are easier when Cookie Monster calls to talk about getting dressed, getting ready for bed time, and more! 
• Laugh with Cookie: Cookie Monster just wants to make you laugh! 
• Sing with Cookie: Sing along to classic kids’ songs with Cookie Monster, or just listen! 
• Foods of The World: Cookie is on a trip around the world and wants to talk about new foods with you! 
TIPS 
• Please allow Push Notifications to receive scheduled calls from Cookie Monster! 
ABOUT US
Sesame Workshop’s mission is to use the educational power of media to help kids everywhere grow smarter, stronger, and kinder. Delivered through a variety of platforms, including television programs, digital experiences, books and community engagement, its research-based programs are tailored to the needs of the communities and countries they serve. Learn more at www.sesameworkshop.org.
ABOUT IDEO
IDEO is a human-centered design and innovation firm ranked independently among the ten most innovative companies in the world. Learn how our team of child-development experts, veteran toy designers and interaction designers approach the creation of award-winning kid apps at www.ideotoylab.com. 
PRIVACY POLICY 
The Privacy Policy can be found here: 
https://sesameworkshop.org/about-us/legal/privacy-policy/
CONTACT US
Your input is very important to us. If you have any questions, comments or need help, please contact us at: sesameworkshopapps@sesame.org.

bluejetty:00025291:ios.description:
Easy Fast — the simple, powerful fasting tracker built to make intermittent fasting easy.
Easy Fast is your personal intermittent fasting companion designed to help you break free from unhealthy eating habits and take control of your health. Whether you're a beginner starting your first intermittent fasting plan or an experienced faster looking for a smarter fasting tracker, Easy Fast makes it simple to track, manage, and stay motivated throughout your fasting journey.
WHY EASY FAST?
Intermittent fasting is one of the most effective ways to lose weight, improve your relationship with food, and boost energy. Easy Fast gives you the structure, guidance, and motivation you need to build lasting fasting habits — all from your pocket. Unlike other fasting trackers, Easy Fast combines a clean, beautiful design with science-backed insights to make every fast count.
WHO IS EASY FAST FOR?
Beginners exploring intermittent fasting for the first time
Anyone using a fasting tracker to lose weight or improve health
People following 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD, or custom fasting plans
Faster looking for a clean, distraction-free intermittent fasting app
Anyone who wants to build consistent fasting habits with reminders and insights
KEY FEATURES
Fasting Timer — Start and stop your fasts with a beautiful, real-time fasting tracker countdown that shows your progress through every stage
Multiple Fasting Plans — Choose from popular intermittent fasting plans like 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD, and more — or create your own custom fasting schedule
Fasting Stages — See what's happening in your body at every hour of your fast with science-backed intermittent fasting milestones
Smart Reminders — Get notified when to start fasting, when you hit milestones, and when your fast is complete
Insights & Trends — Track your fasting streaks, view detailed stats, and monitor your intermittent fasting progress over time
Weight Tracking — Log your weight and watch your fasting progress with easy-to-read charts
Journal — Record how you feel during and after each fast with mood, energy, and hunger tracking
Hunger Toolkit — Tools to help you push through cravings during fasting, including guided breathing, motivation cards, and wave timers
Dark Mode — Full dark mode support for comfortable use day and night
Live Activity — See your fasting timer right on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
WHY USERS LOVE EASY FAST
Easy Fast is more than just a fasting tracker — it's a complete intermittent fasting coach in your pocket. From the moment you start your first fast to building long-term fasting streaks, Easy Fast keeps you focused, informed, and motivated.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Easy Fast offers a free version with basic fasting tracking. Unlock all features with a Premium subscription:
Weekly, Monthly or Yearly subscription options available
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase
Free users can start and complete fasts, view fasting plans with benefits, and log weight. Premium subscribers get unlimited access to custom plans, advanced insights, hunger management tools, and all premium features.
Privacy Policy: https://easyfastingapp.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://easyfastingapp.com/terms
DISCLAIMER
This app is for informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider before starting any diet, fasting plan, exercise, or health program. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read in this app.

bluejetty:00062042:ios.description:
Enjoy Calcudoku, a fun number puzzle game that tests your math and logic! If you like Killer Sudoku puzzles, you will love Calcudoku!
About Calcudoku number puzzles:
Every Calcudoku has a single solution that can be reached logically. Like Sudoku and Killer Sudoku, fill in the grid such that no two digits repeat in any column or row. Use the shapes in the grid as your guide. Each shape contains a number equaling the product of the shapes' digits. For example a shape with three cells containing the number 6 may have cell values 1, 2 and 3, as 1 × 2 × 3 = 6. Challenge yourself further with larger grids for experts, up to 9x9 size!
Calcudoku offers thousands of fun number puzzles with features to help you solve each puzzle. Enjoy an unlimited number of hints and checks in case you get stuck. Use the calculator tool to help with multiplication and division against large numbers. And rest assured that all puzzle games are automatically saved and restored letting you stop and restart games with ease.
Track your best and average solve times over history with our stats tracker.
Calcudoku, a popular Killer Sudoku variant, was originally invented in 2004 by Japanese math teacher Tetsuya Miyamoto. Also known as KenKen® and Mathdoku, Calcudoku brings to you over 15,000 unique puzzle grids!
You can play Calcudoku by Razzle Puzzles on your phone and tablet. Enjoy Calcudoku online or in offline mode!
For support please contact us at support@razzlepuzzles.com or visit RazzlePuzzles.com

bluejetty:00039800:ios.name: BIMx
bluejetty:00039800:ios.summary: Graphisoft’s BIMx is an interactive app for exploring BIM projects and linked documentation sets created in Archicad, MEP Designer, and DDScad. Please download to visualize or collaborate on architectural design projects on your mobile devi
bluejetty:00039800:ios.description:
Graphisoft’s BIMx is an interactive app for exploring BIM projects and linked documentation sets created in Archicad, MEP Designer, and DDScad. Please download to visualize or collaborate on architectural design projects on your mobile device(s).
BIMx offers professional building visualization with game-like navigation to explore and visualize architectural projects. BIMx features the ‘BIMx hyper-model’ – allowing non-design professionals to explore and fully understand architectural design intent, view project deliverables, and access element-level BIM data. BIMx links the 3D model with the relevant 2D documentation layouts, providing a seamless way to view the 3D cutaway model in the context of a 2D layout — and vice versa.
BIMx connects the construction site with the architect’s office for streamlined collaboration. Real-time model cut-throughs, in-context measuring, and project markups in the model context make BIMx your best on-site BIM companion. Drive the design narrative on the building site for fast, specific client feedback.
Features:
• Hyperlinked 2D & 3D views with interactive markers
• Trace 2D drawings on 3D with animation
• Access project and building component-related BIM information
• Superfast 2D documentation viewer
• Game-like 3D navigation
• Gravity & Egress recognition
• Option to access a Hyper-model element from outside of the app
• Google Cardboard VR support on iPhones
• Real-time 3D cutaway
• Cut Plane Color Picker
• Shading options
• Shadow casting
• Sun positioning by date and time
• Measure in 3D and on 2D layouts
• Explore 3D models of any size thanks to the streaming 3D engine
• Save Favorites
• Create compelling presentations
• Print support, PDF export
• Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad support
BIMx Pro features, available with Graphisoft account-based licensing:
• Issue creation – BCF-based documentation revisioning
• Hide 3D elements and control Layer visibility in the virtual model
• Customizable Cut Plane
Explore the BIMx Pro features with the built-in demo model.
Joining BIMcloud in Hyper-models published from Teamwork projects unlocks messaging and Pro features.
View our Terms of Use: https://graphisoft.com/legal/terms-of-use/bimx-ios
and Privacy Policy: https://graphisoft.com/legal/privacy-policy
Send your comments and suggestions to bimx@graphisoft.com!

bluejetty:00144240:ios.description:
Band together to improve your fitness by competing in a group fitness challenge. Enlist friends, family, teammates, colleagues, or whoever, to become gym rats. More effective than a simple step challenge, the goal is to workout more often; any activity counts.
-How it works-
* Create or join a group challenge
* Invite as many people as you'd like
* Post workouts to the group
* Keep doing that, a lot
* See the leader board and have fun competing
-Flexibility-
The app is free form and allows for creating your own rules of competition. Score by total number of workouts, miles, minutes, calories, steps, or come up with your own point system. All that's required for a workout is a photo and a title. The photo can be of the gym equipment, a sweaty selfie, a screenshot of another app, or whatever your group deems acceptable.
-Accountability-
Don't care about score? No problem, the app can be used as a general group activity log. Keep each other accountable by having a shared space for tracking workouts.
-Integrates with the Apple Health App-
GymRats has the ability to import workouts from the Apple Health app. This not only includes activities recorded on the Apple Watch, but any activity saved to your device.

bluejetty:00065628:ios.name: McNellie's Passport
bluejetty:00065628:ios.summary: Every neighborhood needs a pub. In Tulsa, that pub is James E. McNellie’s Public House (known by the locals simply as McNellie’s). Styled after the Irish pubs that our founder Elliot Nelson fell in love with while studying abroad, McNellie’
bluejetty:00065628:ios.description:
Every neighborhood needs a pub. In Tulsa, that pub is James E. McNellie’s Public House (known by the locals simply as McNellie’s). Styled after the Irish pubs that our founder Elliot Nelson fell in love with while studying abroad, McNellie’s debuted on St. Patricks’ Day 2004. It quickly became the center of the downtown Tulsa community.
Every pub needs a neighborhood. McNellie’s needed neighboring bars and restaurants to really bring the Tulsa community together, so in 2007 the group launched the Tex-Mex sensation El Guapo’s across the street. The Blue Dome district exploded over the next few years with the addition of Dilly Deli (rebranded in 2015 as Dilly Diner), the Asian-fusion flair of Yokozuna, Fassler Hall (a year-round nod to Oktoberfest), and the retro-style Dust Bowl Lanes & Lounge. 
A few blocks north, the Tulsa Arts District was also poised for a resurgence. The Tavern, an upscale interpretation of the modern pub, is a fitting anchor for the burgeoning cultural scene. (If you promise to keep it a secret, we’ll help you get reservations at our speakeasy steakhouse, The Bull in The Alley.) Just a couple blocks down, you’ll find Elgin Park Brewery, which introduced house-brewed beers, New Haven-style pizza, and 50+ screens of sports to downtown Tulsa for the first time when they opened in 2016.

bluejetty:00029711:ios.description:
The Blood Pressure App is an intuitive and user-friendly blood pressure monitoring app designed to help you take charge of your cardiovascular health. Its easy-to-use interface and powerful features empower you to track, analyze, and manage your blood pressure with ease.
Data Entry After Measurement: 
Record your blood pressure measurements after each reading. You can input systolic, diastolic blood pressure, and pulse. The app also allows you to note pills, arrhythmia, and migraine.
Convenient Statistics: 
The App provides comprehensive and insightful statistics that help you understand your blood pressure trends over time. It generates clear, easy-to-read graphs and charts that display your blood pressure history, allowing you to spot patterns and changes at a glance. You can filter data by date ranges to track progress and share your results with your healthcare provider.
Daily Activity Logging: 
Beyond blood pressure monitoring, the app includes a feature for noting your overall well-being and daily activities. You can track factors like stress levels, physical activity, diet, and more. This information can provide valuable context for your blood pressure readings and help you identify lifestyle factors that may be impacting your health.
User-Friendly Interface: 
The app is designed for simplicity and ease of use, making it suitable for users of all ages.
Our Blood Pressure Monitor is your reliable companion in achieving better blood pressure management and a healthier lifestyle. Take control of your heart health and start your journey toward optimal well-being with this powerful and convenient app.
Good health to you!

bluejetty:00065439:ios.description:
MoMo - Trợ thủ tài chính với AI giúp bạn làm được nhiều hơn với tiền
1. Thanh toán tiện lợi
- Nhanh chóng, mọi lúc mọi nơi: Dễ dàng thanh toán tại hàng ngàn điểm, từ cửa hàng đến dịch vụ trực tuyến.
- Dịch vụ đa dạng: Thanh toán hóa đơn, nạp tiền, mua vé, đặt vé máy bay chỉ trong vài giây.
- Liên kết ngân hàng dễ dàng: Hỗ trợ hầu hết các ngân hàng lớn tại Việt Nam.
2. Dịch vụ tài chính đa dạng
- Kiểm soát chi tiêu: Tự động phân loại, nhập chi tiêu nhanh, nhắc nhở tránh chi tiêu quá tay.
- Tiết kiệm linh hoạt: Bắt đầu chỉ từ 10.000 đồng, sinh lời dễ dàng (*).
- Vay nhanh, không cần chứng minh thu nhập: Duyệt trong 1 phút, hạn mức đến 50 triệu đồng (*).
- Đầu tư đơn giản: Số vốn nhỏ, theo dõi dễ dàng trên ứng dụng (*).
3. An toàn & Bảo mật
- Công nghệ bảo mật 5 lớp AI: Bảo vệ tài khoản 24/7, phát hiện và ngăn chặn giao dịch bất thường.
- Đối tác chiến lược của các ngân hàng lớn: Đảm bảo tiêu chuẩn bảo mật cao nhất PCI DSS.
MoMo giúp bạn tiếp cận dịch vụ tài chính dễ dàng, chi phí hợp lý, xây dựng nền tảng tài chính ổn định và cuộc sống tốt hơn.
CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN DỊCH VỤ DI ĐỘNG TRỰC TUYẾN
Địa chỉ: Tòa nhà Phú Mỹ Hưng, số 8 Hoàng Văn Thái, P. Tân Phú, Quận 7, TP. Hồ Chí Minh.
(*) Dịch vụ do đối tác MoMo cung cấp và chịu trách nhiệm.
MoMo sử dụng bộ công cụ và APL HealthKit để truy cập.

bluejetty:00013837:ios.name: OPENLANE US
bluejetty:00013837:ios.summary: The OPENLANE app brings together buyers and sellers in the preferred US marketplace for wholesale used vehicles. Wholesale dealers can seamlessly switch between buying and selling all within one consolidated and easy to navigate app, making
bluejetty:00013837:ios.description:
The OPENLANE app brings together buyers and sellers in the preferred US marketplace for wholesale used vehicles. Wholesale dealers can seamlessly switch between buying and selling all within one consolidated and easy to navigate app, making dealer to dealer car sales easier than ever before. 
OPENLANE’s digital marketplace offers a fast, easy and transparent way to sell and source used and fresh vehicle inventory—anytime, anywhere. We bring together the leading OEMs, dealers, fleet operators, rental companies and financial institutions to match the right buyer with the right car at every price point.
We give you the power to buy or sell your way with OPENLANE’s variety of sale types. Whether you prefer the fast-paced action of the standard online dealer auction format, the flexibility and variety of OPENLANE’s marketplace or the certainty of Absolute Sale, OPENLANE has a sourcing or selling solution for you. 
The OPENLANE Marketplace offers sellers strong results with 110% of book value on average across all price bands, often in less than a day. Thanks to the wholesale industry's first AI-enhanced damage detection feature and the most robust search and filtering capabilities on the market, buyers are able to source inventory faster and with more confidence than ever before—all with the industry’s most competitive fees.
OPENLANE condition reports feature:
- An easy-to-read layout to quickly determine if the vehicle has issues
- Visual Boost AI™, an AI-enhanced exterior detected damage visualization
- Easy-to-read scan codes with Code Boost IQ, engine noise audio files, photos and more
- Complimentary AutoCheckⓇ on all listings
Find all the buyers, all the sellers and all the vehicles right now on the OPENLANE app.

bluejetty:00029778:ios.description:
PopNovel—A Popular Web Novel App
PopNovel, a web novel app, provides you with massive exclusive novels. It contains both the trending novels and the niche ones of high quality. PopNovel is also easy to use! You can download the novels and enjoy an offline, fantastic journey anytime, anywhere!
Massive novels:
PopNovel covers many genres, including Urban Romance, CEO Romance, Fantasy, Werewolf, etc. Get a novel world in your pocket now!
Why Us?
[FAST RELEASING]
You can find numerous authorized exclusive novels on PopNovel. Fast-releasing chapters give you an immersive experience!
[SMART LIBRARY]
Add your favored novels to the library. The sorting feature will make your novels easy to find. Catch up with the latest updates by using Update Reminders! Download the existing chapters and read them while you're unavailable to network. The smart memory feature will mark your reading history. You'll easy to continued reading from your last chapter!
[COMMENTS & SHARING]
Share your comments with other readers! Let others know what you think and make novel friends on PopNovel!
[POWERFUL BOOK SEARCHING]
Use the classification (search) filter function to find novels you like in one second.
[UNLOCK & DOWNLOAD]
Quickly download the subsequent chapters, and read novels without loading.
[RELIABLE ACCOUNT]
Every payment of your vouchers and coins is trackable on PopNovel.
[EASY SIGN-UP]
Safe and convenient sign-up via multiple third party accounts such as Google, Facebook, and email address. If your PopNovel is linked with different third party accounts, you can sign up with any account you like!
[Read more novels]

Youtube：https://www.youtube.com/c/PopNovel
Privacy Policy : https://popnovelh5.popnovel.net/v1/main/privacy_agreement

bluejetty:00187289:ios.summary:

Reminders a
bluejetty:00187289:ios.description:
Reminders is a powerful and easy-to-use app that lets you set up all kinds of reminders. Record your own voice or pick a song from your music library and use it as your notification sound. It will play exactly when you need it.
Reminders are fully configurable: Pre-Alarms, Auto-Snooze, Snooze, Reschedule, Custom Messages, Custom Sounds, Custom Images, Notes and More. Practically any type of reminder can be set.
You can also create custom images with AI to make your reminders even more personal (Available on iOS 26 and later).
Repeat throughout the day
• Repeat every X minutes (Every 20 mins, Every 90 mins)
• Repeat every X hours (Every hour, Every 4 hours)
• Repeat at specific times (9:15, 10:30, 11:50)
Daily
• Repeat every X days (Every day, Every 3 days)
Weekly
• Repeat on selected days of the week (Repeat only on Mondays and Fridays)
• Repeat on weekdays, weekends
• Repeat every X weeks (Every week, Every 2 weeks)
Monthly
• Repeat on selected days of the month (Repeat on the 15th and the 30th)
• Repeat every first Monday of the month
• Repeat every last Friday of the month
Yearly
• Repeat every year (Birthdays, Anniversaries)
Cycle
• Repeat daily for 21 days and then take 7 days off (Birth Control)
• Repeat for 3 consecutive days and then take 2 days off
One-Time
• Set a reminder at a specific date and time
Wake-Up Alarm
• Wake up at 8:00 on weekdays
• Wake up at 9:00 on weekends
Main Features
• Easy to use for everyone
• Use your own voice as the reminder sound. It will play at the scheduled time
• Pick a song from your music library and set it as the reminder sound
• The Auto-Snooze feature allows the alarm to repeat up to 5 times at regular intervals (e.g. 1 min, 10 mins, 30 mins) until you take action
• Snooze a reminder or mark it as "Done" directly from the lock screen or notification banner
• Pre-Alarms: Receive up to 5 notifications before the scheduled date
• Add images or photos to each reminder for easy identification, or create custom images with AI (Available on iOS 26 and later)
• Reschedule reminders to a new time and date in the future
• It has a calendar to view all reminders by month
• Easy one-tap option to turn individual reminders on or off
• Option to pause all reminders when you don't want to be disturbed
• Backup and restore reminders on the same device or multiple devices
• More than 90 built-in images
• 32 built-in alarm sounds
General
• Critical Alerts support
• VoiceOver accessibility support
• Dark Mode
• Automatically adjusts to the font size selected on the device
• Notifications are local. No internet connection required
• App doesn't need to be open to receive notifications
• Universal App, full native support for iPhone and iPad
Free Version
• In the free version you can only add up to 3 reminders
• Full version with unlimited reminders is available as an In-App Purchase
• One-Time payment. No monthly or annual fees

bluejetty:00199651:android.description:
China Bank Mobile App is a FREE app that lets you access your China Bank account 24/7 using your smart phone.
Manage your finances and do more with China Bank Mobile at your fingertips –
. Balance inquiry
. Pay your bills
. Transfer funds
. Access to Emergency Cash. Soon, you can withdraw in any BancNet ATM without a China Bank ATM card.
. Send money to anyone (Coming soon.)
China Banking Corporation (Philippines), more popularly known as China Bank, initially catered to the needs of the Filipino-Chinese community. Established in 1920, the Bank was a vital key player in the reconstruction and economic recovery of the country after World War II. In 1927, China Bank was listed in the local stock exchange and in 1969 became the first local bank to process deposit accounts online. In 1991, the bank procured its universal banking license.
Today, China Bank is one of largest private universal banks in the Philippines. bluejetty:00168350:ios.description:
Redesign any room in seconds with DecAI®. Take or upload a photo, choose a style, or chat with your DecAI® Design Agent to visualize personalized home designs and remodel ideas in any style.
DecAI® is built on advanced AI models, including Stable Diffusion, ControlNet, LoRA, Nano Banana, and Google Gemini technologies. These engines help you redesign interiors, visualize renovations, replace furniture, and create personalized room transformations with ease.
KEY FEATURES
Your Personal AI Design Agent.
Simply describe what you have in mind in your own words. Tell DecAI what you want to create or change—from a warmer, more modern living room to a cozy Mediterranean backyard. Ask it to adjust furniture, colors, layouts, decorations, and more, then keep chatting to refine the result until it feels right. 
AI Interior Design
- Empty Room Design
Have an empty room but no idea how to design it? Upload a photo, choose a style and let DecAI create a complete space with realistic furniture, lighting, colors, and decor that match your vision.
- Room Restyle
Choose from 100+ styles, from modern and cozy to minimalist and luxury, and let DecAI transform your room while keeping your original layout.
- Style Transfer
Upload a reference image and let DecAI match its style, colors, and atmosphere to your own space before making real changes.
AI Outdoor Design
- Exterior Design
Give your home a completely new look by exploring different architectural styles, exterior colors, materials, finishes, and details. Upload your house photo and see potential renovations before making a commitment.
- Garden Design
Upload a garden, backyard, or patio photo and visualize landscaping ideas with plants, paths, seating areas, outdoor decor, and different garden styles.
Smart Home Editing
- New Walls
Want to refresh your walls without picking up a paintbrush? Upload your room photo and preview different wall colors, textures, and materials before making a renovation decision.
- New Flooring
Thinking about new flooring? Upload your room photo and try hardwood, tile, stone, and more to see how different floors transform your space before installation.
- Replace & Add Furniture
Want to try a new sofa, table, lamp, cabinet, or decor item? Describe what you want to replace or add, and let AI create a realistic update that fits your space.
- Room Declutter & Furniture Removal
Too much clutter or outdated furniture getting in the way? Remove unwanted objects, sofas, tables, cabinets, beds, and more to clear your space, see its potential, and prepare it for a fresh new design. 
PERFECT FOR
- New homeowners planning a renovation or redesign
- Renters decorating without permanent changes
- Real estate agents creating fast virtual staging
- Interior design enthusiasts and DIY decorators

Looking for a fast, intelligent, and easy-to-use way to identify stones and minerals around you? Discover the ultimate app for rock identification, crystal
bluejetty:00116145:ios.description:
Rock Scanner App: Instantly Identify, Learn & Locate Rocks, Minerals, and Crystals
Looking for a fast, intelligent, and easy-to-use way to identify stones and minerals around you? Discover the ultimate app for rock identification, crystal discovery, and gemstone analysis — your smart pocket companion for uncovering the secrets of nature.
With cutting-edge AI technology, this app turns your smartphone into a powerful rock scanner, mineral identifier, and gemstone detector.
Scan any object — from a polished gem, rough crystal, or simple rock — and get instant, detailed information, including:
- Stone name & type
- Hardness and crystal structure
- Chemical composition
- Real vs. fake gemstone detection
- Detailed description and historical facts
- Origin map & typical growth location
Whether you're analyzing amethyst, titanite, fluorite, quartz, garnet, opal, jasper, malachite, pyrite, agate, or turquoise, the app gives you in-depth data for every specimen.
Key Features:
• Rock Identifier & Crystal Scanner – Instantly identify any rock, mineral, or gem
• AI-Powered Mineral Identification – Fast, accurate scanning using the latest AI geology tools
• Interactive Stone Map – Discover where the stone was found and learn its geographical origins
• Metal Detector & Magnetic Rock Finder – Detect metal-rich rocks like magnetite, hematite, or iron-based minerals
• Crystal & Gem Analyzer – Learn about colors, luster, clarity, and more
• Personal Rock Collection Manager – Save and organize your scanned rocks with notes, photos, and ID checker
• Educational Geology Insights – Learn how and where crystals form, their uses, and how to spot fake stones
• Global Ore Locator – Understand typical stone formations in different areas using an AI-powered geology map
Explore Like a Pro
Whether you're a rockhound, crystal collector, geology student, or just curious about a shiny stone you found — this is the app for you. Use it during hikes, garden digs, beach trips, or museum visits.
From identifying rare gemstones like titanite and spinel to scanning common minerals such as feldspar or calcite, our app helps you see the unseen, understand what lies beneath, and explore the natural world like never before.
Why Users Love It:
• Simple and intuitive interface
• Fast and reliable scanning
• High-quality database of stones, rocks, and minerals
• Built-in support for gemstone enthusiasts, rock collectors, and explorers
• Perfect for metal detecting, mineral hunting, or educational use
Download now and start your adventure through the world of rocks, crystals, minerals, and gemstones. Whether you're chasing hidden treasures or just want to learn something new, this app is your essential tool.

Privacy Policy: https://codabrasoft.com/home/privacy-html

bluejetty:00070670:ios.summary:
Take command of your ship in Idle Space Force! Blast your way through this retro incremental space shoot ‘em up, upgrade your ship, and travel to scenic and dangerous planets, collecting a passive income for your fleet!
Idle Space Force is
bluejetty:00070670:ios.description:
Take command of your ship in Idle Space Force! Blast your way through this retro incremental space shoot ‘em up, upgrade your ship, and travel to scenic and dangerous planets, collecting a passive income for your fleet!
Idle Space Force is a retro idle tapper with the perfect blend of idle and RPG mechanics inspired by the classics like Space Invaders and Asteroids. Collect your ISF credits while offline and blast through seven unique worlds with classic shmup gameplay. Prestige your way through Deep Space upgrades and travel to never before seen worlds!
Idle Gameplay
Generate income as you cruise AFK or battle hordes of enemies through space! Your ship’s progress continues while offline, letting you pick up the action wherever you are in the universe.
Action-Packed Battles
Engage in intense pixelated retro space battles as you face relentless enemies from across the galaxy. With classic mechanics of the staple shoot ‘em up / shmup genre, you’ll be filling the screen with bombs and bees in a flash – battling enemy ships, enemy hornets, and enemy bosses. Gameplay inspired by 8 bit classics like Space Invaders and Asteroids.
Upgrade Your Ship
Kit out your ship with powerful upgrades and frontier technologies to unleash devastating firepower. Collect income like an idle game while offline, then add missiles, magnetism, and more to your vessel. Looking for even more firepower? Prestige your way to the ultimate unlocks and blast away the competition!
Explore the Cosmos
Vast worlds await you in the expanses of space. Uncover hidden treasures, acquire new upgrades and confront challenging bosses. From the outskirts of deep space to the remnants of the Terran homeworld, there are many unique challenges along the way.
Addictive Experience
With simple yet engaging gameplay mechanics, Idle Space Force offers endless entertainment for both casual players and hardcore enthusiasts alike. The mix of idle game mechanics and shoot 'em up action ensures that even when you’re not working – you’re always on the clock!
Ready to conquer the cosmos? Download Idle Space Force now and embark on an epic retro idle shmup journey!

bluejetty:00115856:ios.description:
Roll, raid, and rule the board!
Welcome to Coin Master: Board Adventure, where every dice roll takes you closer to riches, revenge, and all-out fun! Collect coins, attack villages, build your empire, and explore wild new boards full of surprises. It’s not just a board game - it’s a bold adventure!
ROLL THE DICE, MAKE YOUR MOVE
Every roll brings a new opportunity. Land on coin tiles to stack your fortune, shields to protect your village, or raid tiles to steal from your Coin Master friends! Just like a real board game, your strategy—and a little luck—will decide your fate.
BUILD YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Use your loot to upgrade buildings, complete themed villages, and grow your collection. From fantasy kingdoms to tropical getaways, every board you explore unlocks new worlds to conquer.
ROLL AND ATTACK
Landing on the attack tile? Time to strike! Attack villages across the map, break through defenses, and send your rivals back to square one. It's payback with a bonus.
COLLECT COINS, RAID FRIENDS
Raid your friends’ boards and dig up massive treasures. Want more? Steal coins, disrupt their progress, and climb the ranks. Being nice won’t win you this game!
COLLECT CARDS, COMPLETE SETS
Love collecting? Get hooked on rare card games! Gather themed cards as you play, complete sets, and earn powerful rewards. Trade with friends to finish your collection faster.
PLAY CASUAL, COMPETE HARD
Whether you're in for a quick spin or an all-day binge, Coin Master: Board Adventure delivers fun at your own pace. Play solo or team up with friends to swap cards, trade boosts, and dominate events together!
Why Players Love Coin Master: Board Adventure:
- Exciting roll and attack gameplay
- Strategic board movement
- Build epic villages and unlock new boards
- Collect coins and spend them wisely
- Battle friends
- Fun and competitive casual game style
- Exciting card collecting and trading
- Constant events, bonuses, and surprises
It’s your turn.
Are you ready to roll your way to glory, fortune, and board domination?
Download Coin Master: Board Adventure now and become the master of the board!

bluejetty:00041373:ios.description:
TokenPocket, your secure crypto wallet to explore blockchain.
- Security is Our Core
● You Have Full Control Over Your Assets: TokenPocket only generates and stores private keys and secret phrases on your device, ensuring that you are the only one who can access them. Your keys, your coins.
● Comprehensive Security Protection: TokenPocket provides multiple layers of security, including Passphrase, hardware cold wallets, and multi-signature wallets, giving you flexible security options.
● Trusted Globally: Over 25 million users worldwide trust TokenPocket, with coverage in more than 200 countries and regions, ensuring the safety of your assets.
-Effortless Exploration of the Crypto World
● Supports 1000+ Major Blockchains: Whether it's Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Chain, TRON, or TON, Solana, Arbitrum, Polygon, Dogecoin, Sui, and more, you can easily create, import, or sync your wallet. It fully supports all EVM-compatible blockchains and Layer 2 solutions.
● Manage Millions of Cryptocurrencies: Easily manage over a million tokens, such as BTC, ETH, BNB, TRX, USDT, USDC, SOL, DOGE, and more. All your assets are managed in one place with TokenPocket.
- Simple to Use, Thoughtfully Designed
● Gas-Free Stablecoin Transfers: Even if your account has no Gas, you can transfer stablecoins via the TRON network. Support for BSC and other EVM blockchains is coming soon.
● Smart Security Alerts: TokenPocket provides token safety detection, authorization checks, and reminders, offering comprehensive protection for your transactions and ensuring safe usage.
Download TokenPocket now and start your secure and convenient journey into the blockchain world!

bluejetty:00015130:ios.description:
A family-friendly cooking game loved worldwide!
[You'll learn to love cooking!]
Chop, bake, stew...
Cook tasty meals with easy touch controls!
Try out this unique cooking game.
The yummy food you'll create will definitely make you hungry!
▼Let's Cook!
Cook food by playing fun mini games. More than 30 kinds of recipes are waiting for you. Do your best, Special Chef!
▼Happy Village!
Serve your cooking to everyone at your restaurant. Create a big and wonderful restaurant that's all your own.
Harvest lots of things by going Fishing, growing plants in the Fields, and raising animals in your Ranch.
Gather up lots to exchange for Happy Foods!
▼Game Plaza!
Play non-cooking games like "Help out," "Play Shopkeeper," and "Exercise your brain." More than 30 kinds of mini games are waiting for you. Aim to get high scores!

Compete in weekly events for the best scores! Join the global rankings!

With its intuitive controls, both children and adults can enjoy the game. Also, even if you make mistakes there are no game overs, so everyone can complete dishes. Furthermore, children who play may develop an interest in cooking.

iOS 13 or later.

bluejetty:00081026:ios.name: Detective, Find Differences
bluejetty:00081026:ios.summary: Differences is an interesting find difference spot puzzle game! This find difference spot game is to find all the differences between two pictures! There are thousands of find difference levels with different difficult, you can find 5 diffe
bluejetty:00081026:ios.description:
Differences is an interesting find difference spot puzzle game! This find difference spot game is to find all the differences between two pictures! There are thousands of find difference levels with different difficult, you can find 5 differences, find 6 hidden differences, and so on.
Why this find difference spot game is a better choice than many other find differences games?
Thousands of Different Pictures
There are thousands of different pictures of find differences levels in this game. You can start from 5 differences, and become a professional finder by solving harder levels. These amazing colorful pictures include cartoons, animals, food, rooms, beautiful views, and so on. The common levels are very relaxing and have no timer. And you can use hints to find hidden differences if you find they are hard.
Detective
Do you like to be a detective in real life? There are many cases waiting for you to solve. There are hidden differences in the pictures before and after a case scene, you can find out the importance clues from the differences. After you find all the important clues in the cases, you will find the truth. The cases are very interesting, find differences helps you to improve your detective and observation abilities and train your brain.
Challenge & Special Levels
This differences puzzle game has many challenge levels and special levels to challenge your mind. 
- There is a flashlight mode, which will give you a flashlight to find the hidden differences spots in night. 
- There is a time model, which will limit the time to finish the levels. 
- The special levels have more difference spots than other common levels. 
Jigsaw Puzzle
While playing find difference puzzle games, you can collect jigsaw puzzle fragments. After collecting all the fragments of a painting, you will get a painting displaying in your studio. Many paintings composed of jigsaw fragments waiting for you to unlock.
Differences - Find difference spot is so interesting and addictive; it helps to train your brain, relax your mood, and develop your focus ability and memory. Download and relax it now!

bluejetty:00063956:ios.name: Quartermaster
bluejetty:00063956:ios.summary:
Quartermaster is the management app for tabletop miniature games that knows how to play nice.
As a wargamer, you're constantly thinking about new ways to assemble an army, force, or squadron for your favorite miniature games. Now you’ll be
bluejetty:00063956:ios.description:
Quartermaster is the management app for tabletop miniature games that knows how to play nice.
As a wargamer, you're constantly thinking about new ways to assemble an army, force, or squadron for your favorite miniature games. Now you’ll be ready to draft your ideas whenever inspiration strikes. And when gaming time comes, you’ll have all your miniatures in order. No more loose pages and scribbled notes!
Quartermaster uses game systems and faction templates created by a community of wargamers just like you. You can create and edit your own factions right in the app. The list of community-created games for Quartermaster continues to grow, and currently includes the following tabletop miniature games:
- Warhammer: The Old World
- Horus Heresy (all editions)
- Necromunda
- Warhammer Fantasy Battles
- Warhammer 40,000 (2nd and 3rd Edition)
- Trench Crusade
- and more!
Quartermaster is constantly evolving to bring you the latest technologies and the best user experience.
- iCloud automatically syncs your drafts across your devices.
- Share your drafts with your friends (and opponents!) by AirDrop, social media, email, or message.
- Prepare a detailed list or card grid for printing.
Play nice. Use Quartermaster.

bluejetty:00120047:ios.description:
The app Daycare Diary is the simplest, most practical and safest way to follow your kids’ day by day in kindergarten or daycare. Forget the outdated paper diaries, you can use your mobile phone and access your kids’ diary in real time wherever you are!
With Daycare Diary you have all the necessary features to track your kids’ daily activities in the palm of your hand:
* Diary: track your kids’ activities. Did they do all the tasks? Were them excited or bored? Did they play with the classmates? Did they have all meals? Did they eat enough or just a little? Did they pee or poop?
* Messages: send a message straight to your kids’ teacher or to daycare principal and be notified when you receive a response.
* Calendar: receive invitations for events that will happen at your kids’ kindergarten or daycare. Be notified once you receive a new invitation. Inform your attendance by accepting or rejecting the invitations.
* Medicines: tell the teacher the medicines your kids are taking, in which time they should be given and at what dose. Send a picture of the prescription.
* Data: enter the most important data about your kids. What are their allergies? Do they have a health insurance plan? Who is authorized to pick them up? What are their birthdays?
The Daycare Diary app is available for free for parents. If your kids’ kindergarten or daycare doesn’t have the Daycare Diary yet, ask them to get in touch with us!

bluejetty:00018448:ios.description:
The United Mississippi Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact United Mississippi Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the United Mississippi Bank App, you must be enrolled as a United Mississippi Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00067605:ios.description:
It’s League of Legends by Riot Games, now built from the ground up for mobile PvP battles. Dive into Wild Rift’s fast-paced multiplayer strategy games with smooth controls and endless online battle arena action.
Team up with friends in epic PvP gameplay, lock in your champion, and go for the big plays in a legendary multiplayer battle arena. 
Download League of Legends: Wild Rift and prepare for battle. Ready when you are!
STRATEGY IS KEY - OUTPLAY, OUTSMART, OUTSKILL
- Strategize and execute on masterful plans to become a MOBA legend on the Rift.
- Champions, objectives, items, and even the battle arena itself will change up your moment-to-moment decisions, as well as your end-game goals.
- Compete in high-stakes, PvP battles where your strategy and skills will be put to the ultimate test.
- Fast-paced game sessions give you more chances to land the perfect skill shot, turn the tides in a crazy teamfight, or pull off that sweet, sweet pentakill.
- No two games are the same! 
TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS ONLINE
- A 5v5 action MOBA where teamwork makes the dream work.
- Gather your squad and climb the ladder as a duo, trio, or full five-stack—one enemy nexus at a time.
- Invite friends through social channels to compete in wild PvP arena battles!
- Climb up leaderboards and start a guild to achieve more rewards together!
CHAMPIONS RISE UP
- 80+ champions with diverse and unique ways to play, with more on the way!
- A rogue assassin vs. a literal mountain. A warrior of sunlight vs. a mermaid. A treasure hunter vs. a blind monk. Experience innovative gameplay across wholly unique champions.
- Familiar favorites like Akali, Seraphine, Jinx, Caitlyn, Vi, Jayce, and more champions from the League of Legends PC title, faithfully adapted to play great on mobile!
- Whatever you want your legend to be, there’s a champ waiting for you.
PREMIUM MOBILE MOBA EXPERIENCE
- Stunning visuals, beautiful graphics, and vibrant characters.
- Multiplayer game modes, champions, and skins are constantly updated.
- The 5v5 battles of League of Legends, optimized for an epic mobile experience.
- Ever-changing, high-quality content.
FREE TO PLAY, ALWAYS FAIR
- Skill level and party size are a priority in matchmaking balance for each mobile battle.
- Earn all champions for free in Wild Rift just by playing! There will never be exclusively purchasable champions.
- No intrusive ads. No paying for power. No paying for play time. Ever.
Go for the big plays in the ultimate battle arena competition. Experience the action-packed gameplay Riot Games is known for with League of Legends: Wild Rift.

bluejetty:00141945:ios.description:
Symlex VPN helps protect your internet connection with secure protocols and privacy-focused features.
Eligible new users receive 5 days of Premium access without adding a card or payment method. The trial ends automatically and does not convert into a paid subscription.
Connect through 1,000+ servers across 100+ locations. At home, while traveling, or on public Wi-Fi, Symlex VPN helps keep your connection private, secure, and reliable.
WHY CHOOSE SYMLEX VPN?
• 5-day Premium trial with no card required
• 1,000+ servers across 100+ locations
• Unlimited bandwidth
• AnyConnect, WireGuard, V2Ray, and OpenVPN protocols
• Kill switch (On Demand)
• DNS leak protection
• Smart server selection
• Connect up to 10 devices simultaneously
• 24/7 customer support
Features, protocols, and servers may vary by device, location, and network.
PRIVATE AND SECURE BROWSING
Symlex VPN encrypts your connection and helps protect your IP address on mobile data, home Wi-Fi, and public networks.
BUILT FOR DIFFERENT NETWORK CONDITIONS
Network conditions vary by location and provider. Multiple protocols let you select a suitable option, while smart server selection makes connecting simple.
TRAVEL, COMMUNICATION, GAMING, AND STREAMING
Symlex VPN supports browsing, secure communication, gaming, streaming, downloads, and other online activities.
Service performance and availability may vary by location, network, provider, and third-party terms.
PREMIUM ACCESS AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
After the trial, selected free servers remain available. You can purchase Premium for the complete Premium server network and additional features.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when your purchase is confirmed. Auto-renewing subscriptions renew according to the selected billing period unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple Account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings. Prices, billing periods, plans, and benefits appear before purchase and may vary by region.
EASY TO GET STARTED
1. Download Symlex VPN.
2. Create or sign in to your account.
3. Verify your email address.
4. Choose a server location.
5. Tap Connect.
ACCOUNT DELETION
You can request deletion of your Symlex VPN account directly within the app. Associated account data is permanently deleted, except where retention is required for security, fraud prevention, financial obligations, or legal compliance. Applicable retention practices are explained in our Privacy Policy.
PRIVACY AT SYMLEX VPN
Symlex VPN processes limited information required to operate, secure, support, and improve the service. Depending on the features you use, this may include your email address, subscription status, device model, operating system, and app version.
Optional de-identified diagnostic information may be collected with your consent to identify technical issues and improve app performance. This information is not linked to your account or device.
Symlex VPN does not store logs of your browsing history, DNS queries, traffic destinations, or traffic content. Your IP address is processed temporarily to establish a VPN connection, but Symlex VPN does not retain activity logs linking it to your online activity. Symlex VPN does not sell your personal information.
NEED HELP?
Our support team is available 24/7 for questions about setup, connections, accounts, subscriptions, and features.
Privacy Policy:
https://symlexvpn.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service:
https://symlexvpn.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00128022:ios.description:
Buddy is back to help you unwind and bring some lighthearted fun to your day! Enjoy the remastered classic with Buddy, everyone’s favorite stress-relief doll, designed to help you let off some steam. Customize, interact, and get creative with Buddy in a playful experience that’s packed with surprises.
Simply tap, drag, and throw Buddy around the screen in an intuitive gameplay experience. You can start by stretching Buddy’s limbs, tossing him against walls, or testing his endurance in new and entertaining ways. As you continue to interact with Buddy, you’ll earn coins to unlock an incredible variety of tools, effects, and items that offer endless ways to play. Each interaction brings you closer to unlocking more dynamic experiences as Buddy brings his unique personality to life with funny reactions and sound effects.
Collect coins to unlock over fifty different items! From classic tools to creative gadgets, each item adds a new level of fun. Every interaction with Buddy is a chance to relax, be entertained, and enjoy some stress-free moments, whether you’re unlocking new costumes, testing out a range of props, or exploring the new achievements.
Key Features:
– Remastered Visuals: Enjoy updated colorful graphics that bring Buddy to life like never before
– Enhanced Physics: Buddy’s reactions are more realistic, making interactions fun and satisfying
– Interactive Props: Unlock and experiment with a wide variety of items that create unique reactions every time
– Wardrobe Updates: Customize Buddy with a brand-new selection of fashionable outfits
– New Sound Effects & Voice: Buddy’s reactions now include hilarious sound effects and voice lines for added fun
– Achievements & Rewards: Collect achievements as you explore all the playful ways to interact with Buddy
Whether you’re looking to unwind after a busy day or just want some light-hearted entertainment, Kick the Buddy: Second Kick is the perfect way to play. Start your journey with Buddy and see where the fun takes you! Download now and enjoy Buddy’s delightful company anytime, anywhere.

DRUID is a test for personal and workplace use that measures impairment of cognitive and motor functions. Users chose between either the 1-minute Rapid Druid Test or the 3-minute Benchmark Druid Test.
Start your free 14-day trial today.
DRUID applies neuroscience research to bring you a sophisticated tool that detects and measures cognitive and motor impairment from any cause, including from cannabis, illicit or prescription drugs, alcohol, fatigue, illness, chronic condition, concussion, severe emotional stress, or injury. Are your employees fit for duty? A version of DRUID that includes management controls is also available for the workplace. Impaired employees, including those under the influence of alcohol or drugs, have slower reflexes and impaired balance. Impaired physical coordination, mental acuity and decision-making results in inefficient or incompetent work, reducing productivity and exposing employees and co-workers to far greater risk of injury or even death.
Please note DRUID App is a utility application. DRUID app is not a medical app.

bluejetty:00175613:ios.description:
Welcome to experience Serene, where we offer various scenes and sounds to help you achieve deep relaxation, enhance focus, and find inner calm in different situations. Whether you need assistance with falling asleep, staying focused at work, or simply escaping the hustle and bustle of the world, Serene has you covered.
Key Features:
- Multiple Scene Options: Choose from settings like a campsite, beach, room, or temple, each offering a unique experience.
- Over 30 Sound Choices: Includes sounds such as rustling leaves, raindrops, ocean waves, and natural bird songs, with hundreds of combinations for you to select.
- Versatile Functions: Aid in falling asleep, boosting concentration, reducing stress, and improving mental well-being, among other benefits.
- Timer: Set a duration for the white noise playback, and it will automatically turn off, saving energy and ensuring peace of mind.
- User-Friendly: An intuitive interface allows you to easily adjust sound and scenes, so you can enjoy tranquility whenever you desire.
Serene is your ideal choice for achieving inner peace and improving your quality of life. Download Serene and let white noise transport you to a serene world, offering relaxation and focus at your fingertips. Begin your Serene journey now!
Serene also provides beautiful widgets, making it easy for you to access the white noise experience without opening the app. These widgets not only enhance aesthetics but also improve convenience, with the following key features:
1. Quick Access: Add Serene widgets to your home screen, allowing you to launch your favorite scenes and sounds with a single tap, eliminating the need to open the app.
2. Customization Options: Select your most frequently used scene and sound combinations and add them to the widgets for quick access to your favorite settings.
3. Auto-Switching Mode: Serene widgets support automatic switching modes, enabling you to enjoy different sounds and scenes at different times, such as using a focus scene during work and a sleep aid scene at night.
Serene's widgets make it easier for you to immerse yourself in a state of tranquility and focus without the hassle of complex operations, enhancing the harmony and efficiency of your life. Customize your widgets to meet your needs and elevate your quality of life.
"Auto-Subscription Membership Information":
1. Service Name: Serene Quarterly Subscription
2. Price: $1.99 per quarter for the continuous package
3. Your account will be charged from your iTunes account 24 hours before the end of each monthly subscription period. If the charge is successful, your subscription will be automatically extended for another subscription cycle.
4. To cancel the subscription, please manually open the "Settings" on your Apple device, go to "iTunes & App Store," tap on your "Apple ID," select "View Apple ID," enter "Account Settings," and then tap "Subscriptions." Choose the Serene membership service and cancel the subscription at least 24 hours before the subscription period ends. If you do not cancel the subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, it will be automatically renewed.

bluejetty:00126098:ios.description:
Car Camera DVR: Personal Dash Cam Without Extra Hardware
Turn your iPhone or iPod touch into a smart Car DVR recorder and GPS blackbox—no additional hardware required.
Car Camera DVR helps you capture every drive, from everyday commutes to long road trips, with useful overlays and recording controls for safety, evidence, and memories.
KEY FEATURES
FRONT & BACK CAMERA RECORDING
- Record with rear camera and optional front camera together.
- Enable or disable front camera anytime from Settings.
VIDEO SETTINGS
- Audio recording on/off.
- Multiple resolution options: Low, Medium, High, 640x480, 1280x720, and 1920x1080.
- Auto-save video segments by selected duration.
- Adjustable frame rate: 15, 20, 25, or 30 FPS.
DISPLAY SETTINGS
- Show/hide timestamp on videos.
- Show/hide speed overlay while driving.
- Display GPS coordinates on recordings.
- Choose speed unit: KM/H or MPH.
STORAGE & STATS
- Check app and device memory usage.
- View available storage in real time.
- Instantly clear all recordings when needed.
VIDEO HISTORY
- Browse recorded videos with duration and timestamp details.
- In-app playback with one tap.
- Quickly delete old or unnecessary files.
TRIP HISTORY
- Review past driving sessions in one place.
- Track your route-based driving records for better journey insights.
AI DRIVING SCORE & TRIP SCORE
- Get an AI-powered Driving Score based on driving behavior and consistency.
- View Trip Score for each journey to understand trip quality at a glance.
- Use smart score insights to improve driving habits over time.
CLOUD VIDEO BACKUP
- Securely back up videos to the cloud.
- Access recordings anytime, anywhere.
- Keep your data safe even after device reset or replacement.
USER PROFILE
- Create and manage your personal profile.
- Sync preferences and cloud content for a personalized experience.
PREMIUM ACCESS
Car Camera DVR is free to use, with optional premium subscriptions:
- Lifetime
- Monthly (auto-renewable)
- Yearly (auto-renewable)
Subscriptions are available on iOS and can be managed or canceled anytime from your Apple ID account settings.
Use Cases
- HD Car Camera for daily driving footage
- GPS Blackbox with real-time driving data
- Evidence recorder for incidents and insurance/legal support
- Smarter driving improvement with AI score-based trip insights
Terms of Use: https://www.guruinfomedia.com/apps/apple/carcamera/terms.html
