bluejetty:00184618:ios.description:
Grow a tiny village into a mighty empire! In Travian Kingdoms, you'll journey to an ancient land of warring realms, where you can forge kingdoms, conduct diplomacy, or wage war – the choice is yours!
Now you can play one of the most popular multiplayer games (strategy MMOG) worldwide on your iPhone or iPad! A community of more than 1.5 million players awaits -- will you join them or fight them?
In Travian Kingdoms, you can either play as a KING, VICE KING, DUKE, or GOVERNOR. As king, you'll lead your troops into battle, recruiting and supplying massive armies to vanquish your enemies. As governor, you can upgrade your village into a flourishing, prosperous city. And you can always reach for the crown yourself!
Choose a Gaul, Teuton, or Roman tribe, each with radically different playstyles, then get your hands on valuable resources by raiding ROBBER CAMPS. Upgrade and send your hero on legendary missions! Establish additional villages and BESIEGE other players' settlements with your military. Or join secret societies and forge kingdoms with other players.
TEAMWORK is essential in Travian Kingdoms – it's the only way to win! By employing the right strategy, you can be the first to build and defend one of the Wonders of the World. The kingdom with the most points will be VICTORIOUS!
If you like these features, download the game now:
• UNIQUE TRIBES: Choose from three distinct tribes, with over 10 unique units and 35 buildings.
• BE THE HERO: Control a powerful hero, choose skill points, and discover over 25 powerful items and more than 30 unique pieces of equipment.
• MASSIVELY MULTIPLAYER: Dozens of massive game worlds host thousands of players at a time.
• ONLINE 24/7: Game worlds last from weeks up to six months, and players are active around the clock.
• UNIQUE WORLDS: Every game world can have a different set of rules.
• DAILY QUESTS: Thrilling adventures await – grab bonuses and advantages in this build-up strategy game.
• EPIC HISTORY: Dedicated players play dozens of rounds over the years.
Travian Kingdoms can be downloaded and installed free of charge. However, some game features can only be purchased with real money. If you don't wish to use this feature, please deactivate in-app purchases in your device's settings. A network connection is required.

bluejetty:00131339:ios.summary:
I started Superfan because music didn’t feel personal anymore.
Streaming made everything available. But it made me feel distant from the artists I love and the friends I used to share music with.
So I built a home for my music life: stats
bluejetty:00131339:ios.description:
I started Superfan because music didn’t feel personal anymore.
Streaming made everything available. But it made me feel distant from the artists I love and the friends I used to share music with.
So I built a home for my music life: stats, concerts, vinyl and friends.
Join 500,000 fans using Superfan to track their music lives and show up for the moments that matter.
SHARE YOUR MUSIC
- automatically track what you listen to from Spotify and Apple Music
- react, comment, and start conversations around what your friends are hearing
- discover new artists through people you actually trust
because algorithms shouldn't decide what you love.
GET YOUR WEEKLY RECAP
- your top artists, albums, and songs from the past week
- a weekly vibe that captures your listening identity
- see your friends' recaps and comment on them
because your listening history tells a story.
FOLLOW THE ARTISTS YOU LOVE
- see your full history with them over time
- understand your place in their fanbase
- show up for releases, tours, and the moments that matter
because supporting artists should feel real.
TRACK YOUR CONCERTS
- log every show and festival you attend
- tag your friends and upload photos from the night
- get reminded about your memories every year on the anniversary
because concerts shouldn't disappear into your camera roll.
LOG YOUR VINYL COLLECTION
- catalogue your vinyl, CDs, and cassettes
- tag friends when you play something
- see what your friends are spinning
because physical music matters more than ever.
SOUNDTRACK OF THE WEEK
- choose one song that defines your week
- see what defined your friends'
- build a timeline of your life, told through music
because everyone's life has a score.
GROUPS WITH FRIENDS
- create private groups with the people you listen with
- earn awards for top listener, saddest songs, and more
because music is better together.
Streaming made music endless.
Superfan makes it meaningful again.
---
Privacy Policy: https://superfan.social/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://superfan.social/terms-of-use
Feedback & Support: support@superfan.social

bluejetty:00095899:ios.description:
Meet WellMe – Your Everyday Wellness Companion!
Step into a smarter, simpler way to care for your health — right from your phone.
WellMe is designed to make tracking your health effortless and enjoyable. Ditch guesswork and complicated setups, just a friendly app that helps you stay mindful of your body, your habits, and your wellness goals — all in one place.
Whether you're logging your heart rate after a jog, recording your blood pressure or exploring healthy recipes, WellMe turns daily check-ins into daily wins.
Track, Learn, and Improve Your Wellness – All in One App
Disclaimer: WellMe is not intended for diagnosis, treatment, or prevention of any medical condition. All features are designed for general wellness and informational purposes only. Please consult a licensed healthcare provider for medical concerns. Data entered or scanned is stored securely and used only with your consent.
Features:
 • Health Logging Made Simple
Gain real-time insight into your heart's rhythm, including heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV), to stay aware of how your body responds throughout the day. Record essential health indicators like blood pressure, oxygen saturation, glucose levels, body temperature, and weight to build a personal wellness history over time. Spot trends, notice changes, and reflect on how stress, movement, and routine habits may influence your overall well-being. Use visual charts and wellness goals to stay engaged with your health and support mindful daily choices.
• Smart Calorie & Nutrition Tracker
Log your meals and snacks with ease. Track your calories, macronutrients (proteins, carbs, fats), and portion sizes. Automatically calculate exercise-based calorie output to better understand your daily energy balance.
• Food Scanner with Instant Insights
Scan food labels or log meals to instantly view calories, nutrition info, and a smart health score — making food choices easier every time. Every scan helps you make quicker, more informed choices when eating at home or on the go.
• Your Wellness Inspiration Hub
Access daily wellness reads, science-backed health tips, easy and nutritious recipes, and calming audio content. Get AI-powered beauty previews and chat with our smart Health Assistant for lifestyle ideas on your journey — whether you're building healthy habits or just curious about better choices.
Your body. Your data. Your WellMe.
 Download now and stay on top of your health — every single day.
Why Go Premium?
Unlock the full potential of your health journey with the Premium plan. Gain unlimited access to all tracking features, detailed health trend insights, and advanced food scan results. Stay organized, stay informed, and stay motivated every day.
 · Your iTunes Account will be charged once the purchase is confirmed.
 · Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal anytime in your Account Settings. To prevent being charged for the next billing cycle, be sure to cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
Terms of Service: https://www.urbanwallmobile.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.urbanwallmobile.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00074210:ios.description:
TubeCut is an AI-powered thumbnail creator designed to help YouTube creators make better thumbnails faster.
Turn your ideas into eye-catching thumbnails with AI, explore different creative styles, analyze your designs, and fine-tune every detail with powerful editing tools.
AI-POWERED THUMBNAIL TOOLS
• AI Thumbnail Generator — Turn your ideas into thumbnails with AI.
• AI Thumbnail Variations — Upload a thumbnail and instantly create 3 different styles.
• AI Thumbnail Score — Analyze your thumbnail and get an AI-powered score and suggestions to improve it.
• AI Cutout — Remove the background of any photo in just one tap.
POWERFUL THUMBNAIL EDITOR
• 500+ professionally designed templates to help you create thumbnails, intros & outros faster.
• 200+ fonts and 200+ text effects. Customize size, color, gradient, shadow, and more.
• 2,000+ stickers and 500+ backgrounds for every type of content.
• Easy-to-use editing tools to customize every detail and create a style that fits your channel.
CREATE THUMBNAILS THAT GET CLICKS
Whether you're starting from an idea, an existing thumbnail, or a ready-made template, TubeCut gives you the AI tools and creative resources you need to create thumbnails that stand out.
Create faster. Explore more ideas. Make better thumbnails with AI.
UPGRADE TO TUBECUT PREMIUM
Get full access to all advanced tools and materials with Premium!
TubeCut Premium offers two subscription options: monthly and yearly.
Should you choose to upgrade to a Premium subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
You may cancel automatic renewal and manage your subscription by selecting Manage App Subscriptions in your iTunes Account settings and selecting the subscription you want to modify. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a Premium subscription, where applicable.

bluejetty:00022730:ios.name: Aviateur: Flight Simulation
bluejetty:00022730:ios.summary:
Features:
-Several aircraft to choose from
-Diverse, geographically accurate real-world locations
- Air-to-Air and Air-to-ground combat battles against fighter jets, WWII aircraft, tanks, destroyers, submarines, AAAs, SAM missile systems
bluejetty:00022730:ios.description:
Features:
-Several aircraft to choose from
-Diverse, geographically accurate real-world locations
- Air-to-Air and Air-to-ground combat battles against fighter jets, WWII aircraft, tanks, destroyers, submarines, AAAs, SAM missile systems
- 2 Combat Eras to choose from - WWII and Modern
- Command wingmen into combat, or fly various formations
- Rack up a high score in Air Endurance mode where you fight endless enemies
-Practice aircraft carrier, destroyer ship and oil platform landings
-24 hour Day/Night cycle
-Customizable, fully dynamic weather that varies spatially and with time (clear, cloudy, hurricane, thunderstorm, rain, snowstorm, thermals, and more!)
-Landing/Engine failure Challenges
-Racing Challenges
-Air Traffic Control
-Comprehensive flight dynamics
- Pilot a variety of aircraft, from jet airliner, fighter jets, civilian and military helicopters, general aviation, and vintage planes!
- Test your landing skills by landing on an aircraft carrier, destroyer ship or an oil rig, or perhaps add some crosswinds, some turbulence and rain to make things more challenging!
- Create air-to-ground combat battles and make use of weapons such as cannons, missiles, bombs, rockets and flares and survive against enemies such as tanks, destroyer ships, surface-to-air missiles, anti-aircraft artilleries and more!
- Features fully customizable weather. Control the cloud cover in multiple layers, recreate thunderstorms, snowstorms, rain, customize winds and gusts, visibility and add turbulence!
- Visit the locations of Cape Verde and Grand Canyons and take in the views of vast rugged terrain! Locations are recreated on a 1:1 scale with accurate terrain, fully recreated cities, towns and roads from real geodata. Airports are recreated with accuracy and detail to mirror their real life counterparts.
- Put your aerobatic stunts on display with the use of customizable aerobatic smoke!
- Launch your glider into the sky with a winch and soar through the clouds in an authentic glider simulation!
- Try out some landing challenges or create your own! Test your emergency skills with engine failures!
- Break the sound barrier in the sky with supersonic jets!
- Features Attack Helicopters!
- Race against time in racing challenges!
- Ability to park your aircraft and walk around!
- Features in-depth flight dynamics modelling to bring authenticity to each aircraft!
- Features a full day and night cycle!
- Features aircraft customization such as changing paint color, selecting weaponry loadouts, external fuel tanks and more!
- Fly from a variety of viewing angles, be it 360 degrees around the aircraft, inside the cockpit, or from the passenger seat!
- Features ATC (Air Traffic Control) communication and procedures!
- Features customizable air traffic!
- In-depth controls featuring flaps, gear, spoilers (arm), rudder, reverse thrust, engine start/stop, elevator trim, lights, drag chutes and more!
- Features instruments such as: Artificial horizon, altimeter, airspeed, in-flight map, heading, Vertical Speed Indicator, Engine RPM/N1, fuel, G-force gauge, Head-Up Display etc.
- Features 3D instrument gauges in cockpits!
- Navigate using ILS systems!
- Features in-depth Autopilot (Vertical Speed, Altitude change, Autothrottle, Heading) and warning systems for each aircraft!
- Features in-depth weapon systems simulation!

bluejetty:00115638:ios.description:
Jump into this offline first-person zombie shooter and put your skills to the test in countless battles against zombies. Kill the infected hordes in this new FPS shooting game set in a post-apocalyptic world where the undead dominate the ruins of civilization. 
ZOMBIE HARBOR offers the ultimate offline zombie survival shooter experience. With intense action, a rich arsenal of upgradeable weapons, and immersive apocalyptic environments, it’s the perfect game for both casual players and seasoned FPS fans. Each battle requires quick thinking, precise aim, and the will to survive against overwhelming infected hordes.
Enter a world of non-stop tension and take on the apocalypse shooter with high-quality visuals and responsive gameplay. 
▶ Offline zombie shooting game with immersive FPS gameplay
Enjoy high-quality first-person combat without going online, perfect for mobile play on the go.
▶ Shoot zombies with powerful guns
Choose from a wide selection of weapons, including assault rifles, shotguns, machine guns, and many others. Each weapon provides a unique tactical edge in battle.
▶ Upgrade your weapons to survive the apocalypse
Earn rewards by completing missions and use them to enhance your gear. Improve damage, reload speed, and accuracy to stay ahead of increasingly dangerous enemies.
▶ Face hordes of zombies in wave-based combat
Take on escalating hordes of undead threats. Adapt your tactics, manage resources, and make each shot count in order to survive.
▶ Explore post-apocalyptic locations
Fight your way through haunting environments shaped by the apocalypse, where each level brings new dangers and an immersive atmosphere.
▶ Simple controls and a smooth mobile shooting experience
Optimized for mobile, the game features intuitive controls that keep you focused on the action.
Zombie Harbor delivers a complete offline experience, allowing you to play anytime, anywhere — no internet connection required. 
Fight through relentless waves of zombies using a wide range of powerful weapons, complete intense missions across apocalyptic environments, and rise above the outbreak.
Built for smooth performance on mobile devices, the game combines detailed 3D graphics, satisfying gameplay, and intuitive controls into a focused single-player experience. 
The undead won’t stop coming, but with the right strategy and firepower, you might just make it out alive!
Ready to fight back? Download Zombie Harbor today and prove your strength in a world overrun by the undead!
If you have a problem with this game, please contact us via email zs2@support.my.games 
Please note: Zombie Harbor is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money.
- For information about how we collect and use your data, please read our privacy policy at: https://documentation.my.games/terms/mygames_privacy 
- Terms of Use: https://documentation.my.games/terms/mygames_eula

bluejetty:00128382:ios.description:
Make the forecast feel like yours. InstantWeather combines clear, detailed weather information with photographic backgrounds you choose, creating a weather app that is both useful and personal.
See current conditions at a glance, explore the hourly outlook, or plan ahead with a 10-day forecast. Choose your current location or search for a city or region, then quickly return to recently viewed locations.
Main features
- Current conditions with temperature, feels-like temperature, humidity, wind, and daily high and low
- Hourly forecasts with temperature, precipitation chance, wind, and weather conditions
- 10-day forecasts with expandable daily details
- Daily precipitation amounts, wind gusts, sunrise, sunset, moon phase, and expected high and low times
- Current-location weather and city or region search
- Recent locations for faster switching
- Celsius and Fahrenheit support
- Custom backgrounds using a new photo or an image from your photo library
- Adjustable background blur and brightness
- Customizable text and icon colors
- Dedicated layouts for iPhone and iPad
- Personalize backgrounds for different weather conditions and keep the forecast readable by adjusting the image, colors, and effects to suit your style.
Weather data is provided by Apple WeatherKit.

bluejetty:00015166:ios.summary: Embark on an extraordinary prehistoric journey with Yateland's dinosaur games for kids! Dive into an educational adventure in our interactive Jurassic world, populated with 12 diverse dinosaurs including T-Rex, Diplodocus, Raptor, Tricerato
bluejetty:00015166:ios.description:
Embark on an extraordinary prehistoric journey with Yateland's dinosaur games for kids! Dive into an educational adventure in our interactive Jurassic world, populated with 12 diverse dinosaurs including T-Rex, Diplodocus, Raptor, Triceratops, and Stegosaurus, among others.
Buckle up in your favorite off-road vehicle and zoom off to the archaeological dig site. There, you can uncover and excavate 12 different dinosaur fossils, offering a hands-on experience of the thrilling work of a paleontologist. Once the fossils are unearthed, it's back to the Dino Laboratory to assemble them, bringing these magnificent creatures back to life in the heart of your very own Jurassic world!
Navigate through varied landscapes like the seaside, plains, desert, and rainforest, each teeming with distinct dinosaur species. This game not only brings to life the exciting process of fossil excavation but also offers insight into dinosaur behaviors and their respective habitats.
So, get ready to rev up your engine and embark on a thrilling fossil hunt, unearthing 12 unique dinosaur fossils in one of the most exciting Jurassic world games for kids!
Features:
• Discover and assemble fossils from 12 different dinosaur species.
• Navigate through a captivating Jurassic world with your dinosaur companions.
• Bring dinosaurs to life with engaging animations and sound effects.
• Discover hidden treasures and surprises throughout your journey.
• Designed for preschoolers, ages 2-6 years.
• No third-party advertising, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience for kids.
About Yateland:
At Yateland, we create fun and educational apps that inspire preschoolers worldwide to learn through play. Our guiding motto is "Apps children love and parents trust". Discover more about Yateland and our variety of apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland places great importance on user privacy. To understand how we handle user data, please read our comprehensive privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00024874:ios.description:
Wokamon = virtual pet game + pedometer (activity tracker)
Wokamons are running out of resources and they need your help! Every step you take is turned into energy. Use it to feed, grow and collect Wokamons. The more you walk, the more Wokamons you can collect and the further you get to explore the magical Woka-worlds like candy desert, icy realm, mystical forest and more! Lend a helping hand and soon you will find, the more you help, the fitter you get!
--------------FUN & MOTIVATING---------------
Wokamon, an unique adventure and clicker simulation game on iPhone and Apple Watch, makes walking interesting and fun! Doesn’t matter if you walk, jog or run, outdoor or on a treadmill, Wokamon set out to make your fitness experience never be the same again: you will want to walk more, all day, every day! 
Simply play with your phone, or connect with Apple Health, Fitbit, UP by JAWBONE, Moves and MI band
Please enjoy Wokamon with iPad and iPhone 6 and 6 Plus with optimised graphics.
--------------------THE STORY--------------------
A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away, on planet Laya, Wokamons lived happily with their friends, the Layabots. They worked together and played together, turning the Layabots’ activity output into energy source for Wokamons. However the Layabouts got too lazy and eventually stopped moving. Wokamons got super weak and mega sad. 
In order for Wokamon to thrive again, Wokamon elders decided to send some young and brave Wokamons to plant Earth to harness energy from the human race and to start their adventure.
------------------PLEASE NOTE--------------------
Permissions - Make sure to grant all permissions when asked to authorise with the Health App to make it work.
Power consumption (iPhone 4/4S/5/5C) - Wokamon requires background location (GPS) for built-in pedometer. Although Wokamon is designed to consume less power, please be aware that continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
--------------------CONTACT US--------------------
Learn more about us: www.wokamon.com
Follow us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/wokamon
Follow us on Twitter: www.twitter.com/wokamon
***If you enjoy playing Wokamon, please rate us a 5-star. If you would like to report a bug or to express your concerns, please contact us at Wokamon support: http://forum.shikudo.com/c/wokamon We appreciate your feedback and we read every single review!***

bluejetty:00186053:ios.name: Word Cross: Find Words Search
bluejetty:00186053:ios.summary: Do you like word search? This letter puzzle game will surprise you. Edujoy’s word search game is easy to play, ideal for hours of fun entertainment while training your brain. It is suitable for both adults and children, resulting in an educ
bluejetty:00186053:ios.description:
Do you like word search? This letter puzzle game will surprise you. Edujoy’s word search game is easy to play, ideal for hours of fun entertainment while training your brain. It is suitable for both adults and children, resulting in an educational and enriching experience as you play. It has different levels of difficulty, making it perfect for anyone who is on the lookout for words on a board.
- Easy: Perfect for little kids. The board is 6x6 so it's easy to find the words and solve the puzzle. In addition, the clue system helps you find a new word when the child is stuck.
- Medium: The board is built 9x9. As you move up in the game the level becomes much more difficult and challenging than the last.
- Hard: The board is 12x12 and each game is harder. This level is made for players who are looking to test and train their brain with a classic puzzle game.
- Extreme: Only the bravest may face this level! A difficult feat for those up for the challenge. Do you think you'll be able to beat it?
Our app is a classic mental game for all ages. Find the hidden words! 5 levels of difficulty for all ages - easy for children all the way up to extreme for adults.
It is also available in several languages, which makes it ideal for learning new vocabulary in other languages. If you are learning: Spanish, English, German, Portuguese, French, Italian, Polish, Turkish… this is the game for you!
You will never want to play another word search game and end up referring it to your friends! Every time you play it's a new experience due to our generating system that creates a brand new, random puzzle game. By doing this, it makes it challenging for you every time and allows us to keep you wanting to solve the puzzle. So, you will never get bored!
The word search boards are created with many fundamental topics: food, animals, cities, countries, transport, home, colors, sports… Are you ready to solve hundreds of fun-filled puzzles?
In addition, the game is integrated with game services making it a social experience with your friends and family. This system allows you to compare your skills and results with others and millions of people around the world. Rankings and achievements included.
The classification is based on the time needed to complete a level. So the faster you are, the higher you rank.
Through your achievements, you can track your progress and know how you are doing as time passes by. Unlock all the achievements and eventually you'll become the master of puzzles.
Thanks to you, It’s very important for us that you share your opinions so we can improve based off the feedback we receive. If you have any questions or suggestions please contact us on our site or through our profiles on social media:
Twitter: twitter.com/edujoygames
Facebook: facebook.com/edujoysl

bluejetty:00140004:ios.description:
SPRK is a couples app designed to strengthen connection, encourage meaningful conversations, and bring more fun into your relationship. Whether you’re looking to reconnect, break routine, or enjoy playful moments together, SPRK offers engaging activities made for couples.
What you’ll find inside SPRK:
◆ Couples Dice Games Interactive dice-based games that introduce lighthearted challenges and fun surprises, helping couples enjoy spontaneous moments together.
◆ Couples Questions Carefully crafted questions that encourage deeper conversations, emotional bonding, and mutual understanding.
◆ Dares Fun and relationship-friendly challenges that add excitement, laughter, and positive energy to your time together.
◆ Couples Positions Guide A curated guide focused on closeness, comfort, and connection, helping couples explore new ways to feel closer.
And More Fun things to ignite the intimacy.
With SPRK, couples can create meaningful moments, improve communication, and enjoy quality time together. It’s perfect for date nights, weekend getaways, or simply reconnecting after a busy day.
Download SPRK and bring more connection, fun, and closeness into your relationship.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your Apple ID account settings after purchase.  
Privacy Policy : https://sites.google.com/view/couplesquestions/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use : https://sites.google.com/view/couplesquestions/terms-conditions

Mobility Bus is our accessible door – to– door transit service for Strathc
bluejetty:00046737:ios.description:
Use SC Transit to book all your Mobility Bus transit services, and local On-demand transit trips in Sherwood Park connecting to the fixed-route transit services.
Mobility Bus is our accessible door – to– door transit service for Strathcona County residents with physical or cognitive impairments that make using conventional transit difficult - you will only have access to booking this service once Transit pre-qualifies you. Application info call: 780-449-9680.
With just a few quick taps, registered Mobility bus users can book their trips up to two weeks in advance and track their current trips.
Strathcona On-demand Transit is a dynamic way to get around Sherwood Park – a ride sharing service that is accessible, affordable, and green. Book your trip with-in 30-minutes of your desired travel time, and the app will find the trip that’s right for you. Our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. 
How it works:
Book a ride on your phone
Get picked up a near-by stop
Share your ride with others heading in the same direction
Save cash and reduce carbon emissions.
You can also use the app to plan trips on the bus into Edmonton and surrounding areas.
On-demand questions? Call us at 780-464-7433 press 5
Loving your app experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating… You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

5 FREE FAX PAGES EVERY MONTH (US & CANADA)
• Send up to 5 free pages every month — no trial, no expiration
• No credit card, no subscription, no hidden paywalls
• Truly free fax — not a 7-day trial that flips to paid

• Affordable monthly plans and pay-as-you-go options

ALL-IN-ONE MOBILE FAX APP

• Attach documents from Files, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, Photos, or Mail
• Built-in scanner captures documents quickly and cleanly — scan and fax in one flow
• Combine pages, preview before sending, and track delivery in real time
COMPLETE DOCUMENT TOOLKIT — BUILT IN
Unlike most fax apps, Faxify includes document tools so you never need to switch apps:
• PDF tools: merge, split, compress, convert to/from images
• Image editing: crop, rotate, enhance, and convert images for faxing
• Word docs: open and prepare DOC and DOCX files for sending
• Signature tools: sign scanned pages, images, and cover pages before faxing
• Page management: delete and combine pages from any source
RECEIVE FAXES ANYTIME (WITH SUBSCRIPTION)

• Organize your fax inbox: download, print, or share documents

SECURE & PROFESSIONAL FAXING
• 256-bit SSL encryption protects documents in transit
• Trusted by users in finance, law, government, real estate, and small business
REAL CUSTOMER SUPPORT — NOT A CHATBOT

• Read our reviews — users consistently highlight reliability and support quality
AI-POWERED FAX AUTOMATION
• Faxify MCP Server brings faxing into AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor
• Automate sending, fetching, and processing faxes
• Scriptable workflows for high-volume senders and developers
WHY USERS CHOOSE FAXIFY
• 5 free fax pages every month — no trial, no credit card
• Built-in document toolkit most fax apps don't include
• Real human support over email, phone, and video call
• Send PDF, DOC, DOCX, and image files without converting first
• Affordable plans and a dedicated fax number when you're ready to upgrade
NEED MORE THAN FAX? TRY NXTTOOLS
Check out our companion app NxtTools at https://nxt.tools — a free, ad-supported daily toolkit for PDF, image, QR, and document tasks beyond faxing.

bluejetty:00036229:android.name: Backpack Mod for Minecraft
bluejetty:00036229:android.summary:
😎 This mod is not an official Minecraft PE product, also not approved or not associated with Mojang company.
😃 How inconvenient it is sometimes to carry a bunch of objects after the next search of the cave in Minecraft. You have to either
bluejetty:00036229:android.description:
😎 This mod is not an official Minecraft PE product, also not approved or not associated with Mojang company.
😃 How inconvenient it is sometimes to carry a bunch of objects after the next search of the cave in Minecraft. You have to either rise to leave things, or replace less needed items with more valuable ones. While the player is choosing items, a cunning creeper deftly catches him behind his back and blows everything around, leaving all the things in a deep, confused cave, where the player will not be able to get until the things disappear. For such cases, a Backpacks mod is provided, which adds a bag to the player’s back. There are many slots for storing items in the bag, which means the player will be able to carry even more unnecessary things and materials on his back. The Backpack is easy to remove and just as easily put on back. Recommended for all fans of survival mode.
😎 Craft:
In order to put on a Backpacks, you will first have to create an item. The screenshots show crafting recipes that are also hidden in the add-on settings in the game.
😃 Backpacks are painted in desired colors with dyes.
To lock the Backpack, you must put the tension sensor in the first slot of the backpack. This will prevent other players from getting your items.
Equip a bag with a chest - this unlocks the inventory of a Backpacks for storing items.
😎 To put on a Backpack, stand next to it: the bag will jump onto the user's back. If you want to shoot, then click the sneak button and bounce.

bluejetty:00171219:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Run a rustic virtual farm your way. Plant crops, tend livestock and manage production until your agricultural empire flourishes in this soothing game.
Life on a farm isn't easy, but when you're running said farm from the comfort of your couch in this simulator game, it's actually kind of relaxing. Build your farm from the ground up by choosing the crops you want to grow, the animals you want to tend and the products you want to sell — then get to work each in-game day with the help of your growing fleet of tractors and other authentically recreated farm machines. 
Features:
• Till, plant, fertilize and harvest a variety of crops, now including grapes and olives.
• Build a fleet of tractors and more from a catalog of over 100 authentic, licensed vehicles from John Deere, New Holland, Fendt and many more notable manufacturers.
• Raise and care for livestock: your sheep, cows and now chickens can produce animal products that diversify your farm's offerings.
• Turn your crops into in-demand merchandise to create complex and profitable supply chains.
• Choose from two new maps: the classic red barn farm in Amberstone or the sleek European Neubrunn farm, which comes with riverfront fields.
• Expand into forestry with the new logging skill and equipment.
• Relax and take a virtual walk or drive through your land whenever you want — it's your farm, your harvest, your tractor and your game!
• New in Farming Simulator 23: Enjoy a guided tutorial on the Amberstone farm, use AI assistants to complete tasks while you run the farm and try the autoload truck feature to make moving logs and pallets a breeze. 
- Created by Giants Software.

bluejetty:00022129:ios.summary: Tabu: Forbidden Words is a team-based word guessing party game for friends, families, and groups. Describe the target word without saying the forbidden clues, help your teammates guess before time runs out, and compete across customizable r
bluejetty:00022129:ios.description:
Tabu: Forbidden Words is a team-based word guessing party game for friends, families, and groups. Describe the target word without saying the forbidden clues, help your teammates guess before time runs out, and compete across customizable rounds and game modes.
Choose from more than 5,000 word cards, create two to four teams, adjust the rules for your group, and play at parties, family game nights, school activities, or casual gatherings.
HOW DO YOU PLAY TABU?
Create two, three, or four teams.
Choose a game mode and set the round rules.
Describe the target word without using any forbidden words shown on the card.
Help your teammates guess as many words as possible before time runs out.
Track the score and continue until the selected score or round limit is reached.
CHOOSE FROM FIVE GAME MODES
CLASSIC TABU
Describe the target word without using the forbidden words.
LIMITED WORDS
Explain the target using only a limited number of words. Choose each clue carefully and try to communicate more with less.
DRAW & GUESS
Draw the target without speaking while your teammates try to guess it.
PUPPET MODE
Choose a puppet and use animated characters while describing words for your team.
MIXED MODE
Combine Classic Tabu, Limited Words, Draw & Guess, and Puppet Mode in one game. The mode changes between rounds to create a more varied team competition.
CUSTOMIZE THE GAME FOR YOUR GROUP
Set up each game based on how your group wants to play:
Create two, three, or four teams
Customize team names and avatars
Set the duration of each round
Adjust the number of allowed passes
Choose score-based, round-based, or free-play limits
Use swipe or button controls
Pause and resume the game at any time
EXPLORE MORE THAN 5,000 WORD CARDS
Play with a large collection of word cards across repeated game nights and different groups.
Choose both your language and region so cards and content feel more relevant to where you play. Tabu is available in English and 32 additional languages.
TRACK SCORES AND ROUND RESULTS
Review detailed results at the end of each game, including:
Correct answers
Wrong guesses
Passed cards
Team scores
Success rates
Use the scoreboard to compare teams and see which group performed best.
WHO IS TABU FOR?
Tabu is designed for:
Friends looking for a team party game
Families playing together on game night
Groups that enjoy fast word guessing games
Teachers and students planning classroom activities
Players who enjoy communication and teamwork games
FULL VERSION AND PURCHASE INFORMATION
Tabu is free to download and contains advertising.
The Full Version is a one-time purchase, not an automatically renewing subscription. There are no recurring subscription charges associated with this purchase.
Please review the Privacy Policy and other purchase information available on the app's App Store page.

bluejetty:00138448:ios.name: Relio: Back Pain Management
bluejetty:00138448:ios.summary: Relio is the easiest way to self-manage your persistent back pain symptoms at home, without medications. Developed by experts, Relio can help you better manage your pain and get back to your activities with a 6-week psychology-based program
bluejetty:00138448:ios.description:
Relio is the easiest way to self-manage your persistent back pain symptoms at home, without medications. Developed by experts, Relio can help you better manage your pain and get back to your activities with a 6-week psychology-based program.
Relio uses a proven psychological approach to persistent back pain: clinical hypnosis combined with pain science education. Examined in a government-funded study at Neuroscience Research Australia, this approach was found to double the number of people reporting reduced pain and improved function*.
How does it work?
Most solutions only provide temporary or incomplete relief because they fail to target the root cause of persistent back pain, which is an overprotective pain system. Relio can help you learn how to address this overprotective pain system through education and audio-based clinical hypnosis in just a few weeks.
What you get:
- An evidence-based clinical hypnosis program designed by world-leading experts to help you better manage your pain
- Interactive educational content to help you understand why you’re experiencing persistent pain
- Relaxing 15-minute daily sessions that fit easily into your schedule
- Techniques to calm stress and reduce tension
- Strategies to help you safely return to your daily activities
- In-app chat support from real people
*Rizzo RRN, Medeiros FC, Pires LG, Pimenta RM, McAuley JH, Jensen MP, Costa LOP. Hypnosis Enhances the Effects of Pain Education in Patients With Chronic Nonspecific Low Back Pain: A Randomized Controlled Trial. J Pain. 2018 Oct;19(10):1103.e1-1103.e9. doi: 10.1016/j.jpain.2018.03.013. Epub 2018 Apr 11. PMID: 29654980.
Medical Disclaimer:
Relio is a general wellbeing and lifestyle tool designed to help people live well with diagnosed persistent back pain. Relio is not intended as a treatment for persistent back pain and does not replace care by your provider or persistent back pain treatments you may be using. Always consult your healthcare professional before making medical decisions.
Relio is not a substitute for any medications. You should continue to take your medications as directed by your healthcare provider.
If you have any feelings or thoughts of harming yourself or others, please dial 911 (or local equivalent) or go to the nearest emergency room.
If you subscribe through iTunes, the credit card associated with your iTunes account will be charged at the end of the 7-day trial period, and your subscription will automatically renew every 3 months thereafter unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. If you do not cancel, your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. If you purchase a subscription during the free trial period, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited.
To manage your Relio subscription from iTunes:
1) On your iOS device, go to your device Settings and the ‘iTunes & App Stores’.
2) Tap on your Apple ID.
3) Tap to ‘View Apple ID’. (You may need to sign in or use Touch ID.)
4) Tap on ‘Subscriptions’.
5) Choose ‘Relio Subscription.
6) Tap ‘Cancel Subscription’.
For more information, please see our Terms and Conditions of Use: https://www.mindsethealth.com/legal/terms-conditions-relio

bluejetty:00065276:ios.name: Rosedale Bank
bluejetty:00065276:ios.summary: Rosedale Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay orga
bluejetty:00065276:ios.description:
Rosedale Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Rosedale Federal Savings & Loan Association customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Rosedale Bank App, you must be enrolled as an Rosedale Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00159200:ios.summary: Turn your daily drives into a journey toward safer roads! The Safe Roads Challenge app is your ultimate companion for building mindful driving habits while having fun. Track your progress, improve your skills, and make a difference—one safe
bluejetty:00159200:ios.description:
Turn your daily drives into a journey toward safer roads! The Safe Roads Challenge app is your ultimate companion for building mindful driving habits while having fun. Track your progress, improve your skills, and make a difference—one safe drive at a time.
WHY CHOOSE SAFE ROADS CHALLENGE?
Safe Roads Challenge is more than just a driving app—it’s a movement. We reward positive actions on the road, helping you become the best version of yourself behind the wheel. Whether you're a new driver or just looking to improve, we make driving safer, fun, and rewarding.
MINDFUL FEATURES FOR MINDFUL DRIVERS
• Track Your Progress: Monitor your daily driving score and see how you’re improving over time.
• Build Better Habits: Earn streaks for safe driving and stay motivated with habit-building features.
• Compete and Collaborate: Join a team to unlock advanced stats, compete with friends, and track your collective progress.
• Earn Rewards: Celebrate your safe driving milestones with real rewards for improving your score.
• Level Up Your Skills: Complete tasks and challenges to sharpen your driving habits and skills.
• Engage in Fun Activities: Enter contests, collect pins, and make safe driving a game.
• Stay Informed: Get helpful driving tips and safety information to keep you on track.
PRIVACY & DATA
• Your Privacy Comes First: We anonymize all driving data and never sell personal information. Your scores and progress are for your eyes only—no one else can access your personal location or details.
• Smart Data Usage: Our app uses Wi-Fi caching to minimize cellular data usage. You’ll often see your scores update when you reconnect to Wi-Fi.
• Battery-Friendly Design: Safe Roads Challenge runs efficiently in the background to conserve your phone’s battery life—because we know every percentage matters!
A CHALLENGE WORTH TAKING
Safe Roads Challenge is your personal promise to drive mindfully. With positive reinforcement, gamified features, and a focus on progress, we make driving safely something to celebrate.
JOIN THE MOVEMENT. MAKE ROADS SAFER. REWARD YOURSELF FOR DRIVING MINDFULLY.
Download Safe Roads Challenge today and start tracking your progress toward safer roads and a safer you!
Having trouble? Please contact us by email: support@saferoadschallenge.com
Terms of Use: https://saferoadschallenge.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://saferoadschallenge.com/privacy-policy/
All contests, rewards and sweepstakes included in this app are not sponsored by Apple.

Shuffles is a new app from Pinterest for creative expression. Want to curate a festival outfit? Visualize your dream bedroom? Moodboard your current aesthetic vibe? Manifest the future of your dreams? Or just create collages and digital art from your phone? Shuffles will be your new favorite app.
Here’s how it works:
• Snap a picture of any objects you want and use them to create animated, immersive collages.
• Find inspiration in our library of 300+ billion beautiful pictures.
• Cut out objects from an image with a single tap
• Layer, rotate, and resize objects into still or animated collages and moodboards
• Add animations and effects (motions, filters, and frames!) to make your Shuffles pop
• Share privately with friends to collaborate on creative projects
• Remix other peoples' Shuffles to put your own spin on someone else's creation
• Create impressive animated stories using keyframe animation
• Design animated holiday cards using our custom templates
• Dress your phone in custom wallpapers
• Share your creations with the caring Shuffles community, or post to your favorite messaging or social apps.

bluejetty:00162431:ios.name: Motorola Nursery
bluejetty:00162431:ios.summary:
Motorola Nursery: Your All-in-One Connected Nursery Companion
As dedicated parents, the comfort, safety, and happiness of your little ones are always our top priorities. The Motorola Nursery app, tailor-made for Motorola's branded Connect
bluejetty:00162431:ios.description:
Motorola Nursery: Your All-in-One Connected Nursery Companion
As dedicated parents, the comfort, safety, and happiness of your little ones are always our top priorities. The Motorola Nursery app, tailor-made for Motorola's branded Connected Nursery compatible products, offers you an integrated suite of features designed with modern parenting in mind.
Key Features:
24-hour Event Monitoring:
Enjoy unlimited live streaming in crisp 1080p Full HD on compatible mobile devices.
Capture those tender, fleeting moments with motion and sound detection for each connected camera.
As a warm welcome, new Motorola Nursery app users receive a complimentary three-month (90 days) subscription to Motorola Nursery+ 24-hour event monitoring upon purchasing a compatible product. Dive into the app for more details.
Split-Screen Viewing:
Multi-task like a pro! View up to four connected cameras simultaneously.
A single tap on a live preview transports you to a detailed view, complete with all the features you love.
Lullabies, Soothing Sounds, and Personal Touch:
Choose from a range of gentle lullabies and calming sounds to serenade your baby to sleep.
Add a personal touch by using the Motorola Nursery app to record and play your own voice through the connected camera. Whether it's their favorite lullaby or a comforting word, let your familiar voice wrap them in warmth.
Baby Journal:
Create a keepsake digital journal for each child, capturing growth milestones, important dates, and daily habits.
Store and analyze data on height, weight, feeding, sleeping, and more. Reflect on your child's journey with daily, weekly, monthly, or annual summaries.
Photo and Video Gallery:
Your one-stop spot for all cherished memories captured during live streams or downloaded from event monitoring.
Effortlessly search, sort, and share these treasures with loved ones.
Talk Back and Room Temperature Monitoring:
Engage in two-way conversations, sending your love and reassurance directly to your baby.
Stay informed with the room's temperature sensor, ensuring the ideal environment for your little one's peaceful slumber.
Discover more about Motorola Nursery's world of features at motorolanursery.com. Entrust us with the privilege of accompanying you and your child in these unforgettable early years.
Warm wishes,
The Motorola Nursery Team

bluejetty:00100750:ios.description:
iBreviary TS Pro Terra Sancta is the application that brings the traditional Catholic prayer of the Breviary and all the texts of the Liturgy on your iPhone, iPad and iPod.
This app wants to contribute, through a partnership with Custody of the Holy Land, friendship and prayer for all Christians living Holy Places.
iBreviary contains:
• Breviary, Missal and Lectionary complete in 10 languages and continuously updated (Italian, English, Spanish, French, Romanian, Arabic, Portuguese, Turkish, Latin and Galician)
• The text of the Breviary and the Missal in the "Latin Vetus Ordo" and Latin
• All the main prayers of the Christian
• Rituals for the sacraments and celebrations
• The liturgical texts used in the Holy Land
Also iBreviary "Pro Terra Sancta" offers:
• The section, "Rites", with all the rituals and texts for the various celebrations Catholic (Adoration of the Eucharist, the Sacraments, Blessings, etc.)
• The brand new "Terra Sancta" the liturgical texts used in the Holy Land
• Keep in touch through the blog and the pages of the Franciscans Holy Places
• A rich section dedicated to Saints
• Store a day on any device
• Full management of saved days (selection and cancellation)
• Store up to 14 days (something very much in demand by those who want to download a bit of days for travel or long period without internet access)
• Download the entire week
• Enlarge and diminish the text dimension, with the flick of the fingers on the screen
• The ability to adjust the color of the background, the font and the size for a better reading of texts
• (On iPad only) Create and manage your Missal
The Application is available in the following languages:
• English
• Italian
• Spanish
• French
• Romanian
• Arabic
• Portuguese
• Turkish

bluejetty:00024960:ios.description:
Log your daily blood pressure readings, add notes, and share free PDF reports with your doctor.
Designed to be obvious and easy - big buttons, big text, no clutter.
You take the reading on your blood pressure monitor; this app keeps the journal.
Keeping a blood pressure log, journal or diary is important when facing associated health concerns. Recording just one blood pressure measurement is like a snapshot. It only tells you what your blood pressure is at that moment. 
Maintaining a record of readings taken over time provides a "time-lapse" picture of your blood pressure that can help you partner with your physician and health team to ensure that your treatments to manage your blood pressure and related concerns. 
Use the app with your blood pressure monitor (sphygmomanometer) or other sources through connecting to Apple Health and importing your recordings.
FEATURES
- Keep your blood pressure measurements synchronized through Apple Health.
- Keep a journal or diary of your blood pressure recordings through notes on each recording.
- Create reminders to help you track your blood pressure measurements consistently.
- Get a sense of your blood pressure trends over time.
- Generate and share your FREE blood pressure reports with your physician and health team.
FREE
- No Ads
- No Subscriptions
- No In-App Purchases
IMPORTANT 
This app and its reports are for informational purposes only. They are not a substitute for a medical diagnosis. Talk to your doctor about your blood pressure.

bluejetty:00128558:ios.summary:
Glycemic Snap is the AI-powered glycemic index guide for managing blood sugar. Snap a photo of any meal, scan a label or barcode, or log a glucose reading — and instantly see how it affects your glucose response.
▶ DAILY GLYCEMIC DIARY
Log
bluejetty:00128558:ios.description:
Glycemic Snap is the AI-powered glycemic index guide for managing blood sugar. Snap a photo of any meal, scan a label or barcode, or log a glucose reading — and instantly see how it affects your glucose response.
▶ DAILY GLYCEMIC DIARY
Log every meal in one place. Track daily glycemic load, average GI, net carbs, fiber, sugar, and optional nutrients against personalized targets. The weekly calendar shows green, yellow, and red days at a glance.
▶ BLOOD GLUCOSE TRACKING (NEW IN 5.4)
Manually log glucose readings with meal-context tags (fasting, before/after meal, bedtime) and see your trends charted over time. Spot what spikes you and what keeps you stable.
▶ SCAN ANY MEAL
Point your camera at your plate. In seconds, see the glycemic index, glycemic load, and a predicted blood sugar curve for the whole meal.
▶ SCAN LABELS & BARCODES
Scan any nutrition label or product barcode for instant blood sugar impact analysis. Works with packaged foods, supplements, and anything with a barcode.
▶ VOICE & TEXT LOOKUP
No camera? Describe your meal by voice or text for the same instant analysis. Perfect for planning ahead or checking menus before you order.
▶ RECIPE IMPORT
Paste any recipe URL, snap a cookbook page, or upload a PDF — get instant glycemic analysis with smart swaps and blood sugar predictions.
▶ SMART SWAPS
Other apps warn you about high-GI foods. We tell you what to eat instead. Get alternatives that can reduce your glucose spike by up to 80%.
▶ ASK ANYTHING
"What if I skipped the rice?" "How can I make this healthier?" Our AI assistant answers instantly with personalized tips.
▶ MULTI-ADD FAVORITES & COPY DAYS (NEW IN 5.4)
Save go-to meals as favorites and add several at once. Copy entries from one day to another and switch meal types in a tap — no re-logging.
▶ WEIGHT & STREAKS
Log your weight, see trends over time, and build daily logging streaks with milestone celebrations.
▶ AI PATTERN INSIGHTS (PRO)
Personalized AI insights uncover which foods trigger spikes, which keep you stable, and how your habits trend week over week.
▶ PERSONALIZED TARGETS
Set daily glycemic targets by diabetes type — general health, prediabetes, Type 1, Type 2, or gestational. Track optional nutrients like calories, protein, and fat alongside your core glycemic metrics.
▶ PERFECT FOR
• Following a low glycemic or low GI diet
• Tracking blood sugar and glucose response
• Prediabetes and Type 2 diabetes support
• Type 1 and gestational diabetes tracking
• Weight loss and energy optimization
• Anyone tired of guessing their food's impact
The glycemic index (GI) measures how quickly foods raise blood sugar. Low GI foods (55 or less) digest slowly, causing a gentler rise. High GI foods (70+) cause rapid spikes. Glycemic Snap does the math for you — instantly.
Stop searching glycemic index charts. Stop guessing. Just scan, log, and know.
This app is not intended to replace medical advice. Please consult a qualified health care professional for personalized guidance.
Privacy and Terms
https://glycemicsnap.com/privacy
https://glycemicsnap.com/terms

Any Photos

bluejetty:00123194:ios.name: Splitwise
bluejetty:00123194:ios.summary: Splitwise is the easiest way to share expenses with friends and family and stop stressing about “who owes who”. Millions of people around the world use Splitwise to organize group bills for households, trips, and more. Our mission is to red
bluejetty:00123194:ios.description:
Splitwise is the easiest way to share expenses with friends and family and stop stressing about “who owes who”. Millions of people around the world use Splitwise to organize group bills for households, trips, and more. Our mission is to reduce the stress and awkwardness that money places on our most important relationships.
Splitwise is great for:
- Roommates splitting rent and apartment bills
- Group trips around the world
- Splitting a vacation house for skiing or at the beach
- Weddings and bachelor/bachelorette parties
- Couples sharing relationship costs
- Friends and co-workers who go out to lunch or dinner together frequently
- Loans and IOUS between friends 
- And so much more
Splitwise is simple to use:
- Create groups or private friendships for any splitting situation
- Add expenses, IOUs, or informal debts in any currency, with support for offline entry
- Expenses are backed up online so everyone can log in, view their balances, and add expenses
- Keep track of who should pay next, or settle up by recording cash payments or using our integrations
We also have powerful features that can handle almost any money sharing situation. Here are some of our industry-leading features:
- Multi-platform support for smartphones and web
- Simplify debts into the easiest repayment plan
- Expense categorization
- Calculate group totals
- Export to CSV
- Comment directly on expenses
- Split expenses equally or unequally by percentages, shares, or exact amounts
- Add informal debts and IOUs
- Create bills that reccur monthly, weekly, yearly, fortnightly
- Add multiple payers on a single expense
- See total balances with a person across multiple groups and private expenses
- Custom user avatars
- Cover photos for groups 
- Activity feed and push notifications help you stay on top of changes
- View your edit history for changes to an expense
- Any deleted group or bill can be restored easily
- World-class customer support
- Pay back using our integrated payments: Venmo and PayPal (US only), Paytm (India only)
- 100+ currencies and growing
- 7+ supported languages
Endorsements:
“Makes it easy to split everything from your dinner bill to rent.” - NY Times
"Fundamental for tracking finances. As good as WhatsApp for containing awkwardness." – The Financial Times
“I never fight with roommates over bills because of this genius expense-splitting app”- Business Insider
“The Single Best App You Can Download for Group Trips of Any Kind” - Thrillist
“Life Changing! I don’t review many things, but this app has seriously improved my quality of life. It has saved my sanity when it comes to splitting utilities, mortgage, groceries, dog expenses...the list goes on. No more saving receipts, making spreadsheets, and manually calculating each month. So handy for group trips/weekends, too! THANK YOU!!” – Courtney via the App Store
We offer in-app purchases for “Splitwise Pro”, the benefits of which are described below. The subscription amount will be charged to your App Store account and will vary by plan and country. You’ll see the total price before completing your first payment. If you don’t choose to purchase “Splitwise Pro”, you can continue using Splitwise for free.
Premium Subscription Service “Splitwise Pro”:
1. Store high-resolution receipts in the cloud (10GB cloud storage)
2. OCR integration for scanning and itemizing receipts
3. Backups to JSON, downloadable from our website
4. Convert expenses to different currencies using our Open Exchange Rates integration
5. Access to “spending by category” budgeting tools and other charts
6. Search full expense history
“Splitwise Pro” subscriptions purchased in-app renew monthly or yearly depending on your plan. Plan pricing may vary by country. To avoid renewal, you must turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before your subscription ends. You can turn off auto-renew at any time by visiting the App Store.
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://www.splitwise.com/terms

bluejetty:00186991:ios.description:
Similar in nature to the iStudent app, the iParent app offers parents quick access to real-time school information about their child. This includes everything from attendance records to exam results, reward and detention notifications, access to reports and assessments, teaching groups, timetables and more.
The official iSAMS Parent app links directly with the iSAMS Parent Portal. It has been designed to offer parents a quick and easy channel for keeping up-to-date with their son or daughter’s performance and any relevant school information, including last minute calendar notifications or event invites. It is aimed at enhancing the information flow from your school/teachers to parents ensuring greater engagement between all parties.
The iParent app offers parents a useful and configurable dashboard where they are able to view information and activities about all children at the school. Quick links are provided for:
The timetable of each child
Information about any sanctions and rewards
School news and bulletins
The school calendar
The photo galleries
More detailed information can then be located about the following:
Teaching groups
The school timetable
Internal exam details (entries, timetables, results)
External exam details (entries, timetables, arrangements, candidate details, results)
School reports and assessments
Attendance
Activities
Detentions
Reward and conduct details
Parents can use the app to view and subscribe to your school communications including emails, SMS messages and push notifications to the app. Push notifications will advise parents about any timely updates for each child, including information such as recently released reports or exam results, any rewards or detentions and pastoral records.
They can also view the contacts linked with their child and request changes to any contact details, thereby ensuring the data is accurate and up-to-date.

Discover a universe of stories with NovelBox—the one-stop platform where thousands of novels from every imaginable genre come together in one beautifully designed app. Whether you’re a fan of heartwarming romance, pulse-pounding thrillers, mind-bending sci‑fi, or epic historical tales, NovelBox offers a curated collection that caters to every taste and mood.

NovelBox isn’t just another reading app—it’s a gateway to a world of endless adventures and captivating narratives. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or dive into a complex, multi‑layered story, NovelBox makes it effortless to find the perfect novel for every moment.

Access the world’s top-ranking forecast models for reliable and
bluejetty:00072912:ios.description:
Accurate marine weather forecasts and powerful tools utilizing wind, wave and currents, save you time, keep you safe and ensure you get the most out of every day on the water.
Access the world’s top-ranking forecast models for reliable and accurate wind and weather data, including ECMWF, AIFS, ICON, UKMO, GFS, and more. Our very own PWAi, PWG & PWE models deliver unmatched accuracy in the short-to-medium range. 
View high resolution marine weather maps for wind, gust, CAPE, wave, rain, cloud, pressure, air temperature, sea temperature, ocean data and solunar. Suitable for sailing yacht, powerboat and any other marine weather activity.
In addition to marine forecasts, PredictWind also provides a suite of powerful marine weather tools to save you time and keep you safe at sea using Wind, Wave, Tidal and Ocean currents.
Weather Routing takes your start and end points then calculates your route factoring in tides, currents, wind and wave data, depth and your Sailing Yacht or Powerboats unique dimensions to give you the best route for comfort or speed.
Departure Planning quickly summarizes the forecast marine weather conditions you’ll encounter along your route if leaving on day 1, 2, 3, or 4. Use this data to select the perfect departure date, every time for your Sailing Yacht or Powerboat.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
- Daily Briefing: Powerful marine weather data condensed into a simple text forecast.
- Maps: High resolution forecasts maps with animated streamlines, wind barbs or arrows.
- Tables: The ultimate dashboard for detailed analysis of Wind, Wave, Rain and more.
- Graphs: Compare multiple marine forecasts at the same time.
- Live Wind Observations and Webcams: Know what’s happening with the weather right now at your local spot.
- Local Knowledge: Hear about the best marine spots, amenities and activities at your destination.
- Weather Alerts: Set your preferences then get alerts when conditions are just the way you like them for Wind, wave and other parameters.
- Ocean Data: See what’s happening under the waves with ocean and tidal currents, and sea temperature.
- GPS Tracking: Get a free customized GPS tracking page for your blog or website showing wind data overlaid.
- AIS Data: View over 280,000 vessels worldwide on the AIS network to see marine traffic.
Terms and conditions: https://www.predictwind.com/about-us/terms-and-conditions 
Privacy policy: https://www.predictwind.com/about-us/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00164654:ios.description:

Ideal for anyone who values better sleep, Sleep Tracker offers the tools to monitor your rest like never before.
Why use Sleep Tracker - Sleep Cycle App?
Sleep is essential for your health and productivity. With Sleep Tracker, you’ll get the most accurate sleep monitoring, insights into your sleep cycles, and tools to address disturbances like snoring or restless nights. It’s more than a sleep tracker—it’s your personal sleep coach!
Advanced Sleep Tracking
* Monitor your sleep cycles, including light, deep, and REM stages.
* Use the Sleep Monitor to detect disruptions and restless moments during the night.
Sleep Recorder
* Record nighttime sounds like snoring, talking, or other noises that might disrupt your rest.
* Play back recordings to understand how your environment impacts your sleep quality.
* Identify and analyze snoring patterns with the Sleep Recorder to improve breathing and rest.
Detailed Sleep Insights
* Get personalized sleep insights with daily, weekly, and monthly reports on sleep duration, quality, and trends.
* Learn how lifestyle factors like diet, stress, and activity levels influence your sleep patterns.
Smart Sleep Cycle Tracker
* Track your natural sleep rhythms and wake up at the optimal time with the smart alarm feature.
* Sleep Cycle Monitor ensures you wake up refreshed and ready to take on the day.
Custom Sleep Monitoring Tools
* Tailor your Sleep Tracker experience to your needs with customizable settings.
* Track naps separately for a complete picture of your rest.
* Add notes about bedtime routines or stress levels to see how they affect your sleep quality.

Additional Features of Sleep Monitor App
* Snore Detection: Identify snoring patterns and learn how to minimize them for uninterrupted sleep.
* Sleep Environment Analysis: Monitor sound, light, and temperature levels for the ideal sleeping conditions.
How Sleep Monitor App Works?
1. Place your phone beside your bed before sleeping.
2. Start the Sleep Monitor to track your rest and record sounds throughout the night.
3. Wake up to a detailed report on your sleep cycles, quality, and any disturbances.
Why Download Sleep Tracker?
* Combines Sleep Monitor, Sleep Recorder, and Sleep Insights into one powerful tool.
* Tracks sleep cycles accurately for a complete understanding of your rest.

bluejetty:00098286:ios.developer: Dog Training AI Puppy Translator Ltd
bluejetty:00098286:ios.summary: A lighthearted soundboard and simulation game inspired by the quirky personalities of cats. Furlingo offers a playful and imaginative experience, filled with meow-like sound effects, animated feline characters, and interactive features desi
bluejetty:00098286:ios.description:
A lighthearted soundboard and simulation game inspired by the quirky personalities of cats. Furlingo offers a playful and imaginative experience, filled with meow-like sound effects, animated feline characters, and interactive features designed for laughs and surprises.
Explore a virtual world of expressive audio and unlock unique reactions, moods, and cat personas. Whether you're a casual gamer or simply love humorous and creative content, Furlingo provides endless amusement through randomized sound simulations and fun mini-games.
Game Features:
Note: Some of the features are only available after you take paid subscription.
Soundboard Simulation
Access a variety of cat-inspired audio clips designed to reflect different moods and tones. Tap through dozens of randomized sound effects that range from soft purrs to dramatic yowls. Each interaction is unpredictable, making every session fresh and fun.
Mood-Based Audio Sets
Select from different emotional profiles such as energetic, annoyed, curious, or sleepy. Each mood offers a customized sound set and matching animations for added personality.
Unlockable Cat Characters
Progress through the game by collecting in-game rewards and unlocking new virtual cats. Each character brings a unique voice style and set of expressive animations, encouraging continued exploration.
Mini-Games and Challenges
Play simple, engaging mini-games like memory matching, sound mimicking, and reaction-based tapping. These optional challenges provide rewards, unlockables, and leaderboard positions for players who want more variety.
Customizable Environments
Decorate your game world with various themed backgrounds and interactive items. Unlock toys, beds, and furniture to create a space that fits your favorite virtual cat personalities.
No Animal Interaction Required
Furlingo does not simulate, interpret, or encourage real-world communication with pets. It is a fictional experience centered around exaggerated and humorous audio representations inspired by feline behavior.
Who Is It For
Furlingo is ideal for anyone who enjoys:
Casual games with humor and personality
Creative soundboards and voice-based play
Virtual pets with collectible features
Quirky, animated characters
Low-pressure gameplay with rewarding progression
Offline and one-handed play for mobile convenience
Content and Updates
New cat characters, seasonal content, themed sound packs, and decorative items are added regularly. Players are encouraged to check back often for fresh content and limited-time unlocks.
Important Notes
Furlingo is intended for entertainment purposes only. It does not provide actual translation or interaction with animals. All content is fictional and designed to create a humorous, engaging gameplay experience. Audio clips are stylized and exaggerated, created for comedic effect and simulation-based play.
Privacy and Safety
Furlingo does not record, analyze, or share voice data. Microphone use is optional and solely used for activating in-game simulated responses. No personal information is collected or stored.
Subscription Terms:
To access all the premium features and content, you need to subscribe or pay once for lifetime access. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account.
Subscriptions automatically renew and are billed at the rate and period you choose based on your subscription plan. User accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://www.trainmydog.ai/dog-whistle/app-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.trainmydog.ai/dog-whistle/app-terms

bluejetty:00063341:ios.description:
This is a simple but powerful photo distortion App. You can use it to simulate body transformations, improve your appearance on social networks, or have fun warping people. All you need to do is drag, grow or shrink the body parts you want to distort. Find out how you would look like with a different nose, chin, buttock, less weight... 
Our app, downloaded 10 million times on all platforms worldwide stands out because of 2 particular features:
1) The distortion algorithm we are using produce very smooth image distortions, such as the ones you find in 100x more expensive professional liquify apps. 
 2) Our dual display mode, which clones your image into the other half of the screen when you rotate your device, allows you to modify your image without the encumbrance of your finger hiding the area you are working on. This is ideal for small touch devices such as your phone !!
- New Feature: You can now save morphing animations as videos! 
************************ 
WHAT CAN THE APP DO? 
************************ 
With this photo distortion app you can transform any face and body part:
• Nose reshaping
• Lips augmentation 
• Chin and face contouring 
• Weight loss 
• Muscle augmentation 
• anything you can reshape or shrink! 
For fun or simply because you are curious about how you would look with a differently shaped body part, this app will help you.
************************ 
HOW TO USE THE APP?

Private Browser – Secure, Fast & Anonymous Browsing
Private Browser provides a secure browsing experience with safe internet surfing. It gives a default incognito screen with no tracking and no history record. The user has complete control over their privacy — choosing whether to save bookmarks, history, and more.
Private Browser is not only for those looking for anonymous internet browsing but also for fast internet browser users. It delivers the ultimate user experience with complete interface customization. Set the theme according to your style and browse the way you want.
Disclaimer: Please note that this app is a standalone, independently built browser. It has no connection to or affiliation with The Tor Project, Inc. Every aspect of its design and development is entirely the work of our own team.
What Private Browser Offers
Incognito Tab When you use incognito mode, your device retains no evidence of your activity. Private Browser will not track the sites you've visited, save your search history, or remember your username and password — keeping your sessions completely clean.
Bookmark Your Webpage Save any website's URL for future reference with ease. Bookmarks save you time, especially when revisiting a homepage or a specific section of a site. Your favorite pages are always just one tap away.
Search History Your browsing history includes visited pages, titles, and visit times — but with Private Browser, you stay in control. Our secure private browsing mode ensures history is never recorded, safeguarding you against third parties collecting your data for targeted advertising.
Find In Page Searching through a long or complex webpage is now effortless. Simply open the Find In Page tool, type a word or phrase, and Private Browser will highlight every match on the page. Use the arrows to cycle through results up and down with ease.
Share With Friends Seamlessly share webpages with whoever you want, directly through Private Browser — quick, easy, and private.
Multiple Search Engines Private Browser gives you the freedom to choose from multiple search engines so you never have to stick with just one:
Google
Bing
Yahoo
Wikipedia
WolframAlpha
Ecosia
DuckDuckGo
Qwant
Music Player Listen to your favorite music in complete privacy with our built-in music player. Our encryption technology ensures your listening history stays completely private, while the user-friendly interface and high-quality sound deliver an unparalleled experience — all without ever leaving the browser.
TOR Network — Tor-Powered Private Browsing Private Browser connects you directly to the Tor-powered network, routing your traffic through multiple encrypted layers for maximum anonymity. No technical setup needed — we handle the connection so you can browse privately in seconds. Instantly refresh your Tor circuit anytime for a fresh, untraceable connection.
VPN — Encrypted & Secure Connection Our built-in VPN adds an extra layer of security by encrypting your internet connection, protecting your data on public WiFi, and helping shield your activity from third parties, advertisers, and potential threats.
This app connects users to the Tor-powered network for privacy and security purposes. Some users may choose to access publicly available resources, including parts of the deep web or dark web. Usage depends on user responsibility and full compliance with local laws.
This app is designed for privacy and security purposes only. It does not promote or support any illegal activities. Users are solely responsible for how they choose to use the app.

bluejetty:00062072:ios.description:
Citizen of Rome - Dynasty Ascendant is a family/Dynasty life sim set in the Roman Republic.
You get to see how life was in the Ancient Republic, participate in their various customs, festivals and Ludi / sporting competitions, while raising a family and moving up in the social and economic hierarchy in the Republic.
You can educate your children, marry them off, sponsor their elections and much more. You'll take over as one of your children once your character dies, and live through the generations.
The game is open-ended without a set endgame just like in real life, but a grand goal for any ambitious Roman family was to land a Consulship of the republic. This could be your goal in the game as well, climbing the Cursus Honorum and becoming a "New Man" - "Novus Homo"
WARNING: The game just like fate will beat you down from time to time and you might find all that you worked for being taken away from you in an instant, but the way things are set up you'll almost certainly end up growing wealthy and reach the Senatorial class at some point despite various setbacks. There is no game-over and life goes on no matter what
A core philosophy of the game is that just like in real life, there's no winning or losing, just experiencing life and having fun at it no matter where it takes you. The game should be fun in its own way at every level, no matter if you're a prole or a senator, but with things just playing differently and with different goals and challenges
Gameplay features:
 + Fully offline, no ads, no in-app purchases
 + Marriage, Birth, Death, and Succession
 + Property and economy
 + Several key Roman festivals
 + Traits and Skills
 + Education
 + Apprenticeships and employment
 + Elections, Warfare and Class progression
 + Random interactions and events
 + Achievements
 + Dark Mode
 + Easy Mode
 + Modding support (See https://rome.rangergo.net/modding-support/)
Long live the Republic!
