bluejetty:00033843:ios.description:
Receiptix — Expense Tracker & Receipt Scanner
Track what you spend. Split costs with others. Know where your money goes.
Receiptix helps you stay on top of personal expenses without spreadsheets or manual bookkeeping. Snap a receipt, say it out loud, or type it in — your spending is organized automatically.
SHARED PROJECTS
Track expenses together. Create a project, invite people, and everyone's receipts land in one place. Great for couples managing a household budget, shared apartments, group trips, team budgets, or any situation where multiple people spend from the same pot.
APPLE WATCH
Track expenses right from your wrist. Log a quick expense, dictate a receipt by voice, or check your monthly spending — all without reaching for your phone. Your Watch stays in sync with your iPhone automatically.
SIRI SHORTCUTS
"Hey Siri, log an expense in Receiptix." Add expenses hands-free using Siri — at home, in the car, or on the go.
CHAT
Send receipts to Receiptix on WhatsApp or Telegram. Snap a photo, forward a PDF, or just type the amount — it lands in your spending automatically.
EMAIL FORWARDING
Got a receipt in your inbox? Forward it to your personal Receiptix email address and it gets processed automatically. Images, PDFs, and text-based digital receipts are all supported.
HOW IT WORKS
Add an expense however you prefer: take a photo of a receipt, use voice input, or enter it manually. Receiptix reads the receipt, pulls out the merchant, amount, date, and items, then files everything into the right category. You get clear charts and reports showing exactly where your money is going.
FREE TO START
Add your first expenses free — scan them, speak them, or type them. Included from day one:
- Automatic categorization
- Spending charts and breakdowns
- PDF spending summaries
- Multi-currency tracking with conversion
- Light and dark mode
- Multiple languages
PREMIUM
- Unlimited expenses — keep scanning, speaking, and typing with no limit
- AI receipt scanning — photograph any receipt and let Receiptix extract the details
- Voice input & Siri — speak your expenses hands-free, on your iPhone or Apple Watch
- Shared projects — collaborate on expenses with others
- Custom tags — organize beyond categories (by client, trip, event, or anything else)
- Full expense reports with receipts attached — ready for reimbursement or accounting
- Data export for spreadsheets and accounting
- Email forwarding — forward receipts from your inbox and they're processed automatically
- Chrome extension for online receipts
- Chat bots on WhatsApp and Telegram — log expenses through chat
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
- Works with receipts in any language or currency
- Tracks recurring and one-time expenses alike
- Syncs across devices
- No accounting knowledge needed
Privacy Policy: https://receiptix.io/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://receiptix.io/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00066271:ios.description:
SEASON Pro Football Manager is the most realistic mobile game experience of becoming a professional soccer manager.
Join soccer managers worldwide to become a top soccer manager along with the unbeatable excitement of soccer! 
Build your club from scratch and control every aspect of your team, create your own strategies and formations in captivating live simulations and build the most cutting-edge stadium and club facilities for your city!
Begin your journey as a soccer manager today and rise to the top in the world of soccer!
Name your club and build it from the ground up. In SEASON Pro Football Manager you have the opportunity to control every aspect of your club, from training sessions, transfers, squad selection, formation and tactics set-ups, club finances and jersey designs. You can develop your players and shape them into world-class stars with powerful special abilities like a soccer manager does in real life.
In this free online game you will join and compete against friends in real-time and improve your skills while playing against other managers from around the globe. 
There are SEASON soccer managers that have managed their clubs for over 3 years and have won many League Divisions, Champions Cups and Euro Cups! Can you win all the trophies? And become the champion of champions?
Play SEASON Pro Football Manager and experience the excitement of being a real soccer manager and building a legendary soccer club from scratch.
- Build and develop your stadium and all facilities.
- Scout and sign up top players from the live transfer market.
- Train your team and players individually to make them superstars
- Master your team’s skills, tactics and formations.
- Challenge other soccer managers daily in competitions and friendlies.
- Compete in the League Divisions, Champions Cup and Euro Cup!
Join the SEASON Pro Football Manager community on social media (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and YouTube) and stay up-to-date on all the latest news and tips!
See you on the touchline!

bluejetty:00026988:ios.description:
Surf Forecasts Made Awesome! 
Surf Captain gives you 16-day surf forecasts in an app that's fast and simple to read. 
WHAT YOU GET
• 16-day surf forecast, so you can plan your surf week 
• Surf height, swell, wind and tide together in one timeline
• Swell breakdown showing the individual swells behind the surf, with height, period and direction
• Favorites for the spots you check every day
• Surf alerts that notify you when a spot is forecast to hit the conditions you set
• Hundreds of locations across the United States, Canada, Central America and the Caribbean, with more regions on the way
FORECASTS BUILT FOR THE BREAK
Surf Captain doesn't just show open-ocean numbers. Our own wave model is tuned for each location, so the surf forecast reflects what reaches the beach: swell direction, wind, tide and nearby buoy data.
FREE AND PRO
The free app gives you the 5 day forecast for any spot. Surf Captain Pro unlocks the full 16 days, surf alerts and more for only $1.67 per month. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can manage them in your account settings.
Also works with your AI assistant: connect Surf Captain to Claude to ask about surf conditions in plain language.
Questions or feedback? Use Contact inside the app. We read everything.

Privacy: https://surfcaptain.com/privacy

bluejetty:00087557:ios.description:
Sleep tracking tells you what happened. SleepSpace helps you change what happens tonight.
Fall asleep with adaptive sound, support deeper sleep through the night, wake during a lighter sleep phase, and understand your recovery with personalized sleep insights.
Designed by sleep scientist Dr. Dan Gartenberg, SleepSpace brings together your phone, wearables, and guided sleep programs into one complete sleep system.
Built on peer-reviewed research and more than $4M in NIH-funded sleep science. Featured by TED, NPR, CNN, The NYTimes, TIME, Reuters, Human Upgrade, Ben Greenfield Life, Sleep Review, & more.
FALL ASLEEP FASTER
Wind down with relaxing sounds, guided breathing, meditations, and gentle biofeedback. SleepSpace helps your body transition into sleep with calming bedtime routines.
SLEEP DEEPER
Use adaptive sound masking and overnight sleep support to reduce disruptions and promote a more stable night. Track sleep stages, snoring, awakenings, recovery, and sleep quality with clear insights.
Choose sounds for your goals, including meditations, white noise, nature sounds, dream support, and sound patterns designed to support deeper, more restorative sleep.
WAKE UP REFRESHED
Wake during a lighter sleep phase with a smart alarm designed to reduce morning brain fog. Use smart sound or Apple Watch vibration to wake gently without disturbing your partner. Start the day with a clearer view of your recovery, alertness, and next best steps.
TRACK SLEEP YOUR WAY
SleepSpace works with:
• Your phone on the nightstand or mattress
• Apple Watch sleep tracking informed by peer-reviewed research
• Popular wearables such as Oura and WHOOP
• SleepSpace Charger and connected sleep devices
• A clinically inspired sleep diary based on the consensus sleep diary
Your data is unified into one clear sleep, recovery, and alertness view.
PERSONALIZED SLEEP PROGRAMS
Build a nightly Sleep Journey with sounds, wake windows, and routines tailored to your goals. Follow structured sleep programs inspired by evidence-based behavioral sleep techniques, including cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia.
DAILY ALERTNESS AND GUIDANCE
See how your sleep affects daytime energy, focus, and recovery. Get simple daily tasks to support better sleep habits over time.
AI-POWERED SLEEP SUPPORT
Dr. Snooze™ is your built-in AI sleep assistant, offering tips based on your sleep patterns. When you need extra support, you can also connect with a human coach.
PRIVACY-FIRST DESIGN
SleepSpace works offline and in airplane mode. Sound is analyzed as decibel levels and is not recorded unless you explicitly enable recording. Your sleep data stays private and secure. SleepSpace is built on HIPAA-compliant backend infrastructure with safeguards for health data, including encryption, access controls, audit logging, and secure data handling practices.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
SleepSpace is designed for general wellness and sleep support. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns. SleepSpace syncs with Apple Health to measure sleep and sleep-related health data. Support messages are voluntarily shared through Intercom.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
SleepSpace includes a 7-day free trial. After the free trial, a subscription is required to continue using premium features. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Terms: https://sleepspace.com/sleepspace-terms-of-use/
Privacy: https://sleepspace.com/privacy-policies/

Built on peer-reviewed research and more than $4M in NIH-funded sleep science. Featured by TED, NPR, CNN, The NYTimes, TIME, Reuters, Human Upgrade, Ben Greenfield Life, Sleep Review, & more.

FALL ASLEEP FASTER

Wind down with relaxing sounds, guided breathing, meditations, and gentle biofeedback. SleepSpace helps your body transition into sleep with calming bedtime routines.

SLEEP DEEPER

Use adaptive sound masking and overnight sleep support to reduce disruptions and promote a more stable night. Track sleep stages, snoring, awakenings, recovery, and sleep quality with clear insights.

Choose sounds for your goals, including meditations, white noise, nature sounds, dream support, and sound patterns designed to support deeper, more restorative sleep.

WAKE UP REFRESHED

Wake during a lighter sleep phase with a smart alarm designed to reduce morning brain fog. Use smart sound or Apple Watch vibration to wake gently without disturbing your partner. Start the day with a clearer view of your recovery, alertness, and next best steps.

TRACK SLEEP YOUR WAY

SleepSpace works with:
• Your phone on the nightstand or mattress
• Apple Watch sleep tracking informed by peer-reviewed research
• Popular wearables such as Oura and WHOOP
• SleepSpace Charger and connected sleep devices
• A clinically inspired sleep diary based on the consensus sleep diary

Your data is unified into one clear sleep, recovery, and alertness view.

PERSONALIZED SLEEP PROGRAMS

Build a nightly Sleep Journey with sounds, wake windows, and routines tailored to your goals. Follow structured sleep programs inspired by evidence-based behavioral sleep techniques, including cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia.

DAILY ALERTNESS AND GUIDANCE

See how your sleep affects daytime energy, focus, and recovery. Get simple daily tasks to support better sleep habits over time.

AI-POWERED SLEEP SUPPORT

Dr. Snooze™ is your built-in AI sleep assistant, offering tips based on your sleep patterns. When you need extra support, you can also connect with a human coach.

PRIVACY-FIRST DESIGN

SleepSpace works offline and in airplane mode. Sound is analyzed as decibel levels and is not recorded unless you explicitly enable recording. Your sleep data stays private and secure. SleepSpace is built on HIPAA-compliant backend infrastructure with safeguards for health data, including encryption, access controls, audit logging, and secure data handling practices.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

SleepSpace is designed for general wellness and sleep support. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns. SleepSpace syncs with Apple Health to measure sleep and sleep-related health data. Support messages are voluntarily shared through Intercom.

bluejetty:00114266:ios.description:
Stay Connected. Stay Safe. One Tap a Day.
Still Alive is the simplest way to let your loved ones know you’re okay. With just one tap, you can check in daily and give your family peace of mind.
How It Works:
• Tap “I’m OK” to check in anytime
• Optionally add how you’re feeling and where you are
• Choose your own check-in window
• If you don’t check in within your chosen time, your emergency contacts are notified
Look Back, Remember Your Days:
• View your past check-ins in a private timeline
• Revisit where you were and how you felt on different days
• A simple way to reflect on your life, moments, and routines over time
Perfect For:
• Seniors living independently
• Adults with aging parents
• Anyone who lives alone
• Long-distance family members who want reassurance, not constant calls
Simple & Private:
• No complicated setup — get started in minutes
• No social feeds or distractions
• Your data stays private and secure
• Works even without tech experience
Peace of Mind for Everyone:
Your family worries about you. You don’t want to be a burden.
Still Alive bridges that gap — a quiet daily check-in that says, “I’m still here. I’m doing fine.”
No news is good news.
But a quick tap — and a record of your days — is even better.

bluejetty:00043519:ios.description:
Whether you're a student, professional, or future traveler, languages are your passports to the world. With Vocabulity, you decide what you want to learn and how you want to learn it!
Vocabulity is the best app for learning a language's vocabulary.
Why?
Our approach allows you to memorize essential vocabulary quickly, easily, and lastingly using the following methods:
Varied lexicon: Discover over 8,000 words across more than 50 themes. From everyday life to specialized fields such as professional domains or economics, access all the vocabulary you need to feel comfortable in any situation.
Spaced repetition: Our spaced repetition method is based on science to ensure long-term retention. By adapting reviews to the forgetting curve, this method strengthens your vocabulary retention, ensuring it becomes deeply ingrained in your memory.
Pareto's Law: By focusing on learning the 20% of words used in 80% of daily conversations, you make your learning more efficient. This method allows you to master the most useful terms in minimal time.
Personalized learning: Flashcard exercises, multiple-choice questions, and writing tasks are designed to make your learning both effective and enjoyable. The option to create personalized vocabulary lists allows you to tailor content to your specific needs.
If you commit to learning 10 new words every day, you can expand your vocabulary by over 3,650 terms in a year. This daily habit will dramatically improve your command of English, equipping you with a rich and diverse lexicon, essential for confidently navigating the English-speaking world. So, why not give it a try?
Download Vocabulity and discover your complete and minimalist language companion, designed to help you master the essentials of English quickly, effectively, and lastingly.

bluejetty:00187858:ios.description:
Einfach - Sicher - Intuitiv
DATEV SmartLogin ist der Schlüssel zu Ihren vertraulichen Daten in der DATEV Online-Welt.
Scannen Sie bei der Anmeldung in den DATEV Online-Anwendungen einfach den QR-Code mit Ihrer SmartLogin App ab und schon sind Sie angemeldet.
Durch ein Passwort schützen Sie Ihre SmartLogin-App vor unerlaubter Benutzung durch Dritte schon beim App-Start.
DATEV SmartLogin steht allen DATEV-Anwendern als Authentisierungsmedium kostenfrei zur Verfügung. Nähere Informationen dazu finden Sie auf unserer Website: https://www.datev.de/smartlogin
Die Verwendung der DATEV SmartLogin-App auf einem jailbroken iOS-Device ist verboten!
Wichtiger Hinweis:
Um schon den Versuch eines Betrugs ("Phishing") von vornherein auszuschließen, beachten Sie:
• Geben Sie Ihr Passwort stets nur in der DATEV SmartLogin-App auf Ihrem Smartphone ein. DATEV wird Sie nie auffordern, Ihr Passwort anderswo (z.B. auf Webseiten, in E-Mails) einzugeben.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass im Browser am PC-Bildschirm tatsächlich die Webseite für die Anmeldung in der Online-Anwendung der DATEV dargestellt wird, bevor Sie den QR-Code scannen. DATEV wird Sie nie auffordern, den QR-Code anderswo (z. B. aus E-Mails, anderen Anwendungen oder Apps) zu scannen. Wenn Sie den QR-Code versehentlich doch anderswo gescannt haben, melden Sie sich in der SmartLogin-App in den Einstellungen mit 'Browsersitzungen abmelden' wieder ab.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie sich mit dem App-Login nur in offiziell von DATEV freigegebenen Apps anmelden. Informationen zu den Partnern und den verifizierten Apps finden Sie auf dem DATEV-Marktplatz.

bluejetty:00156899:ios.name: Hypnopedia: Night affirmations
bluejetty:00156899:ios.summary:
Hypnopedia is the first TMR application that helps you to significantly enhance the positive effect of affirmations while you’re asleep.  
Hypnopedia syncs with your Apple Watch and works during the beginning, middle, and end of your sleep
bluejetty:00156899:ios.description:
Hypnopedia is the first TMR application that helps you to significantly enhance the positive effect of affirmations while you’re asleep.  
Hypnopedia syncs with your Apple Watch and works during the beginning, middle, and end of your sleep cycle through 3 features:
1. Sleep Sounds – Gentle ASMR-like sounds to induce sleep
---------------------------------
Fall asleep faster listening to relaxing sleep sounds. Listen to trickling water, fire burning, thunder, rain, animal noises & more. Create playlists with your favorite sounds and save them for later. 
2. Affirmations (TMR) – Learn positive messages whilst you sleep
---------------------------------
Fill your mind with positive thoughts listening to 15+ pre-recorded affirmations for health, happiness, success, mindfulness, relationships & more. Affirmations play during peak times in your sleep when your brain is most receptive.
3. Smart Alarm – Wake only when your body is ready
---------------------------------
The Smart Alarm tracks your sleeping patterns through your Apple Watch and wakes you up at the most convenient time. No more groggy mornings, Hypnopedia ensures you only wake up feeling refreshed every day.
HOW TMR WORKS:
---------------------------------
TMR (Target memory reactivation) is a technique that allows you to significantly enhance the positive effect of affirmations due to the influence of several effects:
– Repeated listening to information during sleep helps the brain to revive and reinforce the material (affirmations) loaded into the subconscious before going to bed;
– There is a summation of the conscious (before going to bed) and subconscious (during sleep) effects of affirmations.
Hypnopedia tracks patterns in your sleep cycle through your Apple Watch and uses this data to read night affirmations or trigger an alarm at times when your brain is most receptive.
The moment for reading night affirmations is chosen by a specially tuned algorithm that identifies the specific phase of sleep when the brain is most susceptible to information received from external sources. 
HYPNOPEDIA – ALL FEATURES
-------------------------------------------
• 15+ affirmations to play whilst you sleep
• Positive topics including success, mindfulness, and love
• A variety of sleep sounds to help improve sleep quality and duration
• The Smart Alarm ensures you only wake up at an optimal time
• View and analyze detailed statistics on your sleeping habits
• Integrate your data with Apple Health 
FREE VERSION INCLUDES:
• Access to the core feature of Hypnopedia: playing affirmations during the night
• Sleep Sounds and 3D-player for deep relaxation and meditation
• Detailed statistics
• Smart Alarm that wakes you up at the most appropriate time before the set wake-up time
PREMIUM VERSION INCLUDES:
• Access to the whole library of the Sleep Sounds and Affirmations
• History data in the Statistic tab
APPLE HEALTH:
Hypnopedia integrates with Apple Health to monitor heart rate, movement and sleep data updates.
THE FOLLOWING SUBSCRIPTION PLAN IS AVAILABLE (the price may vary by country):
• 1-month of subscription – US $ 12.99
• 6-month of subscription – US $ 24.99
• 1-year of subscription – US $ 89.99
INFORMATION ABOUT THE SUBSCRIPTION AUTO-RENEWAL:
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan
• Subscription may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off in the user Account Settings after the purchase
• Any unused days of the free trial period will be cancelled once the user purchases a subscription
Privacy Policy: https://hypnopedia.site/assets/docs/PrivacyPolicy.pdf
Terms of Use: https://hypnopedia.site/assets/docs/Terms&Conditions.pdf

Connect! Merge! and Collect the Elements!
Favo! is a new puzzle game which you won’t be able to put down!
The rules are quite simple and the game play is stress free!
[Goal of the Game]
Link the three elements (red, blue, and green) 
on the board to collect as many points as possible! 
When there is no more space left on the board, it’s game over.
In order to enjoy this game to the fullest and get a high score, 
mastering the correct technique and maintaining a balanced collection of elements is key.
[How to Play]
- Slide the element panels with your finger to move them.
- Tap the panels to arrange the order of the elements.
[Level Up]
When one of your collected element gauges is full, the element will level up!
You will get a Merge Panel of the same element as a bonus!
[Merge Panel]
Let's put a merge panel next to panels of the same color.
You can merge all connected panels at once!
[Combo]
When you match more than one color at once, you can get a bonus!
- 2 color match = double points!!
- 3 color match = quadruple points!!!!
[Challenge Mode]
The challenge mode is the mode where you can defeat monsters!
Get rid of them by shooting the collected elements at the monsters.
Let's try to win the prizes which are newly designed merge panels together!

bluejetty:00090551:ios.description:
Dreamily, a creative AI companion for anyone seeking for new stories. You can create a world and start a story with this world, or speak with its characters.
「Example: The Dark Side」
Jackson is trying to win back his ex-girlfriend, Hope, whom he broke up with recently after an argument. On top of this, he also tries to keep a secret from her, which would ruin the relationship entirely if she found out. His secret is that he is a street fighter who fights for money, and he has no intention of stopping this lifestyle anytime soon.
Character Entry - Jackson: Jackson is a handsome man with dark hair and brown eyes. While he may seem like an average guy on the surface, underneath lies a fierce warrior. He's a underground fighter who uses his fists to make money, and he's very good at it. He isn't proud of what he does though, because it involves hurting people. As such, he keeps this hidden from most others, including Hope.
Highlight Features
1) Multiverse, written by you and AI
When you click the writing button, Dreamily will give you three options for the following plot.
2) Multiple writing styles
Dreamily has a variety of built-in collaborative writing models — General, Romance, Fantasy, Pure Love. Choose one to set the style of your story.
3) Set the sentence length you prefer
You can decide the length of the sentence that AI offers; You can also decide whether it is a full sentence.
4) Share your story in form of an image
Click Share and Dreamily will automatically generate an image of your story. Then you can share your writing superpower with your friends.
5) Create Your Own World
Now click World to create your unique universe. 
You can add a story background to outline your world first. 
Then you can edit entries of important characters and objects to record world info. Let's call it Dreamipedia;) Additionally, you can set main inter-character relationships to help Dreamily produce continuations according to the logic of your world. 
Dreamily will remember your world and help you complete it.
To resolve a complaint regarding Dreamily or to receive further information regarding the usage of Dreamily, please email us at support@dreamily.ai or join us at https://discord.com/invite/esDncB8zbH (Discord)

bluejetty:00030571:ios.summary:

• Check your benefits, balances and costs 
• See claims and coverage docume
bluejetty:00030571:ios.description:
Stay connected to your health benefits with the official Sharp Health Plan app for iPhone and iPad. Log in with Face ID® or Touch ID® for quick, secure access to: 
• Check your benefits, balances and costs 
• See claims and coverage documents 
• Find or change a primary care physician 
• View and print your member ID card
• Pay health plan premium bills, if applicable 
• Choose paperless options 
• Update your contact information 
• Set communication preferences 
• Manage access to your account
• Link your Sharp HealthCare account to schedule appointments, message your doctor, and more
• And much more
This app is designed for Sharp Health Plan members and Sharp Direct Advantage members. New features and performance updates are released frequently. 
STAY CONNECTED TO YOUR COVERAGE 
• See your benefits at a glance, including your annual balances and cost shares. 
• Search providers and facilities in your plan medical group and plan network. 
SEE YOUR BALANCES IN DETAIL 
• Check progress toward plan deductibles and maximum out-of-pocket limits. 
• View how many yearly visits you’ve used for different benefits. 
REVIEW YOUR CLAIMS HISTORY 
• Go paperless for explanations of benefits, if available for your plan. 
• See medical service claims and pharmacy claims that have been processed and paid. 
CHECK YOUR PHARMACY BENEFITS 
• Look up drug costs and coverage. 
• Find a pharmacy in your plan network. 
• Connect to your CVS Caremark account. 
MANAGE PREMIUM BILLING WITH EASE 
• Set up automatic payments. 
• View your current bill and past payments. 
• Pay as a guest, on behalf of a member. 
Upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs. 
____________________ 
BETTER HEALTH INSURANCE, FOR ALL AGES 
– Individual and family plans
– Financial help with Covered California™ 
– Medicare Advantage plans 
– Coverage for your employees 
INDIVIDUAL AND FAMILY PLANS > 
Explore plan options that fit your needs and budget. Contact our IFP enrollment team at 1-858-499-8211 with questions. 
sharphealthplan.com/quote 
MEDICARE ADVANTAGE PLANS > 
Review our enrollment steps to see if you’re ready to enroll. Contact our Medicare enrollment team at 1-858-499-8232 for personalized assistance. 
sharpdirectadvantage.com/now 
ABOUT SHARP HEALTH PLAN 
Sharp Health Plan is a local nonprofit health plan that has been serving San Diegans for over 30 years. Sharp Health Plan offers San Diegans of all ages access to award-winning, high-quality and affordable health insurance through their individual and family plans, commercial group plans and Medicare plans. See an up-to-date list of Sharp Health Plan honors, awards and quality ratings: 
sharphealthplan.com/honors

bluejetty:00027248:ios.description:
The Spreadsheet App has all you need for a Spreadsheet. 
It is easy to use and has all the basic funtionality you will need for working with data and presenting your results.
Its user interface and calculation technology saves you a lot of time and difficulties.
It has the ease of touch with no setup time for data, calculation, visualizing data in charts, and exporting reports into PDF.
Create Your Own Spreadsheet Functions
Take your spreadsheets to the next level with our new User-Defined Functions. Build custom formulas just once, then reuse them anywhere — no coding required.
Example: Make a “Pythagoras” function to instantly calculate the hypotenuse from two values, using a simple formula like:
=sqrt(A1^2 + B1^2)
Your custom functions work just like the built-in ones — but they’re yours.
USERS USE THE SPREADSHEET APP TO:
• Make budgets
• Track expenses
• Add charts for data
• Make analytical reports incl. sales analysis, scientific modelling
• Make weekly to-do lists
• Make work calendars
• Add memos and notes
• Perform math calculation
• Do almost everything
UNIQUE FEATURES:
• Easy drag and drop features for calculations and charts
• Interactive Visual Analyses through many graph types
• Intuitive & smooth User Interface
• Fast recalculations
• Undo/Redo
• Exports to PDF
• Share on social media
• No registration is required!
WHY SHOULD YOU USE The Spreadsheet App?
It is easy to use. There is no need to write formulas and to select tiny cells on the mobile device anymore. Your workflow, no matter it is sales, logic, memos, products, supplies, BI, or anything else that you want to work on an iPhone can never be so efficient.
With The Spreadsheet App you can make budgets, split costs, manage your travel expenses, do "what if" scenarios. It has never been more easy and secure to enter data into a spreadsheet app and more easy to make calculations. It is your perfect expense tracker & calculator.
The Spreadsheet App is a feature-rich app specially designed for iPhone users.
By downloading this app, you agree to the Apple Standard End User License Agreement (EULA), available here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

apple-macos:6826510045.name: Quotica: eBook Reader & Audio
apple-macos:6826510045.description:
Quotica turns any ebook into an audiobook. A natural voice reads it aloud on your device, highlights each sentence as it goes and shows its translation in your language right above it, so every book becomes bilingual.
LISTEN TO ANY BOOK
• Tap Listen and a natural voice reads from the page you are on, sentence by sentence.
• Skip back or ahead a sentence, change the speed, pause and pick up where you left off.
• The voice runs on your device, so it works offline.
BILINGUAL READING
• While a sentence is read, its translation appears in a bubble right above it.
• Translate a whole sentence with one tap, in the language you choose.
TAP ANY WORD
• Pronunciation, meaning in your language, Wiktionary and Wikipedia, right on the page.
• Colour nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs to see how every sentence is built.
HIGHLIGHTS & NOTES
• Mark passages in five colours and add notes to new words.
• Find them all again in each book's notebook.
READ YOUR WAY
• EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3 and FB2 books, and comics in CBZ or CBR.
• Add books from Files, from a link, or from another device over Wi‑Fi.
• Page curl, slide or vertical scrolling, two pages side by side on iPad and Mac.
• Light, sepia and dark pages, adjustable text and full-screen reading.
SHARE THE AUDIOBOOK
• Share a book over Wi‑Fi: friends nearby open one link to read or listen in their browser. No app, no account.
INKY, YOUR READING COMPANION
• Ask Inky about the page you are on, or get a reminder of where you left off after a few days away.
• Needs Apple Intelligence. Everything is worked out on your device, and Inky can make mistakes.
A HABIT FOR LIFE
• Set a daily goal, keep your reading streak and continue right where you stopped.
• Reading stats: your streak, a goal calendar, books finished, reading speed and a year to share.
• Shelves, series and reading status keep a growing library in order.
• A sleep timer for listening in bed, and widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• Keep books in iCloud and your place, bookmarks and highlights follow you to your other devices.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in. Your books stay on your device or in your own iCloud, and the voice and translation run on the device. Only words you look up are sent to Wiktionary and Wikipedia.
QUOTICA UNLIMITED
Try Quotica with three books of your own, besides the sample book. Quotica Unlimited, a one-time purchase, lets you add as many books as you like on all your devices. No subscription.

apple-itunes:1446274754.description:
YOUR DAILY PRACTICE FOR BODY & MIND
Move your body. Calm your mind. Feel your best.
Welcome to The Yoga Collective, your personal yoga and wellness studio, wherever life takes you.
Discover over 1,500 expertly guided classes in yoga, fitness, meditation, Pilates, and mindful movement, designed to help you build strength, improve flexibility, reduce stress, and create a healthier, more balanced life.
Whether you’re stepping onto your mat for the first time or deepening an established practice, there’s something here for every body, every level, and every day.
FIND YOUR PERFECT PRACTICE
Explore an extensive library of classes led by inspiring instructors from around the world.
• Vinyasa Yoga — Energize your body and connect with your breath.
• Power Yoga — Build strength, endurance, and confidence.
• Yin & Restorative Yoga — Slow down, release tension, and restore balance.
• Beginner Yoga — Build a strong foundation with accessible, step-by-step instruction.
• Pilates & Fitness — Strengthen, tone, and move with intention.
• Meditation & Breathwork — Find clarity, cultivate mindfulness, and reconnect with yourself.
• Stretching & Flexibility — Improve mobility and feel better in your body.
• Sleep & Relaxation — Unwind and create space for deeper rest.
WELLNESS THAT FITS YOUR LIFE
Your practice should work around your schedule, not the other way around.
Choose from classes ranging from 5 to 60 minutes, whether you have a few minutes to reset or an hour to fully immerse yourself.
Practice at home, while traveling, or wherever you feel most comfortable.
From energizing morning flows to calming evening meditations, find exactly what your body and mind need.
DESIGNED TO SUPPORT YOUR JOURNEY
• 1,500+ on-demand yoga and wellness classes
• Expert instructors from around the world
• Classes for beginners through advanced practitioners
• Personalized search by style, duration, level, and focus
• Curated collections to support your goals
• Save your favorite classes
• Download classes for offline practice
• Track your progress and build consistency
• Set daily reminders to stay inspired
• Explore meditation, breathwork, and mindful living
MORE THAN YOGA. A WAY OF LIFE.
At The Yoga Collective, we believe wellness is a daily practice, not a destination.
It’s about feeling stronger in your body, finding greater peace in your mind, and creating moments of connection with yourself.
Some days you’ll want to challenge yourself. Other days you’ll need to slow down.
Whatever you need, there’s a practice waiting for you.
JOIN THE COLLECTIVE
Become part of a global community dedicated to movement, mindfulness, and living well.
Start your 7-day free trial and discover a more balanced approach to everyday wellness.
Your practice. Your pace. Your journey.
The Yoga Collective — Daily Classes for Body & Mind.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
The Yoga Collective offers subscription plans that provide access to its library of classes and features.
Eligible new subscribers can start with a 7-day free trial. After the trial, your selected subscription automatically renews at the price displayed during purchase unless canceled.
Terms & Conditions: https://www.theyogacollective.com/terms-and-conditions/

apple-macos:1067172178.name: FBReader: ePub and fb2 reader
apple-macos:1067172178.description:
FBReader is a fast and easy-to-use e-book reader for iPhone and iPad. It supports all major e-book formats, including ePub (with key ePub3 features), Kindle azw3, and fb2 (.zip). You can open both unprotected books and ePub files protected with Readium LCP DRM.
FBReader also reads RTF, Word (.doc), HTML, and plain text, so you can keep all your books and documents in one place.
Read anywhere and pick up right where you left off. FBReader can sync your library, reading positions, bookmarks, and more across devices using the FBReader Book Network, a cloud service powered by Google Drive.
If you prefer managing files yourself, you can download books in your browser and open them directly with FBReader.
A wide range of appearance and behavior options lets you customize the reading experience to match your preferences.
Free version and upgrade options:
• The free version allows up to 10 books in your library.
• The built-in translation feature is disabled.
Upgrade to the full version to remove these limits and enjoy the complete FBReader experience.

apple-macos:6812253926.name: On The Margins: Bible Notes
apple-macos:6812253926.description:
On The Margins puts your thinking right next to the text: a resizable notes margin beside the Bible reading pane, so annotating feels like part of reading rather than a separate app.
HIGHLIGHT VERSES AND KEEP NOTES ON THEM
Highlights and notes are anchored to the verse, not to one translation. Switch versions, or read in chronological order, and everything you wrote stays exactly where it belongs.
PHOTOGRAPH SERMON SLIDES
Attach a photo of a sermon slide or a handwritten page. The app recognises the text so the note is searchable later. Or draw a note by hand, Apple Pencil supported, beside your typed notes.
READ THE BIBLE IN ORDER
A chronological reading mode with an interactive timeline of eras and key figures, so you can read events in the order they happened.
MULTIPLE TRANSLATIONS
KJV, WEB, BSB, NIV (licensed from Biblica) and NASB (licensed from the Lockman Foundation), plus translations in German, Spanish, French and Romanian.
READ OFFLINE
Downloaded translations, your notes and your highlights live on the device, so reading and writing work without a connection. Sync catches up when you are back online.
SYNC ACROSS IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
Start a note on your phone during the sermon. Finish it on your Mac that evening. It is the same note, not a copy of one.
Read aloud, adjustable text size, six reading themes with light and dark modes, and full keyboard navigation on Mac.
No ads. No tracking. Free to use.

apple-itunes:456278671.name: Grid Player
apple-itunes:456278671.description:
From 1 December 2026, Grid Player will no longer be available for new users to download from the App Store. If you already have Grid Player, you can keep using it, and you can download it again using the same Apple Account if it is removed from your device. 
Grid Player is built on old technology and we are no longer able to guarantee it will continue to work in the future. We want everyone who uses to have the best possible experience, and we can do that most effectively by focusing our time and care on Grid 3 and Grid for iPad. We have not developed new features or content for Grid Player for many years, and we want to direct our efforts towards the apps that can continue to grow with the people who use them. 
We recommend switching to Grid for iPad, our full AAC app. 
You can find full details and answers to frequently asked questions on the Smartbox Hub: https://hub.thinksmartbox.com/knowledgebase/grid-player-update-2026/
---
Grid Player is an Alternative and Augmentative Communication (AAC) App that helps people who cannot speak or who have unclear speech to communicate. Sentences that you create are spoken out loud.
Grid Player is suitable for a wide range of people with communication difficulties, including those who use symbols.
Grid Player is designed for use with Grid 3 and The Grid 2, allowing you to play your grids on iPad. If you don't have Grid 3 or The Grid 2, you can use Grid Player with four complete grid sets: Symbol Talker A, Symbol Talker B, Talking Photographs and Text Talker Phrasebook.
Please note that you need a Online Grids account to use Grid Player. You can create an account for free within the Grid Player app, or sign in to an existing account.
GRID PLAYER FEATURES
• Over 12,000 Widgit Symbols
• Over 12,000 SymbolStix Symbols
• High-quality male and female voices
• “TouchType” word prediction for faster typing
• Prediction suggestions with symbols to help with word recognition
• Word list grids for large topics
• Copy sentences to use with Twitter, Facebook, etc
SYMBOL TALKER A and B
• Dynamic screen AAC
• Uses Widgit symbols
• Over 2,000 unique words in over 50 topics
• Two vocabulary sizes (levels A and B)
TALKING PHOTOGRAPHS
• Over 1000 vivid photographs
• 42 categories
• Inspirational for education and communication
TEXT TALKER PHRASEBOOK
• Over 100 instant phrases
• 10 topics to discuss
• Quick response buttons for answering questions
Grid Player is suitable for people with a wide range of disabilities, including cerebral palsy, motor-neurone disease (ALS), autism, apraxia, traumatic brain injury, stroke and deafness. It can also be used in education for people with learning difficulties or special needs, and with young children.
All over the world, thousands of people are communicating with Grid 3 and The Grid 2 from Smartbox. Install Grid Player and you can join the conversation today!

apple-macos:6815287905.name: HomeFace: Family Calendar
apple-macos:6815287905.description:
HomeFace turns an iPad, iPhone, Apple TV or Mac you already own into the family screen that runs your home. Put it on the kitchen wall or the living room TV and everyone sees what's happening today.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Family calendar: today and what's coming up, with each event showing whose calendar it's from
• Reminders and a shared grocery list you can check off from the screen or a widget
• Meal plan for tonight and the week, with ingredients sent to the grocery list
• Chores: kids tap to finish a chore (points and rewards with HomeFace Plus)
• Routines for mornings, after school, and bedtime
• Countdowns, weather in °F or °C, and a household photo slideshow
• Cards grow to fit what's in them, so nothing gets hidden
KITCHEN TIMERS THAT ACTUALLY RING
• Start as many as you need; every screen in the house sees them
• The phone that started a timer rings like a real alarm, with a Lock Screen countdown for every timer
ASK SIRI, OR TAP ONCE
• "Stop the pasta timer", "Add milk to groceries", "What's for dinner?"
• Control Center buttons, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Announce "Dinner's ready!" and it appears on every HomeFace screen in the house
• Leave-by times tell you when to head out for events with an address
MADE FOR A SCREEN THAT'S ALWAYS ON
• Night mode dims to a quiet clock at bedtime
• A photo frame fills the screen when nobody is using it
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts and no ads. Your household syncs through your family's own iCloud.
• Invite family with a link or a 6-character code; each person picks which of their calendars the family sees.
• Your calendar, lists, and photos are never sent to us.
HOMEFACE PLUS (OPTIONAL)
The iPhone and iPad app is free. HomeFace Plus adds: your family's day on Apple TV and Mac (free for 14 days on each), Smart Home control (lights, rooms, scenes, locks), chore points and rewards, Who's home and automatic On my way, adding and editing calendar events, alerts when family adds things, search, photos on events, custom timer sounds, your own header, more Reminders cards and extra widget styles.
One purchase covers your whole household. Monthly, yearly (with a 1-week free trial) or lifetime. Already using HomeFace? Smart Home, chore rewards and the big screen stay free for your family.
No hardware to buy. Just the devices you already have.
Privacy: https://hellogoodday.com/homeface/privacy
Terms: https://hellogoodday.com/homeface/terms
